Apprentice Wizard.rulesTextZh:
施法者
降臨 → 抽一張法術牌。

Blood Ravens.rulesTextEng:
UPDATED: Airborne
Blood Ravens' strike damage against units heals you.
Blood Ravens.rulesTextZh:
飛行
血鴉對單位造成的打擊傷害會為你回復等量生命。

Candlemas Monks.rulesTextEng: Deathrite → Proceed to the end phase.
Candlemas Monks.rulesTextZh: 死亡儀式 → 直接進入結束階段。

Daperyll Vampire.rulesTextEng:
UPDATED: Airborne
Daperyll Vampire's strike damage against units heals you.
Daperyll Vampire.rulesTextZh:
飛行
達佩瑞爾吸血鬼對單位造成的打擊傷害會為你回復等量生命。

East-West Dragon.rulesTextZh:
飛行
可自由向左右移動。

Grandmaster Wizard.rulesTextZh:
施法者
降臨 → 抽三張法術牌。

Grim Reaper.rulesTextEng:
Lethal
Whenever Grim Reaper kills a minion, banish that minion and all copies. Search its owner's cemetery, hand, and spellbook and banish any copies. They shuffle.
Grim Reaper.rulesTextZh:
致命
每當死神消滅一個隨從時，放逐該隨從及其所有同名牌。搜尋其擁有者的墳墓場、手牌與法術書，並放逐所有同名牌，然後其擁有者將法術書洗牌。

Haast Eagle.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
May carry a weaker allied minion.
Haast Eagle.rulesTextZh:
飛行
可以載運一個力量較低的友方隨從。

Headless Haunt.rulesTextEng:
Voidwalk
At the start of your turn, Headless Haunt teleports to the top of a random site or void.
Headless Haunt.rulesTextZh:
虛空行走
在你的回合開始時，無頭幽魂傳送至一個隨機地點或虛空的地表。

Highland Falconer.rulesTextEng: Genesis → You may search your hand and spellbook for a Beast with Airborne and mana cost ② or less and summon it here. Shuffle if needed.
Highland Falconer.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 你可以從手牌與法術書中搜尋一張具有飛行且法力成本為②或以下的野獸，將其召喚到此處。如有搜尋法術書，則將其洗牌。

Highland Princess.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Search your spellbook for an artifact that costs ① or less, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle.
Highland Princess.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 在你的法術書中搜尋一件成本為①或以下的遺物，展示之，加入你的手牌，然後將法術書洗牌。

Hounds of Ondaros.rulesTextEng:
Airborne, Burrowing, Submerge, Voidwalk
Nearby enemies permanently lose Stealth.
Hounds of Ondaros.rulesTextZh:
飛行，潛地，潛水，虛空行走
附近的敵方失去潛行標記（之後仍可再獲得潛行）。

Kite Archer.rulesTextEng:
Ranged
Immediately after performing a ranged strike, Kite Archer may take a step.
Kite Archer.rulesTextZh:
遠程
在進行遠程打擊後，風箏弓箭手可以立即邁出一步。

Lord of the Void.rulesTextEng:
Voidwalk
At the end of your turn, Lord of the Void may banish an adjacent site, unless there's an Avatar there.
Lord of the Void.rulesTextZh:
虛空行走
在你的回合結束時，虛空領主可以放逐一個相鄰的地點，除非該地點上有化身。

Men of Leng.rulesTextEng: Whenever Men of Leng strike an Avatar, that Avatar discards a random card.
Men of Leng.rulesTextZh: 每當冷原之民打擊一個化身時，該化身隨機棄置一張手牌。

Moon Clan Werewolf.rulesTextEng: Sacrifice an allied Mortal → Summon Moon Clan Werewolf from your hand to the Mortal's location.
Moon Clan Werewolf.rulesTextZh: 犧牲一個友方凡人 → 從你的手牌將月族狼人召喚到該凡人所在的位置。

Nightmare.rulesTextEng: At the end of your turn, for each enemy minion here, you may push it to an adjacent location or void.
Nightmare.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合結束時，對於此處的每個敵方隨從，你可以將其推至相鄰的位置或虛空。

Nimbus Jinn.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
Discard a spell → Deal 3 damage to another random unit here.
Nimbus Jinn.rulesTextZh:
飛行
棄置一張法術牌 → 對此處另一個隨機單位造成3點傷害。

Phantasmal Shade.rulesTextEng: When Phantasmal Shade is struck, destroy it.
Phantasmal Shade.rulesTextZh: 當幻影幽魂受到打擊時，將其摧毀。

Phantom Steed.rulesTextEng:
Movement +2, Voidwalk
May carry an allied minion.
Phantom Steed.rulesTextZh:
移動力 +2，虛空行走
可以載運一個友方隨從。

Phase Assassin.rulesTextEng:
Voidwalk
Whenever Phase Assassin enters the void, he gains Stealth.
Phase Assassin.rulesTextZh:
虛空行走
每當相位刺客進入虛空時，獲得潛行。

Puppet Master.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
Genesis → Gain control of all tapped minions here until Puppet Master leaves the realm.
Puppet Master.rulesTextZh:
飛行
降臨 → 獲得此處所有已橫置隨從的控制權，直到傀儡大師離開界域。

Recurring Specter.rulesTextEng:
Can't defend.
May be cast from your cemetery.
Recurring Specter.rulesTextZh:
不能防禦。
可以從你的墳墓場施放。

Riddle Sphinx.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
Genesis → Look at your topmost spell. You may put it on the bottom of your spellbook, then an opponent may exchange your top and bottommost spells. Draw a card.
Riddle Sphinx.rulesTextZh:
飛行
降臨 → 查看你法術書頂的牌。你可以將它置於法術書底，然後由一位對手選擇是否交換你法術書頂與法術書底的牌。接著抽一張牌。

Roaming Monster.rulesTextEng: May be summoned to any site.

Skirmishers of Mu.rulesTextEng:
Ranged
During basic movement, Skirmishers of Mu may perform a ranged strike from any location along their path.
Skirmishers of Mu.rulesTextZh:
遠程
在進行基本移動時，穆族散兵可以在移動路徑上的任何位置進行一次遠程打擊。

Sky Baron.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
All other minions lose Airborne.
Sky Baron.rulesTextZh:
飛行
所有其他隨從失去飛行。

Sling Pixies.rulesTextEng:
Airborne, Ranged
Takes no damage from units with 4 or more power.
Sling Pixies.rulesTextZh:
飛行，遠程
不會受到力量為4或以上的單位造成的傷害。

Spire Lich.rulesTextEng: If Spire Lich is atop a Tower, it has +2 power, Ranged, and Spellcaster.
Spire Lich.rulesTextZh: 如果尖塔巫妖位於一座塔樓頂部，則它獲得力量 +2、遠程與施法者。

Ultimate Horror.rulesTextEng:
Airborne, Voidwalk
Genesis → Summon each other dead Voidwalk minion to a nearby site or void.
Ultimate Horror.rulesTextZh:
飛行，虛空行走
降臨 → 將每個其他已死亡且具有虛空行走的隨從召喚到附近的地點或虛空。

Vril Revenant.rulesTextEng:
Voidwalk
① → Gain +1 power this turn.
Vril Revenant.rulesTextZh:
虛空行走
① → 本回合獲得力量 +1。

Wind Sylph.rulesTextEng:
Airborne, Air Spellcaster
After Wind Sylph casts a Magic spell, she may push a unit here one step.
Wind Sylph.rulesTextZh:
飛行，風元素施法者
在風之精靈施放一張魔法牌後，她可以將此處的一個單位推動一步。

Witherwing Hero.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
Whenever a weaker allied minion here is attacked, you may return it to its owner's hand.
Witherwing Hero.rulesTextZh:
飛行
每當此處一個力量較低的友方隨從受到攻擊時，你可以將其返回其擁有者的手牌。

Zephyranne Airship.rulesTextEng:
Airborne, Movement +2
May carry any number of allied minions.
Zephyranne Airship.rulesTextZh:
飛行，移動力 +2
可以載運任意數量的友方隨從。

Blink.rulesTextEng: An ally teleports to a location it’s nearby. Draw a card.
Blink.rulesTextZh: 一個友方單位傳送至其附近的一個位置。抽一張牌。

Browse.rulesTextEng: Look at your next seven spells. Put one in your hand and the rest on the bottom of your spellbook in any order.
Browse.rulesTextZh: 查看你法術書頂接下來七張牌。將其中一張加入你的手牌，其餘以任意順序置於法術書底。

Chain Lightning.rulesTextEng: Deal 2 damage to target unit nearby. Any number of times, you may spend ② to additionally target a new unit nearby the previous one.
Chain Lightning.rulesTextZh: 對附近的目標單位造成2點傷害。你可以重複任意次支付②，額外指定一個位於前一個目標附近的新目標單位。

Chaos Twister.rulesTextEng: Place target minion on the back of your hand, then blow it off from a height of at least one foot. Deal damage equal to its power to each unit atop the site it lands on, including itself.
Chaos Twister.rulesTextZh: 將目標隨從放在你的手背上，然後從至少一英尺高處將它吹落。它落到哪個地點，就對該地點地表上的每個單位（包括它自己）造成等同於其力量的傷害。

Disenchant.rulesTextEng: Destroy all auras and artifacts at target location up to two steps away.
Disenchant.rulesTextZh: 摧毀至多兩步距離外目標位置上的所有靈氣與遺物。

Dream-Quest.rulesTextEng: An allied Spellcaster falls asleep and is disabled until hurt. At the start of your next turn, if it's still asleep, you may wake it up to search your spellbook for a card and put it into your hand. Shuffle if needed.
Dream-Quest.rulesTextZh: 一個友方施法者陷入沉睡並失去能力，直到受到傷害為止。在你的下個回合開始時，若它仍在沉睡，你可以喚醒它，從你的法術書中搜尋一張牌加入手牌。如有搜尋法術書，則將其洗牌。

Fade.rulesTextEng: Give an allied minion Stealth. If it occupies an enemy site, draw a card.
Fade.rulesTextZh: 使一個友方隨從獲得潛行。若它佔據一個敵方地點，則抽一張牌。

Flanking Maneuver.rulesTextEng: Teleport any number of allies at one location to another location a chess knight's move away. Draw a card.
Flanking Maneuver.rulesTextZh: 將位於同一位置的任意數量友方單位傳送至另一個相距一個西洋棋騎士步的位置。抽一張牌。

Grapple Shot.rulesTextEng: An ally shoots a projectile. If it hits a unit, the ally is dragged to that location, and may strike the hit unit when it arrives.
Grapple Shot.rulesTextZh: 一個友方單位射出一枚投射物。若命中一個單位，該友方單位會被拉至該位置，並可在抵達時對被命中的單位進行一次打擊。

Lightning Bolt.rulesTextEng: Deal 3 damage to a random unit at target location.
Lightning Bolt.rulesTextZh: 對目標位置的一個隨機單位造成3點傷害。

Mortality.rulesTextEng: Kill all Mortal minions at target location up to two steps away.
Mortality.rulesTextZh: 消滅至多兩步距離外目標位置上的所有凡人隨從。

Occult Ritual.rulesTextEng: Gain ② this turn for each allied Spellcaster here.
Occult Ritual.rulesTextZh: 此處每有一個友方施法者，本回合便獲得②。

Psionic Blast.rulesTextEng: Deal 1 damage to each minion here. They're disabled until your next turn.
Psionic Blast.rulesTextZh: 對此處每個隨從造成1點傷害。它們失去能力直到你的下個回合。

Rain of Arrows.rulesTextEng: Deal 1 damage to each aboveground minion.
Rain of Arrows.rulesTextZh: 對每個位於地表的隨從造成1點傷害。

Raise Dead.rulesTextZh: 召喚一個隨機已死亡的隨從。

Recall.rulesTextEng: Teleport any number of allied minions to the caster’s location.
Recall.rulesTextZh: 將任意數量的友方隨從傳送至施法者所在的位置。

Telekinesis.rulesTextEng: Caster snatches and picks up target nearby artifact they can carry.
Telekinesis.rulesTextZh: 施法者奪取並拾起一件附近自己可攜帶的目標遺物。

Teleport.rulesTextEng: Teleport an ally to the surface of target site.
Teleport.rulesTextZh: 將一個友方單位傳送至目標地點的地表。

Unlikely Alliance.rulesTextEng: Draw a card for each rarity among allied minions.
Unlikely Alliance.rulesTextZh: 友方隨從中每有一種不同的稀有度，便抽一張牌。

Waypoint Portal.rulesTextEng: Choose two different sites. This turn, units can move between them as if they were adjacent.
Waypoint Portal.rulesTextZh: 選擇兩個不同的地點。本回合，單位可以在它們之間移動，如同它們彼此相鄰。

Whirling Blades.rulesTextEng: An ally may take up to two steps, and then strikes each enemy along their entire path.
Whirling Blades.rulesTextZh: 一個友方單位可以移動至多兩步，然後對其整條移動路徑上的每個敵方單位各進行一次打擊。

Windblast.rulesTextEng: Push everything atop sites one step in a cardinal direction.
Windblast.rulesTextZh: 將所有位於地表上的物件朝一個主方向推動一步。

Evil Presence.rulesTextEng: You may summon Spirits to affected sites. When you summon a Spirit here, give it Charge, and return Evil Presence to its owner's hand.
Evil Presence.rulesTextZh: 你可以將靈體召喚到受影響的地點。每當你在此處召喚一個靈體時，它獲得衝鋒，然後將邪惡降臨返回其擁有者的手牌。

Summoning Sphere.rulesTextEng: You may summon minions to affected sites.
Summoning Sphere.rulesTextZh: 你可以將隨從召喚到受影響的地點。

Thunderstorm.rulesTextEng:
At the end of your turn, deal 3 damage to a random unit atop affected sites, then you may move Thunderstorm one step.
Lasts 3 of your turns.
Thunderstorm.rulesTextZh:
在你的回合結束時，對受影響地點上的一個隨機單位造成 3 點傷害，然後你可以將雷暴移動一步。
持續你的 3 個回合。

Wall of Air.rulesTextEng:
Conjure atop the border of a site you control.
Minions with Airborne or 2 or less power can't traverse Wall of Air.
Wall of Air.rulesTextZh:
召喚於你操控的一個地點邊界上。
具有飛行或力量為 2 以下的僕從不能穿越風牆。

Älvalinne Dryads.rulesTextZh: 艾爾瓦林樹妖提供 ①。

Atlas Wanderers.rulesTextEng: Genesis → This site and an adjacent site change places, carrying along everything of normal size.
Atlas Wanderers.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 此地點與一個相鄰地點交換位置，並一同帶走所有正常尺寸的物件。

Bone Rabble.rulesTextEng: Whenever you play an earth site, you may summon Bone Rabble from your cemetery to that site.
Bone Rabble.rulesTextZh: 每當你打出一個大地地點時，你可以從你的墓地將骸骨暴民召喚到該地點。

Conqueror Worm.rulesTextEng: At the end of your turn, if no enemy units occupy this site, permanently gain control of it.
Conqueror Worm.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合結束時，若沒有敵方單位佔據此地點，永久獲得其控制權。

Crown Prince.rulesTextEng: Deathrite → If you control another Mortal, return Crown Prince to its owner's hand.
Crown Prince.rulesTextZh: 死亡儀式 → 若你操控另一個凡人，將王儲返回其擁有者手牌。

Dwarven Digging Team.rulesTextEng:
Burrowing
Allied minions occupying nearby sites have Burrowing.
Dwarven Digging Team.rulesTextZh:
潛地
佔據附近地點的友方僕從具有潛地。

Frontier Settlers.rulesTextEng: Tap → Reveal and play your topmost site to an adjacent void or Rubble. Frontier Settlers move there and lose this ability.
Frontier Settlers.rulesTextZh: 橫置 → 揭示並打出你最上方的地點到一個相鄰的虛空或瓦礫。邊境拓荒者移動至該處並失去此能力。

Gneissgnath Gnomes.rulesTextEng:
Burrowing
At the end of your turn, Gneissgnath Gnomes may burrow.
Gneissgnath Gnomes.rulesTextZh:
潛地
在你的回合結束時，片麻岩顎地精可以潛地。

Grey Wolves.rulesTextEng:
Your spellbook may include any number of Grey Wolves.
Has +1 power for each other Grey Wolves nearby.
Grey Wolves.rulesTextZh:
你的法術書可以包含任意數量的灰狼。
每有一個其他附近的灰狼，便具有 +1 力量。

House Arn Bannerman.rulesTextZh: 其他附近友方具有 +1 力量。

King of the Realm.rulesTextEng:
Other Mortals have +1 power.
You control all Mortals.
King of the Realm.rulesTextZh:
其他凡人具有 +1 力量。
你操控所有凡人。

Mage Slayer.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Kill target Spellcaster minion nearby.
Mage Slayer.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 殺死附近目標施法者僕從。

Master Tracker.rulesTextZh: 所有敵人失去潛行標記（之後仍可再獲得潛行）。

Midland Army.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Target a location up to three steps away. Deal 4 damage to each unit there.
Deathrite → Summon a Foot Soldier token to each adjacent location.
Midland Army.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 指定一個最多三步外的位置。對該處每個單位造成 4 點傷害。
死亡儀式 → 在每個相鄰位置召喚一個步兵衍生物。

Miracle Workers.rulesTextEng: Genesis → You may return a minion that died this turn from your cemetery to your hand.
Miracle Workers.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 你可以將一個本回合死亡的僕從從你的墓地返回你的手牌。

Monastery Gargoyle.rulesTextEng: UPDATED: At the start and end of your turn, choose whether Monastery Gargoyle has Airborne or is a Monument.
Monastery Gargoyle.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合開始與結束時，選擇修道院石像鬼具有飛行，或成為紀念碑。

Monster Hunter.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 殺死一個附近的怪物。

Mordric Druids.rulesTextEng:
Spellcaster
Whenever you lose life due to an undefended attack nearby, the attacker's controller also loses that much life.
Mordric Druids.rulesTextZh:
施法者
每當你因附近一次未防禦的攻擊而失去生命時，攻擊者的操控者也失去等量生命。

Pudge Butcher.rulesTextEng:
UPDATED: Immobile
Tap → Shoot a projectile. If it hits a unit, drag it to this location. Pudge may fight it when it arrives.
Pudge Butcher.rulesTextZh:
不能移動
橫置 → 射出一枚投射物。若它擊中一個單位，將其拖曳到此位置。當其抵達時，帕吉可以與其戰鬥。

Queen of Midland.rulesTextEng: After an opponent draws a card, if they have more cards than you, you may draw a card.
Queen of Midland.rulesTextZh: 在一位對手抽牌後，若其手牌比你多，你可以抽一張牌。

Root Spider.rulesTextEng:
Burrowing
While Root Spider is burrowed, minions directly above it are disabled.
Root Spider.rulesTextZh:
潛地
當樹根蜘蛛潛地時，其正上方的僕從被停用。

Royal Bodyguard.rulesTextEng: If a nearby Avatar or royalty (King, Queen, Prince, or Princess) would take damage, Royal Bodyguard may take that damage instead.
Royal Bodyguard.rulesTextZh: 若附近的化身或王族（國王、女王、王子或公主）將受到傷害，皇家保鑣可以改為承受該傷害。

Scent Hounds.rulesTextZh: 附近的敵方失去潛行標記（之後仍可再獲得潛行）。

Scourge Zombies.rulesTextEng: Whenever an allied Mortal dies on land, you may summon Scourge Zombies from your cemetery to its location, tapped.
Scourge Zombies.rulesTextZh: 每當一個友方凡人在陸地上死亡時，你可以將墓地中的災禍殭屍以橫置狀態召喚到該位置。

Shield Maidens.rulesTextZh: 附近友方受到的傷害減少 1 點。

Silver Valkyries.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
At the end of your turn, untap all allies here.
Silver Valkyries.rulesTextZh:
飛行
在你的回合結束時，重置此地所有友方。

Sirian Templar.rulesTextEng: Takes no damage from Demon, Spirit, or Undead minions.
Sirian Templar.rulesTextZh: 不會受到惡魔、精魂或不死僕從造成的傷害。

Sisters of Silence.rulesTextEng: UPDATED: Other nearby minions are silenced.
Sisters of Silence.rulesTextZh: 其他附近的僕從被沉默。

Slumbering Giantess.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Fall asleep. Slumbering Giantess is disabled until hurt.
Slumbering Giantess.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 進入睡眠。在受到傷害前，沉睡女巨人處於停用狀態。

Squirming Mass.rulesTextEng: UPDATED: Whenever another nearby minion dies, Squirming Mass permanently gains its power.
Squirming Mass.rulesTextZh: 每當另一個附近的僕從死亡時，蠕動肉塊永久獲得其力量。

Stone-gaze Gorgons.rulesTextEng: Other minions at rest at adjacent locations are disabled.
Stone-gaze Gorgons.rulesTextZh: 位於相鄰位置且處於休整狀態的其他僕從被停用。

Tragedy Worrywart.rulesTextEng: Units nearby take no damage from Magic spells.
Tragedy Worrywart.rulesTextZh: 附近的單位不會受到魔法咒語造成的傷害。

Vanguard Knights.rulesTextEng: Vanguard Knights have +2 power if they alone are the furthest forward of your units.
Vanguard Knights.rulesTextZh: 若先鋒騎士是你所有單位中唯一最前方的單位，則其力量 +2。

Wicked Witch.rulesTextEng:
Spellcaster
Other nearby minions have -2 power.
Wicked Witch.rulesTextZh:
施法者
其他附近的僕從力量 -2。

Wraetannis Titan.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 攻擊此地每個敵方。

Yourke Crossbowmen.rulesTextEng:
Ranged
Takes no damage from ranged strikes.
Yourke Crossbowmen.rulesTextZh:
遠程
不會受到遠程攻擊造成的傷害。

Assorted Animals.rulesTextEng: Search your spellbook for different Beasts with a combined mana cost of X or less, reveal them, and put them in your hand. Shuffle your spellbook.
Assorted Animals.rulesTextZh: 在你的法術書中搜尋任意數量且名稱各不相同的野獸，其總法力成本合計為 X 或以下，展示它們，並將它們加入你的手牌。然後洗牌。

Border Militia.rulesTextEng: Summon a Foot Soldier token to each site you control that borders an enemy site.
Border Militia.rulesTextZh: 在每個與敵方地點相鄰且由你操控的地點召喚一個步兵衍生物。

Bury.rulesTextEng: Burrow target minion or artifact, if able.
Bury.rulesTextZh: 若可以，使目標僕從或遺物潛地。

Call to War.rulesTextEng: Search your spellbook for an Exceptional Mortal, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your spellbook.
Call to War.rulesTextZh: 在你的法術書中搜尋一張卓越凡人，展示它，並將它加入你的手牌。然後洗牌。

Cave-In.rulesTextEng: Burrow all minions and artifacts occupying target land site.
Cave-In.rulesTextZh: 使佔據目標陸地地點的所有僕從與遺物潛地。

Common Sense.rulesTextEng: Search your spellbook for an Ordinary card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your spellbook.
Common Sense.rulesTextZh: 在你的法術書中搜尋一張普通卡牌，展示它，並將它加入你的手牌。然後洗牌。

Craterize.rulesTextEng: As an additional cost to cast Craterize, discard a site. Destroy target site and deal damage to each unit above or below a site in the area of effect:
Craterize.rulesTextZh: 施放此咒語時，需額外棄掉一張地點牌作為代價。摧毀目標地點，並對效果範圍內位於地點地表或地下的每個單位造成傷害：

Dispel.rulesTextEng: Destroy all auras and artifacts at target location up to two steps away.
Dispel.rulesTextZh: 摧毀兩步內目標位置上的所有光環與遺物。

Earthquake.rulesTextEng: You may rearrange sites within a two-by-two area, carrying along everything of normal size. Then burrow all minions and artifacts on those sites.
Earthquake.rulesTextZh: 你可以重新排列一個 2×2 區域內的地點，並一同移動其上的所有正常尺寸物件。然後使那些地點上的所有僕從與遺物潛地。

Exorcism.rulesTextEng: Banish all Demon and Undead minions at target location up to two steps away.
Exorcism.rulesTextZh: 放逐兩步內目標位置上的所有惡魔與不死僕從。

Gigantism.rulesTextEng: Give an allied unit +6 power this turn.
Gigantism.rulesTextZh: 本回合，一個友方單位力量 +6。

Minecart Madness.rulesTextEng: This turn, your units can move between any sites in a chosen span of land as if they were adjacent.
Minecart Madness.rulesTextZh: 本回合，你的單位可以在一段你選擇的連續陸地中的任意地點之間移動，視為彼此相鄰。

Overpower.rulesTextEng: Give an ally +2 power this turn.

Shield Wall.rulesTextEng: Until your next turn, each ally takes 1 less damage for each other ally it's nearby.
Shield Wall.rulesTextZh: 直到你的下個回合開始前，每個友方每有一個附近的其他友方，便使其受到的傷害減少 1 點。

Star-seeds of Uhr.rulesTextEng: Fill up to thirteen voids with Rubble.
Star-seeds of Uhr.rulesTextZh: 以碎石填滿至多十三個虛空。

Unravel.rulesTextEng: Destroy all artifacts and Undead minions at a location up to two steps away.
Unravel.rulesTextZh: 摧毀兩步內一個位置上的所有遺物與不死僕從。

Crusade.rulesTextEng:
You may summon earth minions to affected sites.
Allied earth minions occupying affected sites have +1 power.
Crusade.rulesTextZh:
你可以將土系僕從召喚到受影響的地點。
佔據受影響地點的友方土系僕從力量 +1。

Entangle Terrain.rulesTextEng: Minions occupying affected sites lose Airborne and are Immobile. Lasts 3 of your turns.
Entangle Terrain.rulesTextZh: 佔據受影響地點的僕從失去飛行，且變為無法移動。持續三個你的回合。

Rest in Peace.rulesTextEng: Whenever a Spirit or Undead minion occupies affected land sites, burrow it.
Rest in Peace.rulesTextZh: 每當精魂或不死僕從佔據受影響的陸地地點時，使其潛地。

Ancient Dragon.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
Tap → Deal 4 damage to each other unit at target location nearby.
Ancient Dragon.rulesTextZh:
飛行
橫置 → 對附近目標位置上的每個其他單位造成 4 點傷害。

Aramos Mercenaries.rulesTextEng: You may discard a random card rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Aramos Mercenaries.rulesTextZh: 你可以改為隨機棄掉一張手牌，而非支付此咒語的法力成本。

Askelon Phoenix.rulesTextEng:
UPDATED: Airborne
If Askelon Phoenix would take fire damage, it gains +1 power this turn instead.
Askelon Phoenix.rulesTextZh:
飛行
若阿斯克隆鳳凰將受到火焰傷害，改為本回合力量 +1。

Awakened Mummies.rulesTextEng: UPDATED: Summon Awakened Mummies burrowed safely. When an enemy unit moves onto the ground above them, they unburrow and fight.
Awakened Mummies.rulesTextZh: 以安全潛地狀態召喚甦醒木乃伊。當敵方單位移動到其上方地表時，它們會解除潛地並戰鬥。

Azuridge Caravan.rulesTextEng: Has all elements and minion types.
Azuridge Caravan.rulesTextZh: 具有所有元素與僕從類型。

Bane Widow.rulesTextEng: Genesis → May kill target minion here.
Bane Widow.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 可以消滅此地的目標僕從。

Beast of Burden.rulesTextEng: May carry any number of allied minions.
Beast of Burden.rulesTextZh: 可以載運任意數量的友方僕從。

Bull Demons of Adum.rulesTextEng: Tap → Move three steps in a cardinal direction. When Bull Demons of Adum enter each location, they strike each untapped unit there.
Bull Demons of Adum.rulesTextZh: 橫置 → 朝一個基本方向移動三步。阿杜姆牛魔每進入一個位置時，都會攻擊該處每個未橫置的單位。

Cauldron Crones.rulesTextEng:
Spellcaster
Genesis → You may sacrifice another minion here to draw a spell.
Cauldron Crones.rulesTextZh:
施法者
降臨 → 你可以犧牲此地另一個僕從來抽一張法術牌。

Cerberus in Chains.rulesTextEng:
Must be summoned to your location.
Cerberus in Chains automatically follows you and can't move itself away.
Cerberus in Chains.rulesTextZh:
必須召喚到你所在的位置。
鎖鏈地獄犬會自動跟隨你，且不能自行離開。

Clamor of Harpies.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
Genesis → Teleport target weaker minion to this location. Clamor of Harpies may strike it.
Clamor of Harpies.rulesTextZh:
飛行
降臨 → 將目標力量較低的僕從傳送到此位置。鷹身女妖喧囂可以攻擊它。

Colicky Dragonettes.rulesTextEng: At the end of your turn, Colicky Dragonettes shoot a projectile. It deals 1 damage.
Colicky Dragonettes.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合結束時，暴躁幼龍發射一枚投射物，造成 1 點傷害。

Courtesan Thaïs.rulesTextEng: Genesis → During their next turn, each player is controlled by the previous one.
Courtesan Thaïs.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 在下一個回合中，每位玩家都由上一位玩家操控。

Death Dealer.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 消滅所有其他僕從。

Doomsday Prophet.rulesTextEng: Nearby units take double damage, except from strikes.
Doomsday Prophet.rulesTextZh: 附近的單位受到的傷害加倍，但攻擊造成的傷害除外。

Far East Assassin.rulesTextEng:
Stealth
Tap → Far East Assassin throws an artifact he carries at target adjacent unit. It takes damage equal to the artifact's mana cost.
Far East Assassin.rulesTextZh:
潛行
橫置 → 遠東刺客將其攜帶的一件遺物投擲向目標相鄰單位。該單位受到等同於該遺物法力成本的傷害。

Grösse Poltergeist.rulesTextEng: Tap → Until Grosse Poltergeist leaves the realm, gain control of a nearby artifact and animate it. It's an Automaton with power equal to its cost, and has its own bearer abilities.
Grösse Poltergeist.rulesTextZh: 橫置 → 直到格羅瑟騷靈離開場域前，獲得一件附近遺物的控制權，並使其活化。它視為一個自動機，力量等同於其成本，且保有自身的持有者異能。

Hillock Basilisk.rulesTextEng: Other minions at rest here or one step in front of Hillock Basilisk are disabled.
Hillock Basilisk.rulesTextZh: 位於此地或丘陵蛇蜥前方一步且處於休整狀態的其他僕從被停用。

Infernal Legion.rulesTextEng: At the end of your turn, deal 3 damage to each other adjacent unit.
Infernal Legion.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合結束時，對每個其他相鄰單位造成 3 點傷害。

Karkemish Chimera.rulesTextEng: Can simultaneously attack up to three units at the same location.
Karkemish Chimera.rulesTextZh: 可以同時攻擊位於同一位置的至多三個單位。

Lava Salamander.rulesTextEng:
Fire Spellcaster
Takes no damage from fire spells.
Lava Salamander.rulesTextZh:
火焰施法者
不會受到火焰咒語造成的傷害。

Maze Minotaur.rulesTextEng: Enemy minions can’t move themselves out of a maze of nine locations nearby Maze Minotaur.
Maze Minotaur.rulesTextZh: 敵方僕從不能自行離開迷宮牛頭人附近由九個位置構成的迷宮。

Outback Strider.rulesTextEng: Moves freely between land sites not occupied by other units.
Outback Strider.rulesTextZh: 可以在未被其他單位佔據的陸地地點之間自由移動。

Panorama Manticore.rulesTextEng:
Airborne, Lethal
At the end of your turn, if you cast a non-fire spell this turn, untap Panorama Manticore.
Panorama Manticore.rulesTextZh:
飛行、致命
在你的回合結束時，若你本回合施放過非火焰咒語，則重置全景蠍尾獅。

Quarrelsome Kobolds.rulesTextEng: At the end of your turn, Quarrelsome Kobolds strike themselves or another target adjacent unit.
Quarrelsome Kobolds.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合結束時，好鬥狗頭人攻擊自己或另一個目標相鄰單位。

Rimland Nomads.rulesTextEng:
Movement +1
Takes no damage from Deserts.
Rimland Nomads.rulesTextZh:
移動力 +1
不會受到沙漠造成的傷害。

Sacred Scarabs.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
Deathrite → Deal 3 damage to each unit here.
Sacred Scarabs.rulesTextZh:
飛行
死亡之力 → 對此地每個單位造成 3 點傷害。

Scavenging Fiend.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Conjure a broken artifact to this location.
Scavenging Fiend.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 將一件損壞的遺物創造到此位置。

Seasoned Sellsword.rulesTextEng: Avatars nearby have "Discard a card → Gain control of Seasoned Sellsword."
Seasoned Sellsword.rulesTextZh: 附近的化身獲得「棄掉一張牌 → 獲得老練傭兵的控制權。」

Swiven Scout.rulesTextEng:
Movement +1
Enemy Avatars within Swiven Scout's range of motion play with their hands revealed.
Swiven Scout.rulesTextZh:
移動力 +1
位於斯威文斥候行動範圍內的敵方化身，必須公開其手牌進行遊戲。

Tvinnax Berserker.rulesTextEng:
Whenever Tvinnax Berserker can attack a unit, he must.
Untap Tvinnax Berserker whenever he attacks and kills an enemy minion.
Tvinnax Berserker.rulesTextZh:
每當特維納克狂戰士可以攻擊一個單位時，他必須攻擊。
每當特維納克狂戰士攻擊並消滅一個敵方僕從時，重置特維納克狂戰士。

Vile Imp.rulesTextEng: Genesis → May deal 2 damage to target adjacent unit.
Vile Imp.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 可以對目標相鄰單位造成 2 點傷害。

Wayfaring Pilgrim.rulesTextEng: Whenever Wayfaring Pilgrim enters each corner of the realm for the first time, you may draw a card.
Wayfaring Pilgrim.rulesTextZh: 每當朝聖旅人首次進入場域的一個角落時，你可以抽一張牌。

Wills-o'-the-Wisp.rulesTextEng:
Voidwalk
Whenever Wills-o’-the-Wisp are attacked, they may teleport to another nearby location or void to evade the attack.
Wills-o'-the-Wisp.rulesTextZh:
虛空行走
每當鬼火受到攻擊時，可以傳送到另一個附近的位置或虛空，以閃避該次攻擊。

Backstab.rulesTextEng: Target minion moves to an adjacent location, if needed, to strike another target tapped minion there.
Backstab.rulesTextZh: 目標僕從若有需要，移動到一個相鄰位置，攻擊該處另一個目標橫置僕從。

Blaze.rulesTextEng: This turn, give an ally Movement +2, it can't be intercepted, and it leaves a trail of fire at departed locations. When it stops, each unit along the trail takes 2 damage.
Blaze.rulesTextZh: 本回合，一個友方移動力 +2、無法被攔截，並會在離開的每個位置留下火焰軌跡。當它停止移動時，沿途的每個單位受到 2 點傷害。

Boil.rulesTextEng: Destroy all minions occupying target water site up to two steps away.
Boil.rulesTextZh: 摧毀兩步內目標水域地點上的所有僕從。

Cone of Flame.rulesTextEng: Choose a direction from the caster. Deal damage to each unit at a location in the area of effect:
Cone of Flame.rulesTextZh: 選擇施法者面向的一個方向。對效果範圍內每個位置上的單位造成傷害：

Critical Strike.rulesTextEng: The next time an ally strikes a unit this turn, it deals double damage.
Critical Strike.rulesTextZh: 本回合，下一次友方攻擊單位時，造成雙倍傷害。

Disintegrate.rulesTextEng: Banish target minion nearby, and everything it carries.
Disintegrate.rulesTextZh: 放逐附近的目標僕從，以及它所攜帶的一切。

Fireball.rulesTextEng: Shoot a projectile. It deals 4 damage on impact, and 2 damage to each other unit at that location.
Fireball.rulesTextZh: 發射一枚投射物。命中時造成 4 點傷害，並對該位置上的每個其他單位造成 2 點傷害。

Firebolts.rulesTextEng: Shoot three projectiles in the same direction, one at a time. Each deals 1 damage.
Firebolts.rulesTextZh: 朝同一方向依序發射三枚投射物，每枚造成 1 點傷害。

Flame Wave.rulesTextEng: Flame Wave flows horizontally, from one edge of the realm to the other. Deal damage to each unit atop sites in the area of effect:
Flame Wave.rulesTextZh: 烈焰波沿水平方向從場域的一側橫掃至另一側。對效果範圍內位於地點地表上的每個單位造成傷害：

Heat Ray.rulesTextEng: UPDATED: Shoot a piercing projectile. Deal 2 damage to each hit unit.
Heat Ray.rulesTextZh: 發射一枚穿透投射物。對每個命中的單位造成 2 點傷害。

Immolation.rulesTextEng: Deal 7 damage to target minion nearby.
Immolation.rulesTextZh: 對附近的目標僕從造成 7 點傷害。

Incinerate.rulesTextEng: Deal 4 damage to each other unit at target location near the caster or an allied Dragon.
Incinerate.rulesTextZh: 對施法者或友方巨龍附近目標位置上的每個其他單位造成 4 點傷害。

Infiltrate.rulesTextEng: UPDATED: Target enemy minion gains Stealth and taps. You control it until it no longer has Stealth.
Infiltrate.rulesTextZh: 目標敵方僕從獲得潛行並橫置。你操控它，直到它失去潛行為止。

Leap Attack.rulesTextEng: An ally may take a step, and then it strikes each enemy at its location.
Leap Attack.rulesTextZh: 一個友方可以移動一步，然後攻擊其所在位置上的每個敵方。

Mad Dash.rulesTextEng: Draw a card, then give an ally Movement +1 this turn.
Mad Dash.rulesTextZh: 抽一張牌，然後本回合使一個友方移動力 +1。

Major Explosion.rulesTextEng:
Target a location up to two steps away.
Deal damage to each unit at locations in the area of effect:
Major Explosion.rulesTextZh:
選擇兩步內的一個目標位置。
對效果範圍內各位置上的每個單位造成傷害：

Meteor Shower.rulesTextEng: Target three sites that share no borders. Deal damage to each unit atop sites in each area of effect:
Meteor Shower.rulesTextZh: 選擇三個彼此不相鄰的地點。對每個效果範圍內位於地點地表上的每個單位造成傷害：

Minor Explosion.rulesTextEng: Deal 3 damage to each unit at target location up to two steps away.
Minor Explosion.rulesTextZh: 對兩步內目標位置上的每個單位造成 3 點傷害。

Pact with the Devil.rulesTextEng: Sacrifice the caster or lose half your life, rounding up. If you do, draw three cards.
Pact with the Devil.rulesTextZh: 犧牲施法者，否則失去一半生命（無條件進位）。若如此作，抽三張牌。

Poison Nova.rulesTextEng:
Lethal
Deal 1 damage to each other nearby minion.
Poison Nova.rulesTextZh:
致命
對每個其他附近的僕從造成 1 點傷害。

Scorched Earth.rulesTextEng: Choose any number of sites you control. Destroy each of those sites and everything there.
Scorched Earth.rulesTextZh: 選擇任意數量由你操控的地點。摧毀那些地點及其上的一切。

Spin Attack.rulesTextEng: An ally strikes each enemy at its location.
Spin Attack.rulesTextZh: 一個友方攻擊其所在位置上的每個敵方。

Warp Spasm.rulesTextEng: This turn, double an allied minion's power, and whenever it attacks and kills a unit, it untaps. At the end of the turn, it dies.
Warp Spasm.rulesTextZh: 本回合，使一個友方僕從的力量加倍，且每當它攻擊並消滅一個單位時，便重置它。在回合結束時，它死亡。

Drought.rulesTextEng: Affected sites aren't water sites, and provide no water threshold.
Drought.rulesTextZh: 受影響的地點不再視為水域地點，且不提供水元素門檻。

Jihad.rulesTextEng:
You may summon fire minions to affected sites.
Allied fire minions occupying affected sites have +1 power.
Jihad.rulesTextZh:
你可以將火系僕從召喚到受影響的地點。
佔據受影響地點的友方火系僕從力量 +1。

Sandstorm.rulesTextEng:
Affected sites and units atop them can't be attacked or intercepted.
At the start of your turn, dispel Sandstorm.
Sandstorm.rulesTextZh:
受影響的地點及位於其地表上的單位不能成為攻擊或攔截的目標。
在你的回合開始時，驅散沙暴。

Wall of Fire.rulesTextEng:
Conjure atop the border of a site you control.
Whenever a unit passes through Wall of Fire, it takes 3 damage.
Wall of Fire.rulesTextZh:
創造於你操控的一個地點邊界上。
每當一個單位穿過火焰之牆時，便受到 3 點傷害。

Wildfire.rulesTextEng:
Conjure Wildfire atop a single site nearby.
At the end of each turn, each unit here takes 3 damage, then move Wildfire to an adjacent location it hasn't visited before. If none remain, dispel Wildfire.
Wildfire.rulesTextZh:
在附近一個地點的地表創造野火。
每回合結束時，此地每個單位受到 3 點傷害，然後將野火移動到一個它尚未到過的相鄰位置。若沒有符合條件的位置，則驅散野火。

Accursed Albatross.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
When a unit kills Accursed Albatross, kill that unit's other allied minions it's nearby.
Accursed Albatross.rulesTextZh:
飛行
當一個單位消滅受詛咒的信天翁時，消滅該單位附近所有其他友方僕從。

Adept Illusionist.rulesTextEng:
Spellcaster
Tap → Search your hand, cemetery, or spellbook for another Adept Illusionist and summon it nearby. Shuffle if needed.
Adept Illusionist.rulesTextZh:
施法者
橫置 → 在你的手牌、墓地或法術書中搜尋另一張幻術大師，並將其召喚到附近。若搜尋了法術書，則洗牌。

Anui Undine.rulesTextEng:
Submerge
Anui Undine has +1 power for each site in her body of water.
Anui Undine.rulesTextZh:
潛水
阿努伊溫蒂妮每有一個屬於她所在水域的地點，力量便 +1。

Bridge Troll.rulesTextEng: Whenever an enemy attacks Bridge Troll, they must spend all of their remaining mana to give to you on your next turn.
Bridge Troll.rulesTextZh: 每當一個敵方攻擊橋樑巨魔時，其操控者必須將所有剩餘法力保留，並於你的下個回合交給你。

Brobdingnag Bullfrog.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Brobdingnag Bullfrog swallows another target minion here. He carries it disabled in his belly until he leaves the realm.
Brobdingnag Bullfrog.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 布羅卜丁奈格牛蛙吞下此地另一個目標僕從。在布羅卜丁奈格牛蛙離開場域前，該僕從會以停用狀態存在於牠腹中，並由牠攜帶。

Captain Baldassare.rulesTextEng: Whenever Captain Baldassare attacks a unit or site, the defending player discards their topmost three spells. You may cast each of those spells once this turn, ignoring threshold requirements.
Captain Baldassare.rulesTextZh: 每當巴爾達薩雷船長攻擊一個單位或地點時，防禦方玩家棄掉其法術牌堆頂的三張法術牌。本回合，你可以各施放那些法術一次，且無視元素門檻需求。

Court Jester.rulesTextEng: At the end of your turn, each nearby Avatar discards a random card.
Court Jester.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合結束時，每個附近的化身隨機棄掉一張牌。

Deep-Sea Mermaids.rulesTextEng:
Submerge
Genesis → Draw your bottommost spell.
Deep-Sea Mermaids.rulesTextZh:
潛水
降臨 → 抽取你的法術牌堆最底部的一張法術牌。

Diluvian Kraken.rulesTextEng:
Submerge
Tap → Surface to strike each other unit nearby.
Diluvian Kraken.rulesTextZh:
潛水
橫置 → 浮出水面，攻擊每個其他附近的單位。

Felbog Frog Men.rulesTextEng: Can leap entirely over adjacent sites in one step.
Felbog Frog Men.rulesTextZh: 可以一步完全跳過相鄰的地點。

Fenvale Muse.rulesTextEng:
Spellcaster
Whenever Fenvale Muse casts a spell, you may trigger the Genesis of a nearby River.
Fenvale Muse.rulesTextZh:
施法者
每當芬谷繆思施放一個咒語時，你可以觸發附近一條河流的降臨異能。

Fey Changeling.rulesTextEng:
May be summoned to any site.
Genesis → You may return a minion here to its owner’s hand.
Fey Changeling.rulesTextZh:
可以召喚到任何地點。
降臨 → 你可以將此地的一個僕從移回其擁有者手牌。

Ghost Ship.rulesTextEng:
Voidwalk
Whenever Ghost Ship enters a site from the void, you may summon a Spirit from any cemetery to its位置.
Ghost Ship.rulesTextZh:
虛空行走
每當幽靈船從虛空進入一個地點時，你可以從任一墓地將一個精魂召喚到它所在的位置。

Giant Shark.rulesTextEng:
Submerge, Waterbound
Whenever another unit enters or moves between sites in this body of water, Giant Shark moves to that unit to fight it.
Giant Shark.rulesTextZh:
潛水、水域束縛
每當另一個單位進入或在此水域中的地點之間移動時，巨鯊便移動到該單位所在位置並與其戰鬥。

Great Old One.rulesTextEng:
Submerge
Genesis → Permanently flood the entire realm, including voids.
Great Old One.rulesTextZh:
潛水
降臨 → 永久淹沒整個場域，包括所有虛空。

Guile Sirens.rulesTextEng:
Submerge
At the start of your turn, force target nearby enemy minion to take a step toward Guile Sirens.
Guile Sirens.rulesTextZh:
潛水
在你的回合開始時，強制附近的目標敵方僕從朝魅惑海妖移動一步。

Lord of Unland.rulesTextEng:
Submerge
Other allies occupying Lord of Unland's body of water have +1 power.
Lord of Unland.rulesTextZh:
潛水
佔據無陸之主所在水域的其他友方力量 +1。

Megamoeba.rulesTextEng: Megamoeba moves by extending a single pseudopod from any part of itself. It occupies all locations it has ever occupied, and has +1 power for each.
Megamoeba.rulesTextZh: 巨型變形蟲可從自身任意部位伸出一條偽足來移動。它會持續佔據曾經佔據過的所有位置，且每佔據一個位置，力量便 +1。

Mother Nature.rulesTextEng: At the start of your turn, reveal your topmost spell. If it's a minion, you may summon it here.
Mother Nature.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合開始時，展示你的法術牌堆頂牌。若該牌為僕從，你可以將它召喚到此地。

Old Salt Anchorman.rulesTextEng: Nearby allies can't be moved by enemy spells and abilities.
Old Salt Anchorman.rulesTextZh: 附近的友方不能被敵方咒語或異能移動。

Ormund Harpooneers.rulesTextEng: Tap → Deal 1 damage to target minion above or below an adjacent water site and pull that minion to this location.
Ormund Harpooneers.rulesTextZh: 橫置 → 對位於相鄰水域地點地表或水下的目標僕從造成 1 點傷害，並將該僕從拉到此位置。

Polar Bears.rulesTextEng: Can move as if the top and bottom edges of the realm were connected.
Polar Bears.rulesTextZh: 可以移動，視為場域的上邊緣與下邊緣彼此相連。

Polar Explorers.rulesTextEng: Allied units here can move as if the top and bottom edges of the realm were connected.
Polar Explorers.rulesTextZh: 此地的友方單位可以移動，視為場域的上邊緣與下邊緣彼此相連。

Ruler of Thul.rulesTextEng:
Charge
Allies can move as if the top and bottom edges of the realm were connected. Other allies occupying sites there have +1 power.
Ruler of Thul.rulesTextZh:
衝鋒
友軍可以視為疆域的頂端與底端邊界相互連接來移動。位於這些邊界地點上的其他友軍獲得 +1 力量。

Sea Raider.rulesTextEng: Whenever Sea Raider attacks and kills an enemy, its controller discards their topmost spell. You may cast that spell once this turn, ignoring threshold.
Sea Raider.rulesTextZh: 每當海襲者攻擊並消滅一個敵軍時，其操控者棄掉其法術書頂的一張法術牌。本回合中，你可以無視門檻施放該法術一次。

Seirawan Hydra.rulesTextEng: UPDATED: Immediately heals from damage that doesn't kill it.
Seirawan Hydra.rulesTextZh: 若受到的傷害不足以消滅它，則立即恢復該傷害。

Selfsame Simulacrum.rulesTextEng: May be summoned as a basic copy of a nearby minion.
Selfsame Simulacrum.rulesTextZh: 可以作為附近一個隨從的基礎複製品被召喚。

Sneak Thief.rulesTextEng:
Stealth
Tap → Steal an artifact out of the hands of another target unit here, and stay Stealthed.
Sneak Thief.rulesTextZh:
潛行
橫置 → 從此處另一個目標單位手中偷取一件遺物，且保持潛行狀態。

Tide Naiads.rulesTextEng:
Submerge
This site is flooded. It is a water site.
Tide Naiads.rulesTextZh:
潛水
此地點被淹沒，視為水域。

Tringh Constrictor.rulesTextEng: Tap → Tringh Constrictor may take a step, then it constricts target minion here and carries it disabled. The next time Tringh Constrictor would untap, it instead kills that minion if it's still constricted.
Tringh Constrictor.rulesTextZh: 橫置 → 特林巨蟒可以邁出一步，然後纏繞此處一個目標隨從，使其失能並攜帶著它。下一次特林巨蟒將要重置時，若該隨從仍處於被纏繞狀態，則改為消滅該隨從。

Tufted Turtles.rulesTextEng: The first time Tuft Turtles would take damage each turn, prevent that damage.
Tufted Turtles.rulesTextZh: 每回合首次簇冠龜群將受到傷害時，改為防止該傷害。

Unland Angler.rulesTextEng:
Submerge
At the start of your turn, if Unland Angler is submerged, force each enemy minion atop adjacent sites to take a step toward this one.
Unland Angler.rulesTextZh:
潛水
在你的回合開始時，若安蘭鮟鱇處於水下，則使每個位於相鄰地點地表的敵方隨從朝此地邁出一步。

Unland Eel.rulesTextEng:
Submerge
Whenever Unland Eel submerges, it may drag another minion here down with it.
Unland Eel.rulesTextZh:
潛水
每當安蘭鰻潛入水下時，它可以將此處另一個隨從一同拖入水下。

Yokai Kappas.rulesTextEng: Discard a water site → Untap Yokai Kappas. Use only once per turn.
Yokai Kappas.rulesTextZh: 棄掉一張水域地點 → 重置妖怪河童。每回合只能使用一次。

Dodge Roll.rulesTextEng:
May be cast when an ally is attacked.
An attacked ally may move to another adjacent location to evade the attack.
Dodge Roll.rulesTextZh:
可在友軍受到攻擊時施放。
受到攻擊的友軍可以移動到另一個相鄰位置，以閃避此次攻擊。

Drown.rulesTextEng: Submerge target minion or artifact, if able.
Drown.rulesTextZh: 若可行，使目標隨從或遺物潛入水下。

Extinguish.rulesTextEng: Banish all fire minions and fire auras occupying target site up to two steps away.
Extinguish.rulesTextZh: 放逐至多距離兩步內目標地點上的所有火焰隨從與火焰光環。

Fire Harpoons!.rulesTextEng: Deal 1 damage to target minion above or below an adjacent Water site and pull it to the caster's location. Draw a card.
Fire Harpoons!.rulesTextZh: 對位於相鄰水域地點地表或水下的目標隨從造成 1 點傷害，然後將其拉到施法者所在的位置。抽一張牌。

Font of Life.rulesTextEng: Each ally heals an amount equal to the number of sites in its body of water.
Font of Life.rulesTextZh: 每個友軍恢復等同於其所在水體包含的地點數量之生命值。

Frost Nova.rulesTextEng: Freeze nearby enemy minions. They're disabled until your next turn.
Frost Nova.rulesTextZh: 凍結附近所有敵方隨從。它們失能直到你的下一個回合。

Geyser.rulesTextEng: This turn, flood target site and give each minion there Airborne. Draw a card.
Geyser.rulesTextZh: 本回合，使目標地點淹沒，且該處每個隨從獲得飛行。抽一張牌。

Ice Lance.rulesTextEng: UPDATED: Shoot a piercing projectile. Deal 3, then 2, then 1 damage to up to one hit unit at each of the first three locations along its path.
Ice Lance.rulesTextZh: 射出一枚可穿透的投射物。沿著其路徑前進，在前三個位置各對至多一個被擊中的單位依序造成 3、2、1 點傷害。

Marine Voyage.rulesTextEng: This turn, your units can move between any sites in a chosen body of water as if they were adjacent.
Marine Voyage.rulesTextZh: 本回合，你的單位可以在所選水體中的任意地點之間移動，視為彼此相鄰。

Pollimorph.rulesTextEng: Transform target nearby minion into a Frog token.
Pollimorph.rulesTextZh: 將附近目標隨從轉化為一個青蛙衍生物。

Replication.rulesTextEng: Conjure a copy of an artifact carried by the caster.
Replication.rulesTextZh: 創造一件施法者所攜帶遺物的複製品。

Riptide.rulesTextEng: Target water site pulls in an aboveground unit it's adjacent to. Draw a card.
Riptide.rulesTextZh: 目標水域將一個與其相鄰的地表單位拉入該水域。抽一張牌。

Shrink.rulesTextEng: Set the base power of target nearby unit to 0 until your next turn.
Shrink.rulesTextZh: 直到你的下一個回合前，將附近目標單位的基礎力量設為 0。

Sleep.rulesTextEng: Target minion at a location up to two steps away falls asleep. It's disabled until it takes damage.
Sleep.rulesTextZh: 使至多距離兩步內一個位置上的目標隨從陷入沉睡。它會失能直到受到傷害為止。

Stormy Seas.rulesTextEng: Submerge all minions and artifacts occupying target water site.
Stormy Seas.rulesTextZh: 使目標水域上的所有隨從與遺物潛入水下。

Twist of Fate.rulesTextEng: Exchange life totals with target opponent. (X) is the difference between your life totals.
Twist of Fate.rulesTextZh: 與目標對手交換生命值。(X) 等於你們生命值之間的差值。

Upwelling.rulesTextEng: Target a nearby site. Return each artifact and minion there to its owner's hand.
Upwelling.rulesTextZh: 選擇一個附近的地點。將該處所有遺物與隨從返回其擁有者手中。

Wrath of the Sea.rulesTextEng: Flood all sites adjacent to a body of water this turn. Then submerge all minions and artifacts on water.
Wrath of the Sea.rulesTextZh: 本回合，使所有與一片水體相鄰的地點淹沒。然後使所有位於水域上的隨從與遺物潛入水下。

Abundance.rulesTextEng: Each affected site provides one additional mana.
Abundance.rulesTextZh: 每個受影響的地點額外提供 1 點法力。

Atlantean Fate.rulesTextEng:
Affected non-Ordinary sites are flooded. They are water sites, only provide Water threshold, and lose all other abilities.
Genesis → Submerge all minions and artifacts atop affected sites.
Atlantean Fate.rulesTextZh:
受影響的非普通地點被淹沒。它們成為水域，只提供水元素門檻，並失去所有其他能力。
降臨 → 使受影響地點地表上的所有隨從與遺物潛入水下。

Blizzard.rulesTextEng:
Affected sites and units atop them can't be attacked or intercepted.
At the start of your turn, dispel Blizzard.
Blizzard.rulesTextZh:
受影響的地點及其地表上的單位不能成為攻擊或攔截的對象。
在你的回合開始時，驅散暴風雪。

Flood.rulesTextEng: Affected sites are flooded. They're water sites.
Flood.rulesTextZh: 受影響的地點被淹沒。它們成為水域。

Mariner's Curse.rulesTextEng: Whenever a minion enters an affected water site, submerge it and return Mariner's Curse to its owner's hand.
Mariner's Curse.rulesTextZh: 每當一個隨從進入受影響的水域時，使其潛入水下，然後將水手的詛咒返回其擁有者手中。

Silence.rulesTextEng: UPDATED: Minions occupying affected sites are silenced.
Silence.rulesTextZh: 位於受影響地點上的隨從被沉默。

Wall of Ice.rulesTextEng:
Conjure atop the border of a site you control.
Units can't traverse Wall of Ice on the ground.
Wall of Ice.rulesTextZh:
創造於你操控地點的邊界上。
單位不能從地面穿越冰牆。

All-terrain Vestments.rulesTextEng: Bearer has Burrowing, Submerge, and Voidwalk, if it's a minion.
All-terrain Vestments.rulesTextZh: 若佩帶者是隨從，則其具有潛地、潛水與虛空行走。

Amethyst Core.rulesTextEng: Provides (A) and ① to its controller.
Amethyst Core.rulesTextZh: 為其操控者提供 (A) 與 ①。

Angel's Egg.rulesTextEng: At the end of each turn, the controller of Angel's Egg's site heals 1 life.
Angel's Egg.rulesTextZh: 每回合結束時，天使之卵所在地點的操控者恢復 1 點生命。

Aquamarine Core.rulesTextEng: Provides (W) and ① to its controller.
Aquamarine Core.rulesTextZh: 為其操控者提供 (W) 與 ①。

Battering Ram.rulesTextEng: Units here have “Tap → Destroy target adjacent Wall or Monument.”
Battering Ram.rulesTextZh: 此處的單位具有「橫置 → 摧毀目標相鄰的城牆或紀念碑。」

Belfry.rulesTextEng: At the end of your turn, untap all nearby allies.
Belfry.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合結束時，重置所有附近的友軍。

Black Obelisk.rulesTextEng: Black Obelisk's site has “At the start of your turn, lose 2 life and gain ② this turn.”
Black Obelisk.rulesTextZh: 黑曜方尖碑所在的地點具有「在你的回合開始時，失去 2 點生命。本回合獲得 ②。」

Blasted Oak.rulesTextEng: If a spell or non-basic ability can target—in order of precedence—Blasted Oak, its site or location, or anything else at its site or location, it must.
Blasted Oak.rulesTextZh: 若一個法術或非基礎能力可以選擇目標，則必須依下列優先順序指定目標：焦痕橡樹、其所在地點或位置，或該地點／位置上的其他任何物件。

Buried Treasure.rulesTextEng:
If cast, conjure this under an allied land site of an opponent's choice.
When Buried Treasure is carried to the surface, its controller sacrifices it and draws two cards.
Buried Treasure.rulesTextZh:
若以施放方式使用，則由對手選擇一個你的友方陸地地點，將此牌創造於其地下。
當埋藏的寶藏被帶到地表時，其操控者犧牲它並抽兩張牌。

Chains of Prometheus.rulesTextEng: Whenever a player draws a card, that player taps their strongest untapped minion.
Chains of Prometheus.rulesTextZh: 每當一位玩家抽一張牌時，該玩家將其力量最高且未橫置的隨從橫置。

Crave Golem.rulesTextEng: At the start of each player's turn, Crave Golem attacks a random minion within its range of motion, or takes a step toward the closest minion if it can't.
Crave Golem.rulesTextZh: 在每位玩家的回合開始時，渴求魔像攻擊其行動範圍內的一個隨機隨從；若無法如此，則朝最近的隨從邁出一步。

Crown of the Victor.rulesTextEng: Bearer has +3 power if they've ever killed a minion.
Crown of the Victor.rulesTextZh: 若佩帶者曾經消滅過一個隨從，則其獲得 +3 力量。

Devil's Egg.rulesTextEng: At the end of each turn, the controller of Devil's Egg's site loses 1 life.
Devil's Egg.rulesTextZh: 每回合結束時，惡魔之卵所在地點的操控者失去 1 點生命。

Doomsday Device.rulesTextEng:
Doomsday Device enters the realm with 6 counters. At the end of each player’s turn, remove a counter. When the last is removed, it detonates!
Deals damage to each unit at affected locations:
Doomsday Device.rulesTextZh:
末日裝置進入疆域時帶有 6 個指示物。每位玩家的回合結束時，移除一個指示物。當最後一個指示物被移除時，它便會爆炸！
對受影響位置上的每個單位造成傷害：

Drums of Doom.rulesTextEng: Damage dealt to minions nearby is lethal.
Drums of Doom.rulesTextZh: 對附近隨從造成的傷害皆視為致命傷害。

Erik's Curiosa.rulesTextEng: Rip Erik's Curiosa to pieces → Draw a card from your collection.
Erik's Curiosa.rulesTextZh: 將艾瑞克的珍奇收藏撕成碎片 → 從你的收藏中抽一張牌。

Flaming Sword.rulesTextEng: Bearer has +1 power, and its strikes splash full damage to each other enemy at a struck unit's location.
Flaming Sword.rulesTextZh: 佩帶者獲得 +1 力量，且其攻擊會對被擊中單位所在位置的每個其他敵軍造成等同於原本攻擊的全部傷害。

Gilded Aegis.rulesTextEng: If bearer is a minion and would die, instead fully heal it and banish Gilded Aegis.
Gilded Aegis.rulesTextZh: 若佩帶者為隨從且將被消滅，則改為將其完全恢復生命，並放逐鍍金神盾。

Iron Shackles.rulesTextEng:
May be conjured to target enemy minion.
Bearer is disabled.
Iron Shackles.rulesTextZh:
可以創造到目標敵方隨從上。
佩帶者失能。

Kythera Mechanism.rulesTextEng: Bearer's controller determines all random outcomes.
Kythera Mechanism.rulesTextZh: 佩帶者的操控者決定所有隨機結果。

Land Deed.rulesTextZh: 佩帶者具有「你操控此地點。」

Lucky Charm.rulesTextEng: Bearer's controller has “Whenever you would determine an outcome at random, determine it an extra time and choose one.”
Lucky Charm.rulesTextZh: 佩帶者的操控者具有「每當你將決定一個隨機結果時，額外決定一次，然後選擇其中一個結果。」

Maddening Bells.rulesTextEng: Spells cast by a nearby Spellcaster cost ② more to cast.
Maddening Bells.rulesTextZh: 附近施法者施放的法術，其施放成本增加 ②。

Magellan Globe.rulesTextEng: Opposite edges of the realm are connected.
Magellan Globe.rulesTextZh: 疆域相對的邊界彼此相連。

Magnetic Muzzle.rulesTextEng:
UPDATED: Bearer is silenced and can't drop Magnetic Muzzle.
At the end of each player’s turn, if Magnetic Muzzle is abandoned, that player attaches it to a nearby minion.
Magnetic Muzzle.rulesTextZh:
佩帶者被沉默，且不能丟下磁力口罩。
每位玩家的回合結束時，若磁力口罩處於無人攜帶狀態，該玩家將它裝備到附近一個隨從上。

Mask of Mayhem.rulesTextEng:
UPDATED: Whenever a nearby minion can attack, it must.
Nearby strikes against units deal double damage.
Mask of Mayhem.rulesTextZh:
每當附近一個隨從可以攻擊時，它必須攻擊。
附近對單位的攻擊造成雙倍傷害。

Mix Aer.rulesTextEng: Sacrifice Mix Aer → This turn, bearer's next Air spell requires no threshold and costs ③ less to cast.
Mix Aer.rulesTextZh: 犧牲風元素混合劑 → 本回合，佩帶者下一個風元素法術無需元素門檻，且施放成本減少 ③。

Mix Aqua.rulesTextEng: Sacrifice Mix Aqua → This turn, bearer's next Water spell requires no threshold and costs ③ less to cast.
Mix Aqua.rulesTextZh: 犧牲水元素混合劑 → 本回合，佩帶者下一個水元素法術無需元素門檻，且施放成本減少 ③。

Mix Ignis.rulesTextEng: Sacrifice Mix Ignis → This turn, bearer's next Fire spell requires no threshold and costs ③ less to cast.
Mix Ignis.rulesTextZh: 犧牲火元素混合劑 → 本回合，佩帶者下一個火元素法術無需元素門檻，且施放成本減少 ③。

Mix Terra.rulesTextEng: Sacrifice Mix Terra → This turn, bearer's next Earth spell requires no threshold and costs ③ less to cast.
Mix Terra.rulesTextZh: 犧牲土元素混合劑 → 本回合，佩帶者下一個土元素法術無需元素門檻，且施放成本減少 ③。

Onyx Core.rulesTextEng: Provides (E) and ① to its controller.
Onyx Core.rulesTextZh: 為其操控者提供 (E) 與 ①。

Orb of Ba'al Berith.rulesTextEng: The first time each turn a Magic spell is cast nearby, Orb of Ba'al Berith creates a copy. The spell's controller may choose new targets.
Orb of Ba'al Berith.rulesTextZh: 每回合第一次有魔法法術在附近施放時，巴爾‧貝利斯之球會創造一個該法術的複製品。該法術的操控者可以重新選擇目標。

Payload Trebuchet.rulesTextEng: Tap bearer and another ally here, Discard a card → Deal damage equal to the discarded card's mana cost to each unit at target location up to three steps away.
Payload Trebuchet.rulesTextZh: 橫置佩帶者與此處另一個友軍，棄一張牌 → 對至多距離三步內目標位置上的每個單位造成等同於所棄牌法力成本的傷害。

Pendulum of Peril.rulesTextEng: At the end of each player's turn, Pendulum of Peril kills all minions at its current location and another adjacent location of that player's choice.
Pendulum of Peril.rulesTextZh: 每位玩家的回合結束時，危厄擺錘消滅其目前所在位置以及由該玩家選擇的一個相鄰位置上的所有隨從。

Philosopher's Stone.rulesTextEng: The first spell of each element cast by the bearer each turn costs ① less.
Philosopher's Stone.rulesTextZh: 每回合，佩帶者施放的每種元素第一個法術，其施放成本減少 ①。

Pnakotic Manuscript.rulesTextEng: Bearer has “Tap → Reveal your topmost spell and draw it. Bearer takes damage equal to that card's cost.”
Pnakotic Manuscript.rulesTextZh: 佩帶者具有「橫置 → 展示你法術書頂的一張法術牌，然後將其抽到手中。佩帶者受到等同於該牌成本的傷害。」

Purge Juggernaut.rulesTextEng: UPDATED: At the start of your turn, Purge Juggernaut taps and moves to an adjacent location. Kill all other minions there.
Purge Juggernaut.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合開始時，淨化巨獸橫置並移動到一個相鄰位置。消滅該處所有其他隨從。

Rolling Boulder.rulesTextEng: Units here have “Tap → Give Rolling Boulder a push. It rolls as far as possible and deals 4 damage to each other unit along its path.”
Rolling Boulder.rulesTextZh: 此處的單位具有「橫置 → 推動滾石。它會盡可能一路滾動，並對路徑上的每個其他單位造成 4 點傷害。」

Ruby Core.rulesTextEng: Provides (F) and ① to its controller.
Ruby Core.rulesTextZh: 為其操控者提供 (F) 與 ①。

Scarecrow.rulesTextEng:
Genesis → Return each Airborne minion here to its owner’s hand.
Airborne minions can't enter this location.
Scarecrow.rulesTextZh:
降臨 → 將此處所有飛行隨從返回其擁有者手中。
飛行隨從不能進入此位置。

Screaming Skull.rulesTextEng: Whenever bearer attacks and kills an enemy, it untaps.
Screaming Skull.rulesTextZh: 每當佩帶者攻擊並消滅一個敵軍時，將其重置。

Siege Ballista.rulesTextEng: Tap bearer and another ally here → Deal 3 damage to target unit up to two steps away.
Siege Ballista.rulesTextZh: 橫置佩帶者與此處另一個友軍 → 對至多距離兩步內的目標單位造成 3 點傷害。

Spear of Destiny.rulesTextEng: Bearer has “Tap → Throw Spear of Destiny at any minion anywhere. It teleports to that minion’s location and kills it.”
Spear of Destiny.rulesTextZh: 佩帶者具有「橫置 → 將命運之槍擲向任意位置的一個隨從。命運之槍傳送至該隨從所在的位置並將其消滅。」

Sunken Treasure.rulesTextEng:
If cast, conjure this under an allied water site of an opponent's choice.
When Sunken Treasure is carried to the surface, its controller sacrifices it and draws two cards.
Sunken Treasure.rulesTextZh:
若以施放方式使用，則由對手選擇一個你的友方水域，將此牌創造於其水下。
當沉沒的寶藏被帶到地表時，其操控者犧牲它並抽兩張牌。

The Immortal Throne.rulesTextEng:
Whenever anyone plays a card with cost equal to the number of level counters on The Immortal Throne, they draw a card and add a level counter.
At level 8 or more, an Avatar here alone wins the game.
The Immortal Throne.rulesTextZh:
每當任何玩家打出一張其成本等於「不朽王座」上等級指示物數量的卡牌時，該玩家抽一張牌，然後在「不朽王座」上放置一個等級指示物。
當等級達到8級或以上時，若此處僅有一位化身，該化身的操控者贏得遊戲。

Torshammar Trinket.rulesTextEng: UPDATED: Bearer has +1 power. After each turn, return this to its owner’s hand.
Torshammar Trinket.rulesTextZh:
持有者獲得+1力量。
每回合結束後，將此牌返回其擁有者手上。

Truesight Crossbow.rulesTextEng: UPDATED: Bearer has Ranged and can see stealthed enemies.
Truesight Crossbow.rulesTextZh: 持有者具有遠程，且能看見具有潛行的敵方單位。

Undertaker Engine.rulesTextEng: At the end of your turn, you may burrow and/or unburrow any combination of artifacts and minions at this site.
Undertaker Engine.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合結束時，你可以讓此地點任意數量的遺物與隨從潛地、離開潛地，或兩者任意組合。

Wings of Invention.rulesTextEng: Bearer has Airborne and Movement +1, if it's a minion.
Wings of Invention.rulesTextZh: 若持有者是隨從，則其具有飛行，且移動力+1。

Cloud City.rulesTextEng: (A)(A)(A) — Once on your turn, this site may fly to a nearby void.
Cloud City.rulesTextZh: (A)(A)(A) — 每回合一次，此地點可以飛行至附近的一個虛空。

Dark Tower.rulesTextEng: Genesis → If this is the only Dark Tower you control, gain ① this turn.
Dark Tower.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 若這是你操控的唯一一座「黑暗高塔」，本回合獲得①。

Gothic Tower.rulesTextEng: Genesis → If this is the only Gothic Tower you control, gain ① this turn.
Gothic Tower.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 若這是你操控的唯一一座「哥德高塔」，本回合獲得①。

Lone Tower.rulesTextEng: Genesis → If this is the only Lone Tower you control, gain ① this turn.
Lone Tower.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 若這是你操控的唯一一座「孤塔」，本回合獲得①。

Mountain Pass.rulesTextEng: Minions can't enter this site on the ground if there's already a minion atop.
Mountain Pass.rulesTextZh: 若此地點地表已有隨從，其他隨從不能從地面進入此地點。

Observatory.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Look at your next three spells. Put them back in any order.
Observatory.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 查看你法術書頂端接下來三張法術牌，然後以任意順序放回。

Updraft Ridge.rulesTextEng: UPDATED: Airborne minions atop Updraft Ridge move freely away.
Updraft Ridge.rulesTextZh: 位於「上升氣流山脊」地表的飛行隨從，可以自由移動離開此地點。

Watchtower.rulesTextEng: Enemy units atop nearby sites permanently lose Stealth.
Watchtower.rulesTextZh: 位於附近地點地表的敵方單位永久失去潛行。

Bedrock.rulesTextEng: Can't be moved, destroyed, or modified.
Bedrock.rulesTextZh: 不能被移動、摧毀或修改。

Gnome Hollows.rulesTextEng: Units with 3 or more power can’t enter this site.
Gnome Hollows.rulesTextZh: 力量3或以上的單位不能進入此地點。

Holy Ground.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Each nearby Avatar heals 3 life.
Holy Ground.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 每位附近的化身恢復3點生命。

Humble Village.rulesTextEng: Genesis → You may pay ① to summon a Foot Soldier token here.
Humble Village.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 你可以支付①，在此處召喚一個步兵衍生物。

Pillar of Zeiros.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Banish all dead minions, and you heal 1 life for each.
Pillar of Zeiros.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 放逐所有死亡的隨從，你每放逐一個便恢復1點生命。

Quagmire.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Until your next turn, units are Immobile while they occupy nearby sites.
Quagmire.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 直到你的下個回合開始前，位於附近地點的單位具有不可移動。

Rift Valley.rulesTextEng: You may pull apart a partial row or column to make a void in which to play this.
Rift Valley.rulesTextZh: 你可以將部分橫列或直行向外拉開，創造一個虛空，以便將此牌放置於其中。

Rustic Village.rulesTextEng: Genesis → You may pay ① to summon a Foot Soldier token here.
Rustic Village.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 你可以支付①，在此處召喚一個步兵衍生物。

Secret Tunnel.rulesTextEng: Burrowed allies can move as if this were adjacent to your other sites.
Secret Tunnel.rulesTextZh: 已潛地的友方單位移動時，可將此地點視為與你的其他地點相鄰。

Simple Village.rulesTextEng: Genesis → You may pay ① to summon a Foot Soldier token here.
Simple Village.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 你可以支付①，在此處召喚一個步兵衍生物。

Vantage Hills.rulesTextEng: Ranged units atop this site have +1 range.
Vantage Hills.rulesTextZh: 位於此地點地表的遠程單位，射程+1。

Arid Desert.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Deal 1 damage to each minion atop target nearby site.
Arid Desert.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 對目標附近地點地表上的每個隨從造成1點傷害。

Dwarven Forge.rulesTextEng: Anyone may conjure Weapons and Armor here, and for ① less.
Dwarven Forge.rulesTextZh: 任何玩家都可以在此處施放武器與護甲，且其成本減少①。

Mirage.rulesTextEng: When played, you may return a site in play you own to your hand to play this site in its place.
Mirage.rulesTextZh: 當此牌打出時，你可以將一個由你擁有且已在場上的地點返回手牌，並將此地點放置在其原本的位置。

Red Desert.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Deal 1 damage to each minion atop target nearby site.
Red Desert.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 對目標附近地點地表上的每個隨從造成1點傷害。

Remote Desert.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Deal 1 damage to each minion atop target nearby site.
Remote Desert.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 對目標附近地點地表上的每個隨從造成1點傷害。

Shifting Sands.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Reactivate the Genesis abilities of your nearby Deserts.
Shifting Sands.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 重新觸發你附近所有沙漠的降臨能力。

Smokestacks of Gnaak.rulesTextEng: Other nearby sites lose their abilities.
Smokestacks of Gnaak.rulesTextZh: 其他附近的地點被沉默。

Vesuvius.rulesTextEng: (F)(F)(F) — Sacrifice Vesuvius → Each unit occupying nearby sites takes 3 damage.
Vesuvius.rulesTextZh: (F)(F)(F) — 犧牲「維蘇威火山」→ 位於附近地點的每個單位受到3點傷害。

Autumn River.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Look at your next spell. You may put it on the bottom of your spellbook.
Autumn River.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 查看你法術書頂端的下一張法術牌。你可以將它置於法術書底。

Floodplain.rulesTextEng: Once on your turn, you may flood an adjacent site this turn.
Floodplain.rulesTextZh: 每回合一次，你可以於本回合使一個相鄰地點淹沒。

Iceberg.rulesTextEng: Minions occupying nearby sites can't submerge or surface.
Iceberg.rulesTextZh: 位於附近地點的隨從不能潛水或浮出水面。

Island Leviathan.rulesTextEng: (W)(W)(W)(W)(W)(W)(W)(W) — May transform into a Monster. Place flooded Rubble underneath.
Island Leviathan.rulesTextZh: (W)(W)(W)(W)(W)(W)(W)(W) — 可以變形為一隻怪物。在其下方放置一張已淹沒的瓦礫。

Maelström.rulesTextEng: At the start of your turn, you may pull in each minion in this body of water one step.
Maelström.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合開始時，你可以將此水域中的每個隨從朝中心拉近一步。

Spring River.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Look at your next spell. You may put it on the bottom of your spellbook.
Spring River.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 查看你法術書頂端的下一張法術牌。你可以將它置於法術書底。

Summer River.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Look at your next spell. You may put it on the bottom of your spellbook.
Summer River.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 查看你法術書頂端的下一張法術牌。你可以將它置於法術書底。

Tadpole Pool.rulesTextEng: (W)(W)(W) — Genesis → Summon three submerged Frog tokens here.
Tadpole Pool.rulesTextZh: (W)(W)(W) — 降臨 → 在此處召喚三個處於潛水狀態的青蛙衍生物。

Undertow.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Staying within this body of water, move target unit one step.
Undertow.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 目標單位在保持位於此水域內的前提下，移動一步。

Pristine Paradise.rulesTextEng: Provides no mana or threshold unless completely empty.
Pristine Paradise.rulesTextZh: 除非此地點完全沒有任何卡牌，否則不提供法力或門檻。

The Colour Out of Space.rulesTextEng: Provides no mana or threshold if not adjacent to the void.
The Colour Out of Space.rulesTextZh: 若未與虛空相鄰，則不提供法力或門檻。

Astral Alcazar.rulesTextEng: Units can move between this site and any void as if they were adjacent.
Astral Alcazar.rulesTextZh: 單位可以在此地點與任意虛空之間移動，視同彼此相鄰。

Battlefield.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Conjure a broken Weapon or Armor here.
Battlefield.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 在此處施放一件已損壞的武器或護甲。

Boneyard.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Each player may summon a minion from their cemetery here.
Boneyard.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 每位玩家都可以從自己的墳墓場在此處召喚一個隨從。

Bottomless Pit.rulesTextEng: Whenever a non-Airborne minion enters this site, kill it.
Bottomless Pit.rulesTextZh: 每當一個不具有飛行的隨從進入此地點時，將其殺死。

Cornerstone.rulesTextEng: You may play this site to any corner.
Cornerstone.rulesTextZh: 你可以將此地點放置於任意角落。

Crossroads.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Look at your next four sites. Put three on the bottom of your atlas.
Crossroads.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 查看你地誌頂端接下來四張地點牌，將其中三張以任意順序置於地誌底。

Dome of Osiros.rulesTextEng: This site and minions here can't be attacked.
Dome of Osiros.rulesTextZh: 此地點及位於此處的隨從不能成為攻擊目標。

Donnybrook Inn.rulesTextEng: Anyone may cast minions here and they may do so for ① less.
Donnybrook Inn.rulesTextZh: 任何玩家都可以在此處施放隨從，且其成本減少①。

Edge of the World.rulesTextEng: Must always be adjacent to the void.

Free City.rulesTextEng: Once per turn, may attack or defend against enemy units here.
Free City.rulesTextZh: 每回合一次，可以攻擊或防禦此處的敵方單位。

Great Wall.rulesTextEng: Enemy units can’t move through this site’s top border on the ground.
Great Wall.rulesTextZh: 敵方單位不能從地面穿越此地點的上方邊界。

Imperial Road.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Target opponent, then you, may play a site adjacent to this one.
Imperial Road.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 目標對手先，然後你，可以各自放置一個與此地點相鄰的地點。

Mirror Realm.rulesTextEng: This site enters the realm as a copy of another nearby site.
Mirror Realm.rulesTextZh: 此地點進入場域時，作為另一個附近地點的複製品。

Mudflow.rulesTextEng: At the start of your turn, surface or unburrow each minion occupying target site nearby.
Mudflow.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合開始時，使位於目標附近地點的每個隨從浮出水面或離開潛地。

Planar Gate.rulesTextEng: Minions here can traverse the void, gaining Voidwalk until leaving it.
Planar Gate.rulesTextZh: 此處的隨從可以穿越虛空，並在離開虛空前獲得虛空行走。

Primordial Spring.rulesTextEng: Genesis → If you control fewer sites than any opponent, draw three sites.
Primordial Spring.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 若你操控的地點數量少於任一位對手，則抽三張地點牌。

Roots of Yggdrasil.rulesTextEng: When the Roots of Yggdrasil are destroyed, destroy everything.
Roots of Yggdrasil.rulesTextZh: 當「世界樹之根」被摧毀時，摧毀所有東西。

Sinkhole.rulesTextEng: Sacrifice Sinkhole → Destroy a nearby site.
Sinkhole.rulesTextZh: 犧牲「天坑」→ 摧毀一個附近的地點。

Standing Stones.rulesTextZh: 此處的隨從皆為施法者。

The Geistwood.rulesTextEng: Genesis abilities here are also Deathrite abilities.
The Geistwood.rulesTextZh: 此處的降臨能力同時也是死亡儀式能力。

Vaults of Zul.rulesTextEng: The first time an Avatar stops here, they draw three cards and skip their next turn.
Vaults of Zul.rulesTextZh: 當有化身第一次停留於此處時，該玩家抽三張牌，並跳過其下一個回合。

Avatar of Air.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play or draw a site.
Once on your turn, if you occupy an Air site, you may fly a unit atop it to a nearby site.
Avatar of Air.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 放置一個地點或抽一張地點牌。
每回合一次，若你位於一個風地點，你可以使其地表上的一個單位飛行至一個附近地點。

Avatar of Earth.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play or draw a site.
You have +1 power for each nearby earth site.
Avatar of Earth.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 放置一個地點或抽一張地點牌。
你每有一個附近的土地點，便獲得+1力量。

Avatar of Fire.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play or draw a site.
Tap → This turn, fire sites in your hand are also Fireballs.
Avatar of Fire.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 放置一個地點或抽一張地點牌。
橫置 → 本回合，你手中的火地點同時視為火球。

Avatar of Water.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play or draw a site.
Tap → Flood a site adjacent to your body of water until you do so again. You may teleport there.
Avatar of Water.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 放置一個地點或抽一張地點牌。
橫置 → 將一個與你的水域相鄰的地點淹沒，直到你再次如此做為止。你可以傳送至該地點。

Battlemage.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play or draw a site.
Whenever Battlemage attacks and kills an enemy, you may draw a spell.
Battlemage.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 放置一個地點或抽一張地點牌。
每當戰鬥法師攻擊並殺死一個敵方單位時，你可以抽一張法術牌。

Deathspeaker.rulesTextEng:
UPDATED: Tap → Play or draw a site.
You may banish a dead minion each turn to cast a copy of it, and for (0) if you’re on Death’s Door. The copy enters the realm, uses its Genesis, then is banished.
Deathspeaker.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 放置一個地點或抽一張地點牌。
每回合一次，你可以放逐一個死亡的隨從，以施放其複製品。若你處於瀕死狀態，則改為支付(0)。該複製品進入場域後，觸發其降臨能力，然後被放逐。

Elementalist.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play or draw a site.
You have an additional (E)(F)(W)(A).
Elementalist.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 放置一個地點或抽一張地點牌。
你額外擁有(E)(F)(W)(A)。

Enchantress.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play or draw a site.
Whenever you cast a spell, you may animate target aura until your next turn. It’s an aura minion with power equal to its cost.
Enchantress.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 放置一個地點或抽一張地點牌。
每當你施放一張法術牌時，你可以使目標靈氣活化直到你的下個回合。它視為一個靈氣隨從，其力量等於其成本。

Pathfinder.rulesTextEng:
Your atlas can’t contain duplicates. Draw no sites during setup.
Tap → If able, play the topmost site of your atlas to an adjacent location and move there.
Pathfinder.rulesTextZh:
你的地誌不能包含同名地點。設置期間不抽任何地點牌。
橫置 → 若可以，將你地誌頂端的地點放置到一個相鄰位置，然後移動至該處。

Seer.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play or draw a site.
At the start of your turn, look at your topmost site or spell. You may put it on the bottom of its deck.
Seer.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 放置一個地點或抽一張地點牌。
在你的回合開始時，查看你地誌頂端的一張地點牌或法術書頂端的一張法術牌。你可以將其置於對應牌庫底。

Sorcerer.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play or draw a site.
Tap → Draw a spell.
Sorcerer.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 放置一個地點或抽一張地點牌。
橫置 → 抽一張法術牌。

Relentless Crowd.rulesTextEng:
Your spellbook may include any number of Relentless Crowds.
Has +1 power for each other Relentless Crowd nearby.
Relentless Crowd.rulesTextZh:
你的法術書可以包含任意數量的「無盡人潮」。
附近每有另一個「無盡人潮」，此牌便獲得+1力量。

Winter River.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Look at your next spell. You may put it on the bottom of your spellbook.
Winter River.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 查看你法術書頂端的下一張法術牌。你可以將它置於法術書底。

Sparkmage.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play or draw a site.
Tap → Target nearby location. Deal damage to another random unit there equal to the sum of (A) on spells you've cast this turn.
Sparkmage.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 放置一個地點或抽一張地點牌。
橫置 → 選擇一個附近的位置。對該處另一個隨機單位造成傷害，傷害值等於你本回合已施放法術上的(A)總和。

Geomancer.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play or draw a site. If you played an earth site, fill a void adjacent to you with Rubble.
Tap → Replace an adjacent Rubble with the topmost site of your atlas.
Geomancer.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 放置一個地點或抽一張地點牌。若你放置的是土地點，則以一張瓦礫填滿一個與你相鄰的虛空。
橫置 → 將一個相鄰的瓦礫替換為你地誌頂端的地點。

Flamecaller.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play or draw a site.
Tap, Banish all your dead fire minions → Shoot a projectile. It deals damage equal to to the sum of their (F).
Flamecaller.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 放置一個地點或抽一張地點牌。
橫置，放逐你所有死亡的火焰隨從 → 發射一枚投射物。它造成的傷害等於那些隨從(F)的總和。

Waveshaper.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play or draw a site.
Tap → Flood a site near your body of water until you do so again. Tap minions without submerge there. They don't untap the next time they would.
Waveshaper.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 放置一個地點或抽一張地點牌。
橫置 → 將一個靠近你的水域的地點淹沒，直到你再次如此做為止。橫置該處所有不具有潛水的隨從。它們下一次本應重置時，不會重置。

Spellslinger.rulesTextEng:
Start the game with 4 spells in hand.
Tap → Play or draw a site.
Spellslinger.rulesTextZh:
遊戲開始時，手牌中有4張法術牌。
橫置 → 放置一個地點或抽一張地點牌。

13 Treasures of Britain.rulesTextEng: When picked up, bearer's controller draws a card. Teleport the Treasures to the top of a random site or void.
13 Treasures of Britain.rulesTextZh: 當此牌被拾起時，持有者的操控者抽一張牌。將「不列顛十三聖寶」傳送至一個隨機地點或虛空的地表。

A Midsummer Night's Dream.rulesTextEng: Mortals here are disabled and each give +1 power to all Faeries here. Dispel if there are no Faeries here.
A Midsummer Night's Dream.rulesTextZh: 此處的凡人皆失效，且每位凡人使此處所有妖精獲得+1力量。若此處沒有妖精，則驅散此牌。

Amulet of Niniane.rulesTextEng: Bearer can't be targeted or damaged by magic.
Amulet of Niniane.rulesTextZh: 持有者不能成為魔法的目標，也不會受到魔法傷害。

Arcane Barrage.rulesTextEng: Shoot X projectiles in the same direction, one at a time. Each deals 1 damage.
Arcane Barrage.rulesTextZh: 朝同一方向依序發射X枚投射物。每枚投射物造成1點傷害。

Archimago.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play or draw a site.
Banish three magic spells in your cemetery → Cast a copy of one of them.
Archimago.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 放置一個地點或抽一張地點牌。
放逐你墳墓場中的三張魔法牌 → 施放其中一張的複製品。

Arc Lightning.rulesTextEng: Deal 4 damage to target nearby unit.
Arc Lightning.rulesTextZh: 對目標附近單位造成4點傷害。

Attack by Night.rulesTextEng: Enemies drop their artifacts. Allied units strike first this turn.
Attack by Night.rulesTextZh: 敵方單位掉落其持有的遺物。本回合，友方單位先攻。

Avalon.rulesTextEng: Provides mana and threshold for everyone.
Avalon.rulesTextZh: 為所有玩家提供法力與門檻。

Babbling Brook.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Until your next turn, minions are disabled while atop nearby sites.
Babbling Brook.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 直到你的下個回合開始前，位於附近地點地表的隨從失效。

Bailey.rulesTextEng: Enemies can't move to here on the ground.
Bailey.rulesTextZh: 敵方單位不能從地面移動至此處。

Ball Lightning.rulesTextEng: Shoot a projectile. It deals 4 damage on impact, then changes direction. Its next impact deals 2, then it changes direction. Its final impact deals 1.
Ball Lightning.rulesTextZh: 發射一枚投射物。首次命中時造成4點傷害，然後改變方向；下一次命中時造成2點傷害，然後再次改變方向；最後一次命中時造成1點傷害。

Beacon.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Gain (1) for each nearby site with an enemy atop it.
Beacon.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 附近每有一個地表上有敵方單位的地點，便獲得(1)。

Black Knight.rulesTextEng: Costs (2) less to cast if you have more life than each opponent.
Black Knight.rulesTextZh: 若你的生命值高於每位對手，施放此牌的成本減少(2)。

Bluecap Knockers.rulesTextEng:
Burrowing
Bluecap Knockers’ site can't be moved, destroyed, or modified.
Bluecap Knockers.rulesTextZh:
潛地
「藍帽地精」所在的地點不能被移動、摧毀或修改。

Blunderbore.rulesTextEng: Allied Giants banish the minions they kill to permanently gain +1 power.
Blunderbore.rulesTextZh: 友方巨人將其殺死的隨從放逐，以永久獲得+1力量。

Bog.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Until your next turn, units are Immobile while atop target nearby site.
Bog.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 直到你的下個回合開始前，位於目標附近地點地表的單位具有不可移動。

Bonfire.rulesTextEng: Genesis → You may destroy all Weapons and Armor nearby.
Bonfire.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 你可以摧毀附近所有武器與護甲。

Boudicca.rulesTextEng: Other allies have +3 power while successfully attacking sites.
Boudicca.rulesTextZh: 其他友方單位在成功攻擊地點時獲得+3力量。

Bower of Bliss.rulesTextEng: Mortals in the realm become Beasts and are silenced.
Bower of Bliss.rulesTextZh: 場域中的凡人成為野獸，並失去所有能力。

Briar Patch.rulesTextEng: Whenever an enemy unit enters or leaves this site, it takes 1 damage.
Briar Patch.rulesTextZh: 每當一個敵方單位進入或離開此地點時，該單位受到1點傷害。

Brocéliande.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Untap nearby Faeries. Tap nearby Mortals. Give nearby Beasts Stealth.
Brocéliande.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 重置附近的妖精。橫置附近的凡人。使附近的野獸獲得潛行。

Brother Knight.rulesTextEng: Genesis → You may search your spellbook or hand for another Brother Knight and summon it here. Shuffle if needed.
Brother Knight.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 你可以從你的法術書或手牌中搜尋另一張「兄弟騎士」，並在此處召喚它。若搜尋了法術書，則將法術書洗牌。

Burning Hands.rulesTextEng: May be cast by an allied Mortal. Choose two different cardinal directions and deal damage to each unit at locations in the area of effect:
Burning Hands.rulesTextZh: 可以由一個友方凡人施放。選擇兩個不同的基本方向，並對效果範圍內所有位置上的每個單位造成傷害：

Caerleon-Upon-Usk.rulesTextEng: Only provides mana and threshold while in your back row.
Caerleon-Upon-Usk.rulesTextZh: 只有位於你的後排時，才提供法力與門檻。

Camelot.rulesTextEng: Unique minions cost (1) less to cast to nearby sites.
Camelot.rulesTextZh: 將獨特隨從施放到附近地點時，其施放成本減少(1)。

Cast into Exile.rulesTextEng: Shuffle target minion occupying an allied site into its owner's spellbook.
Cast into Exile.rulesTextZh: 將位於友方地點的目標隨從洗入其擁有者的法術書。

Castle Haunt.rulesTextEng:
May be cast to any Elite or Unique site.
Dies if it leaves its summoning site.
Castle Haunt.rulesTextZh:
可以施放到任意精英或獨特地點。
若離開其召喚地點，則死亡。

Castle's Ablaze!.rulesTextEng:
Conjure atop an Elite or Unique site.
At the start of your turn, destroy this site, minions atop it, and Castle's Ablaze.
Castle's Ablaze!.rulesTextZh:
施放於一個精英或獨特地點的地表。
在你的回合開始時，摧毀此地點、其地表上的所有隨從，以及「城堡失火了！」。

Charge.rulesTextEng: Give an ally Charge this turn.
Charge.rulesTextZh: 本回合，使一個友方單位獲得衝鋒。

Common Village.rulesTextEng: Genesis → You may pay (1) to summon a Foot Soldier token here.
Common Village.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 你可以支付(1)，在此處召喚一個步兵衍生物。

Coy Nixie.rulesTextEng:
Submerge
Once on your turn, Coy Nixie may force target nearby enemy to take a step towards her. Tap that enemy.
Coy Nixie.rulesTextZh:
潛水
每回合一次，羞怯水妖可以強制目標附近敵方單位朝她移動一步。橫置該單位。

Cursed Land.rulesTextEng: Whenever another site is played nearby, its controller loses 2 life.
Cursed Land.rulesTextZh: 每當另一個地點在附近被放置時，其操控者失去2點生命。

Dame Britomart.rulesTextEng:
Lance
If Dame Britomart would successfully attack an enemy site, she may summon a Mortal from your cemetery to her location instead.
Dame Britomart.rulesTextZh:
長槍
若布里托瑪特女士將成功攻擊一個敵方地點，則她可以改為從你的墳墓場召喚一個凡人到她所在的位置。

Degradation.rulesTextEng: Transform a Mortal into a Foot Soldier token.
Degradation.rulesTextZh: 將一個凡人變形為一個步兵衍生物。

Dozmary Pool.rulesTextEng: (W)(W)(W) – Genesis → You may submerge an artifact from your hand here.
Dozmary Pool.rulesTextZh: (W)(W)(W) — 降臨 → 你可以將手中的一件遺物以潛水狀態放置於此處。

Druid.rulesTextEng:
UPDATED: Tap → Play or draw a site.
Nearby allied sites have "Whenever an enemy enters here, it takes 1 damage."
Druid.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 放置一個地點或抽一張地點牌。
附近的友方地點具有「每當一個敵方單位進入此處時，該單位受到1點傷害。」

Duel.rulesTextEng: An ally fights target enemy adjacent to it.
Duel.rulesTextZh: 一個友方單位與一個與其相鄰的目標敵方單位戰鬥。

Excalibur.rulesTextEng: Bearer has +1 power for each of their elements. If they have all four, they are also immune to damage.
Excalibur.rulesTextZh: 持有者每擁有一種元素，便獲得+1力量。若持有者擁有四種元素，則同時免疫傷害。

Fae City.rulesTextEng: Tap an allied Faerie here → Shoot a projectile. It deals 1 damage.
Fae City.rulesTextZh: 橫置此處的一個友方妖精 → 發射一枚投射物。它造成1點傷害。

Feast for Crows.rulesTextEng: Name a spell. Search an opponent's hand, spellbook and cemetery for cards with that name, and banish them. They shuffle.
Feast for Crows.rulesTextZh: 宣告一張法術牌名稱。搜尋一位對手的手牌、法術書與墓地中所有與該名稱相同的牌，並將它們放逐。然後該玩家將其法術書洗牌。

Fields of Camlann.rulesTextEng: (F)(F)(F) – Genesis → Each player chooses one of their minions. Kill the rest.
Fields of Camlann.rulesTextZh: (F)(F)(F)－降臨 → 每位玩家各選擇自己的一個隨從，殺死其餘所有隨從。

Fine Courser.rulesTextEng:
Charge, Movement +1
May carry an ally.
Fine Courser.rulesTextZh:
衝鋒、移動力 +1。
可以載運一個友方單位。

Finwife.rulesTextEng:
Submerge
Provides (2) for each nearby enemy Avatar.
Finwife.rulesTextZh:
潛水
每有一個附近的敵方化身，便提供 (2)。

Firebreathing.rulesTextEng: May be cast by an allied Beast or Dragon. Choose a cardinal direction and deal damage to each unit at a location in the area of effect:
Firebreathing.rulesTextZh: 可由友方野獸或巨龍施放。選擇一個基本方向，對效果範圍內各位置上的每個單位造成傷害：

Forge.rulesTextEng: Genesis → You may pay (1) to conjure a Lance token here.
Forge.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 你可以支付 (1)，在此處創造一個長槍衍生物。

Fourberie Knot.rulesTextEng: Bearer minion takes no damage from units with 4 or more power, and is also a Faerie.
Fourberie Knot.rulesTextZh: 持有此牌的隨從不會受到力量 4 或以上單位造成的傷害，且同時視為妖精。

Four Waters of Paradise.rulesTextEng: Sacrifice Four Waters → This turn, bearer's next elemental spell requires no threshold and costs (4) less to cast.
Four Waters of Paradise.rulesTextZh: 犧牲樂園四河 → 本回合，持有者下一張元素法術不需要門檻，且施放成本減少 (4)。

Frisky Red Squirrel.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Take target nearby artifact that can be carried and hide it beneath this site.
Frisky Red Squirrel.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 選擇一個附近可被攜帶的遺物，將其藏到此地點牌下方。

Funeral Pyre.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Banish up to three cards from one cemetery.
Funeral Pyre.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 從一個墓地中放逐至多三張牌。

Giant Killer.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 殺死目標附近的巨人。

Glastonbury Tor.rulesTextEng: Only provides mana and threshold while in your back row.
Glastonbury Tor.rulesTextZh: 只有位於你的後排時，才會提供法力與門檻。

Golden Harp.rulesTextEng: Strike damage and life loss caused by nearby units is reduced to 2.
Golden Harp.rulesTextZh: 附近單位造成的打擊傷害與生命值流失均改為 2。

Goswhit Helmet.rulesTextEng: If bearer would take strike damage, prevent it and return this helmet to hand.
Goswhit Helmet.rulesTextZh: 若持有者將受到打擊傷害，改為防止該傷害，並將此頭盔返回手牌。

Grain Sparrow.rulesTextZh:
飛行
降臨 → 獲得 2 點生命。

Grand Old Boar.rulesTextEng: Has Charge if there are dead Squeakers.
Grand Old Boar.rulesTextZh: 若有已死亡的吱吱獸（Squeakers），則具有衝鋒。

Grievous Insult.rulesTextEng: May be cast by any ally. Silence target nearby minion this turn and tap it. Draw a spell.
Grievous Insult.rulesTextZh: 可由任意友方單位施放。本回合，使目標附近的隨從沉默並將其橫置。抽一張法術牌。

Grim Guisarme.rulesTextEng: UPDATED: Bearer takes and deals double strike damage against units.
Grim Guisarme.rulesTextZh: 持有者與單位交戰時，造成與受到的打擊傷害皆加倍。

Guards!.rulesTextEng: Summon a Foot Soldier token to each site near your Avatar.
Guards!.rulesTextZh: 在你的化身附近的每個地點各召喚一個步兵衍生物。

Hamlet.rulesTextEng: Ordinary minions cost (1) less to cast to this site.
Hamlet.rulesTextZh: 施放到此地點的普通隨從，其施放成本減少 (1)。

Hamlet's Ablaze!.rulesTextEng:
Conjure atop an Ordinary or Exceptional site.
At the start of your turn, destroy this site, minions atop it, and Hamlet's Ablaze.
Hamlet's Ablaze!.rulesTextZh:
創造於一個普通或卓越地點上。
在你的回合開始時，摧毀此地點、其上的所有隨從，以及《村莊陷入火海！》。

Harassing Ruffians.rulesTextEng: Units attacked by Harrassing Ruffians can't be defended.
Harassing Ruffians.rulesTextZh: 被地痞流氓攻擊的單位不能被防禦。

Helpful Hob.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 重置一個相鄰的友方單位。

Hunter's Lodge.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 敵方失去潛行。

Hunting Party.rulesTextZh:
遠程
附近的敵方失去潛行。

Hyter Sprites.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Name a spell. Spells with that name can’t be cast until your next turn.
Hyter Sprites.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 宣告一張法術牌名稱。直到你的下個回合開始前，名稱相同的法術不能被施放。

Impenetrable Copse.rulesTextEng: Projectiles can't enter this site from the outside.
Impenetrable Copse.rulesTextZh: 投射物不能從外部進入此地點。

Invasion.rulesTextEng:
At the end of your turn, summon a
Foot Soldier token to each affected enemy site with no units. Lasts 3 of your turns.
Invasion.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合結束時，在每個受此效果影響且沒有任何單位的敵方地點召喚一個步兵衍生物。持續三個你的回合。

Iron Man Talus.rulesTextEng: Can't be disabled or moved by force.
Iron Man Talus.rulesTextZh: 不能被失能，也不能被強制移動。

Joust!.rulesTextEng: An ally targets an enemy they’re adjacent to, then they both take a step to swap places. If they pass each other, they fight.
Joust!.rulesTextZh: 選擇一個與友方單位相鄰的敵方單位作為目標，然後兩者各邁出一步以交換位置。若兩者在移動過程中彼此交錯，則立即戰鬥。

Joyous Garde.rulesTextEng: Only provides mana and threshold while in your back row.
Joyous Garde.rulesTextZh: 只有位於你的後排時，才會提供法力與門檻。

Just a Rock.rulesTextEng: May be cast into the hands of any unit already carrying an artifact to banish that artifact.
Just a Rock.rulesTextZh: 可施放到任何已攜帶遺物的單位手中，放逐其攜帶的那件遺物。

Keening Banshee.rulesTextEng: May be cast for (0) if an allied Mortal died this turn.
Keening Banshee.rulesTextZh: 若本回合有友方凡人死亡，則可支付 (0) 施放。

Kelp Cavern.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Look at your bottom three spells. Put one on top of your spellbook.
Kelp Cavern.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 查看你的法術書底部三張法術牌。選擇其中一張放到法術書頂。

Kettletop Leprechaun.rulesTextZh: 死亡之際 → 抽一張地點牌。

King Arthur.rulesTextEng: Players can't control cards owned by other players.
King Arthur.rulesTextZh: 玩家不能控制其他玩家擁有的牌。

King's Council.rulesTextEng: Draw a card for each Unique ally.
King's Council.rulesTextZh: 每有一個獨特的友方單位，便抽一張牌。

Kingswood Poachers.rulesTextEng:
Stealth
Genesis → Search a spellbook for up to three Beasts, banish them, then shuffle.
Kingswood Poachers.rulesTextZh:
潛行
降臨 → 搜尋一個牌庫中的至多三張野獸牌，將它們放逐，然後將該法術書洗牌。

Knighthood.rulesTextEng: If you control an Ordinary Mortal, you may summon a Knight, Sir, or Dame from your hand to their location.
Knighthood.rulesTextZh: 若你控制一個普通凡人，你可以從手牌將一個騎士（Knight）、爵士（Sir）或女爵（Dame）召喚到其所在位置。

Lady Iseult.rulesTextEng: If another nearby allied minion would die, return it to hand.
Lady Iseult.rulesTextZh: 若另一個附近的友方隨從將會死亡，改為將其返回手牌。

Lava Flow.rulesTextEng: Lava flows from the caster's site in a cardinal direction. Deal damage to each other unit occupying a site in the area of effect:
Lava Flow.rulesTextZh: 熔岩自施法者所在的地點朝一個基本方向流動。對效果範圍內各地點上的其他單位造成傷害：

Led Astray.rulesTextEng: Choose any number of enemies at target location. They take a step together to another location they're adjacent to.
Led Astray.rulesTextZh: 選擇目標地點上的任意數量敵方單位。它們一起邁出一步，移動到與目前位置相鄰的另一個地點。

Leyline Henge.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Draw a spell for each other adjacent Leyline Henge.
Leyline Henge.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 每有一個其他相鄰的地脈巨石陣，便抽一張法術牌。

Lookout.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Look at each opponent's hand.
Lookout.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 查看每位對手的手牌。

Love Potion.rulesTextEng: Bearer has "Sacrifice Love Potion → Gain control of target enemy minion here until this unit leaves the realm."
Love Potion.rulesTextZh: 持有者具有「犧牲愛情魔藥 → 獲得此處目標敵方隨從的控制權，直到此單位離開場域。」

Lugbog Cat.rulesTextEng: Can and must be cast to any water site.
Lugbog Cat.rulesTextZh: 只能且必須施放到任意水域地點。

Magic Missiles.rulesTextEng: Shoot three projectiles in the same direction, one at a time. Each deals 1 damage.
Magic Missiles.rulesTextZh: 朝同一方向依序射出三枚投射物，每枚各造成 1 點傷害。

Major City.rulesTextEng: Elite minions cost (1) less to cast to this site.
Major City.rulesTextZh: 施放到此地點的菁英隨從，其施放成本減少 (1)。

Merlin.rulesTextEng:
Spellcaster
Any time during your turn, Merlin may look at your next spell and may cast it if it's a magic spell.
Merlin.rulesTextZh:
施法者
在你的回合中任何時候，梅林可以查看你的下一張法術牌；若該牌是魔法，則可以施放它。

Merlin's Staff.rulesTextEng: Bearer has Spellcaster and +1 power for each magic spell they've cast this turn while holding Merlin's Staff.
Merlin's Staff.rulesTextZh: 持有者具有施法者，且本回合持有梅林法杖期間，每施放一張魔法便獲得 +1 力量。

Merlin's Tower.rulesTextEng: (A)(A)(A) – Genesis → This turn, gains Spellcaster and its next magic costs (3) less.
Merlin's Tower.rulesTextZh: (A)(A)(A)－降臨 → 本回合，獲得施法者，且下一張魔法的施放成本減少 (3)。

Mesmerism.rulesTextEng: Gain control of target nearby minion.
Mesmerism.rulesTextZh: 獲得目標附近隨從的控制權。

Mester Stoor Worm.rulesTextEng:
Submerge, Waterbound
Tap → Choose a direction from Mester Stoor Worm. Deal Lethal damage to each unit at a location in the area of effect:
Mester Stoor Worm.rulesTextZh:
潛水、水域束縛
橫置 → 選擇一個以巨龍斯托爾蟲為起點的方向。對效果範圍內各地點上的每個單位造成致命傷害：

Morgana le Fay.rulesTextEng:
Spellcaster, Stealth
Genesis → Morgana draws her own hand of three spells, which only she can cast.
Morgana le Fay.rulesTextZh:
施法者、潛行
降臨 → 摩根抽取專屬於她的三張法術牌作為手牌，且只有她能施放這些法術。

Nelly Longarms.rulesTextEng:
Submerge
Tap → Shoot a projectile. If it hits a unit, drag it here. Nelly may submerge it.
Nelly Longarms.rulesTextZh:
潛水
橫置 → 射出一枚投射物。若命中一個單位，將其拖到此處。奈莉可以使其潛入水下。

Ominous Owl.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
You may cast minions to this site.
Ominous Owl.rulesTextZh:
飛行
你可以將隨從施放到此地點。

Overbearing Bailiff.rulesTextEng: Has +7 power while in your back row and no royalty is nearby.
Overbearing Bailiff.rulesTextZh: 當其位於你的後排，且附近沒有王族時，具有 +7 力量。

Peasant Revolt.rulesTextEng: Destroy everything Unique or Elite in the realm.
Peasant Revolt.rulesTextZh: 摧毀場域中所有獨特或菁英的牌。

Pebbled Paths.rulesTextEng: Minions atop nearby sites lose Charge.
Pebbled Paths.rulesTextZh: 位於附近地點上的隨從失去衝鋒。

Pendragon Banner.rulesTextEng: Nearby allies have +1 power while there are no enemies here.
Pendragon Banner.rulesTextZh: 當此處沒有敵方單位時，附近的友方單位具有 +1 力量。

Pendragon Legacy.rulesTextEng: Shuffle any number of Unique cards from your cemetery into your decks. Draw a card.
Pendragon Legacy.rulesTextZh: 將你墓地中任意數量的獨特牌洗回你的牌庫。抽一張牌。

Perilous Bridge.rulesTextEng: Units can’t traverse this site’s top border on the ground.
Perilous Bridge.rulesTextZh: 單位不能在地面上穿越此地點的上方邊界。

Pigs of the Sounder.rulesTextEng: Deathrite → Reveal your next five spells, then summon all Grand Old Boars from among them to this site. Put the rest on the bottom in a random order.
Pigs of the Sounder.rulesTextZh: 死亡之際 → 展示你的接下來五張法術牌，然後將其中所有老野豬王召喚到此地點。其餘牌以隨機順序置於法術書底。

Poisoned Well.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Enemy Avatars lose 1 life for each nearby site they control.
Poisoned Well.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 每位敵方化身每控制一個附近的地點，便失去 1 點生命。

Pond.rulesTextEng: Genesis → This turn, the next Beast cast to this site costs (1) less, ignoring threshold.
Pond.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 本回合，下一個施放到此地點的野獸無視門檻，且施放成本減少 (1)。

Pookas.rulesTextEng: Deathrite → Each opponent discards a random card.
Pookas.rulesTextZh: 死亡之際 → 每位對手隨機棄一張牌。

Postern Gate.rulesTextEng: Enters the realm under an opponent's control.
Postern Gate.rulesTextZh: 此牌進入場域時，由一位對手控制。

Power of Flight.rulesTextEng: Give an allied minion Airborne until your next turn. Draw a spell.
Power of Flight.rulesTextZh: 直到你的下個回合開始前，賦予一個友方隨從飛行。抽一張法術牌。

Queen Guinevere.rulesTextEng: Once on your turn, Queen Guinevere may untap target allied minion.
Queen Guinevere.rulesTextZh: 每回合一次，在你的回合中，桂妮薇兒王后可以重置目標友方隨從。

Questing Beast.rulesTextEng:
Lethal, Stealth
At the end of your turn, Questing Beast may take a step.
Questing Beast.rulesTextZh:
致命、潛行
在你的回合結束時，尋獸可以邁出一步。

Rebecks.rulesTextZh: 附近的友方巨人具有衝鋒。

Redbreast Robin.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
At the end of your turn, each other unit here takes 1 damage.
Redbreast Robin.rulesTextZh:
飛行
在你的回合結束時，此處其他每個單位受到 1 點傷害。

Redcap Powries.rulesTextEng:
Charge
If Redcap Powries haven't attacked by the end of your turn, they die.
Redcap Powries.rulesTextZh:
衝鋒
若紅帽妖在你的回合結束前尚未攻擊，則其死亡。

Rescue.rulesTextEng: Return a minion from your cemetery to your hand.
Rescue.rulesTextZh: 將一張隨從牌從你的墓地返回手牌。

Rhitta Gawr of Snowdonia.nameZh: 斯諾登尼亞的瑞薩高爾
