Rhongomyniad.rulesTextEng: UPDATED: Bearer strikes first and has "Tap → Throw Rhongomyniad as a piercing projectile. Deal 3 damage to each hit unit."
Rhongomyniad.rulesTextZh: 持有者先攻，且具有「橫置 → 將倫戈米尼亞德擲出作為一枚穿刺投射物。對每個被命中的單位造成 3 點傷害。」

Ribble Boggart.rulesTextEng: At the start of your turn, Boggart gains a random mutation until the end of turn: Airborne, Ranged, Lethal, or +3 power.
Ribble Boggart.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合開始時，惡精隨機獲得一項變異直到回合結束：飛行、遠程、致命或 +3 力量。

Ring of Morrigan.rulesTextEng: Bearer has "Whenever this unit casts a spell, they may deal 1 damage to target nearby unit to have you gain 1 life."
Ring of Morrigan.rulesTextZh: 持有者具有「每當此單位施放一張法術時，你可以對目標附近單位造成 1 點傷害。若如此作，你獲得 1 點生命。」

Salmon of Knowledge.rulesTextEng:
Submerge, Waterbound
Other units at this site have "Tap → Roll a d20. On a 14+, banish Salmon of Knowledge and draw three spells."
Salmon of Knowledge.rulesTextZh:
潛水、水域束縛
此地點上的其他單位具有「橫置 → 擲一顆 d20。若結果為 14 以上，放逐智慧鮭魚並抽三張法術牌。」

Saracen Raiders.rulesTextEng:
Charge
May be cast to any site without enemies.
Saracen Raiders.rulesTextZh:
衝鋒
可施放到任何沒有敵方單位的地點。

Saracen Scout.rulesTextEng: May be cast to any site without enemies.
Saracen Scout.rulesTextZh: 可施放到任何沒有敵方單位的地點。

Seelie Court.rulesTextEng: At the start of your turn, players draw a spell for each Faerie in the realm.
Seelie Court.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合開始時，場域中的每位玩家，每有一個妖精，便抽一張法術牌。

Shameless Squire.rulesTextEng:
Lance
Genesis → Tap target nearby enemy. It drops everything it's carrying.
Shameless Squire.rulesTextZh:
長槍
降臨 → 橫置目標附近的敵方單位。該單位放下其攜帶的所有物品。

Shapeshift.rulesTextEng: An allied minion tries to transform. Look at your next five spells: you may choose a minion among them to be the new form. Put the rest on the bottom in a random order.
Shapeshift.rulesTextZh: 一個友方隨從嘗試變形。查看你的接下來五張法術牌，你可以選擇其中一張隨從牌作為其新形態。其餘牌以隨機順序置於法術書底。

Shatter Strike.rulesTextEng: An ally targets an enemy adjacent to them, destroying an artifact they're carrying and then striking them.
Shatter Strike.rulesTextZh: 選擇一個與友方單位相鄰的敵方單位作為目標，摧毀其攜帶的一件遺物，然後對其發動打擊。

Shellycoat.rulesTextZh:
潛水
受到的傷害減少 1。

Siege Giant.rulesTextEng: Once on your turn, Siege Giant may throw a weaker ally here through the air to a nearby location.
Siege Giant.rulesTextZh: 每回合一次，在你的回合中，攻城巨人可以將此處一個力量低於自己的友方單位拋向空中，移動到一個附近的位置。

Sir Agravaine.rulesTextEng:
Stealth, Movement +1
Whenever another ally attacks an enemy adjacent to Sir Agravaine, he strikes that enemy afterwards without losing Stealth.
Sir Agravaine.rulesTextZh:
潛行、移動力 +1
每當另一個友方單位攻擊與阿格拉文爵士相鄰的敵方單位時，他會在之後對該敵方單位發動打擊，且不會失去潛行。

Sir Balin.rulesTextEng:
Lance
Whenever Sir Balin strikes an Avatar, destroy that Avatar's site then burrow other minions and artifacts there.
Sir Balin.rulesTextZh:
長槍
每當巴林爵士打擊一位化身時，摧毀該化身所在的地點，然後將該處其他隨從與遺物埋入地下。

Sir Bedivere.rulesTextEng: If Sir Bedivere is carrying an artifact at the start of your turn, draw a card.
Sir Bedivere.rulesTextZh: 若在你的回合開始時，貝狄威爾爵士正攜帶一件遺物，則抽一張牌。

Sir Bors the Younger.rulesTextZh:
遠程 2
敵方單位失去潛行。

Sir Gaheris.rulesTextEng:
Lance
Untaps at the end of your turn.
Sir Gaheris.rulesTextZh:
長槍
在你的回合結束時重置。

Sir Galahad.rulesTextEng:
UPDATED: Sir Galahad's strike damage against units heals you.
Nearby allies take no damage from Demons, Spirits, and Undead.
Sir Galahad.rulesTextZh:
加拉哈德爵士對單位造成的打擊傷害會為你回復等量生命。
附近的友方單位不會受到惡魔、靈體與不死生物造成的傷害。

Sir Gareth.rulesTextEng: (A)(W) — Reveal from hand → Transform an allied Mortal into Sir Gareth.
Sir Gareth.rulesTextZh: (A)(W)－從手牌展示 → 將一個友方凡人變形為加雷斯爵士。

Sir Gawain.rulesTextEng: Sir Gawain takes damage for other adjacent allies. If he dies from damage taken this way, draw a card.
Sir Gawain.rulesTextZh: 高文爵士代替其他相鄰的友方單位承受傷害。若他因此受到的傷害而死亡，則抽一張牌。

Sir Ironside.rulesTextZh: 在敵方回合中具有 +3 力量。

Sir Kay.rulesTextEng: Whenever Sir Kay targets a weaker minion, he untaps.
Sir Kay.rulesTextZh: 每當凱爵士指定一個力量低於自己的隨從為目標時，便重置他。

Sir Lamorak.rulesTextZh: 死亡之際 → 對附近的每個敵方單位各發動一次打擊。

Sir Lancelot.rulesTextEng:
Lance
The first time Sir Lancelot fights each turn, untap him.
Sir Lancelot.rulesTextZh:
長槍
每回合蘭斯洛特爵士第一次戰鬥後，重置他。

Sir Mordred.rulesTextEng: Genesis & Deathrite → Kill target adjacent enemy minion.
Sir Mordred.rulesTextZh: 降臨與死亡之際 → 殺死目標相鄰的敵方隨從。

Sir Morien.rulesTextEng:
Genesis → Summon two Foot Soldier tokens here.
Enemy projectiles can't enter here.
Sir Morien.rulesTextZh:
降臨 → 在此處召喚兩個步兵衍生物。
敵方投射物不能進入此處。

Sir Pelleas.rulesTextEng:
Submerge
Moves freely between water locations.
Sir Pelleas.rulesTextZh:
潛水
可在水域位置之間自由移動。

Sir Pellinore.rulesTextEng:
Charge, Lance
Whenever Sir Pellinore kills the strongest enemy minion, draw a card.
Sir Pellinore.rulesTextZh:
衝鋒、長槍
每當佩里諾爾爵士殺死力量最高的敵方隨從時，抽一張牌。

Sir Perceval.rulesTextEng:
Genesis → An opponent chooses a site.
When Sir Perceval enters that site, draw a card, then reactivate his Genesis ability.
Sir Perceval.rulesTextZh:
降臨 → 一位對手選擇一個地點。
當帕西法爾爵士進入該地點時，抽一張牌，然後重新啟用他的降臨能力。

Sir Priamus.rulesTextEng:
Lance, Lethal
Nearby allies are immune to Lethal.
Sir Priamus.rulesTextZh:
長槍、致命
附近的友方單位免疫致命。

Sir Tom Thumb.rulesTextEng:
May be carried by any Beast.
Deathrite → Return to hand.
Sir Tom Thumb.rulesTextZh:
可被任何野獸攜帶。
死亡之際 → 返回手牌。

Sir Tristan.rulesTextEng: Once on your turn, Sir Tristan may tap target nearby enemy minion. That enemy doesn't untap the next time it would.
Sir Tristan.rulesTextZh: 每回合一次，在你的回合中，崔斯坦爵士可以橫置目標附近的敵方隨從。該隨從下一次將要重置時，改為不重置。

Sir Yvain.rulesTextEng:
Lance. Genesis → Choose an allied Beast.
Sir Yvain and his Beast companion have +2 power while adjacent to each other.
Sir Yvain.rulesTextZh:
長槍。降臨 → 選擇一個友方野獸。
當伊凡爵士與他的野獸夥伴彼此相鄰時，兩者具有 +2 力量。

Sisters of Avalon.rulesTextEng:
Spellcaster
Genesis → Discard a spell. Draw a spell.
Sisters of Avalon.rulesTextZh:
施法者
降臨 → 棄一張法術牌，然後抽一張法術牌。

Sly Fox.rulesTextEng: Gains Stealth at the end of your turn.
Sly Fox.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合結束時獲得潛行。

Snowball.rulesTextEng: Shoot a piercing projectile. It picks up all other units along its path and carries them with it. When it stops, units there take damage equal to the number of units in the snowball.
Snowball.rulesTextZh: 射出一枚穿刺投射物。它會捲起路徑上的所有其他單位並一同帶著前進。當它停止時，該處的單位受到等同於雪球內單位數量的傷害。

Spearmarshal.rulesTextEng: Once on your turn, Spearmarshal may acquire a Lance token.
Spearmarshal.rulesTextZh: 每回合一次，在你的回合中，長槍隊長可以獲得一個長槍衍生物。

Squeakers.rulesTextEng: Deathrite → Reveal your next five spells, then summon all Pigs of the Sounder from among them to this site. Put the rest on the bottom in a random order.
Squeakers.rulesTextZh: 死亡之際 → 展示你的接下來五張法術牌，然後將其中所有野豬群召喚到此地點。其餘牌以隨機順序置於法術書底。

Stone Rain.rulesTextEng: Target a site up to two steps away. Deal 1 damage to everything atop it, repeating for each site in your hand.
Stone Rain.rulesTextZh: 選擇一個距離至多兩步的地點。對其上的所有牌造成 1 點傷害，並且你手牌中每有一張地點牌，就重複此效果一次。

Sugarplum Pixies.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
At the end of your turn, untap another nearby ally.
Sugarplum Pixies.rulesTextZh:
飛行
在你的回合結束時，重置另一個附近的友方單位。

Swindler Troupe.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Give another nearby allied minion Stealth.
Swindler Troupe.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 賦予另一個附近的友方隨從潛行。

Sylvan Splendor.rulesTextEng: Whenever you cast a Beast or Faerie to an affected site, draw a spell. Dispel if an affected site is successfully attacked.
Sylvan Splendor.rulesTextZh: 每當你將一個野獸或妖精施放到受此效果影響的地點時，抽一張法術牌。若受此效果影響的地點遭到成功攻擊，則驅散此效果。

Tactical Move.rulesTextEng: One at a time, each ally takes up to two steps.
Tactical Move.rulesTextZh: 友方單位依序各自最多邁出兩步。

Tax Collector.rulesTextEng: Genesis → On your opponent's next turn, their spells cost (1) more.
Tax Collector.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 在對手的下個回合，其法術的施放成本增加 (1)。

Templar.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play or draw a site.
The first Knight, Sir, or Dame you cast each turn costs (1) less.
Templar.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 打出或抽一張地點牌。
你每回合施放的第一個騎士（Knight）、爵士（Sir）或女爵（Dame）成本減少 (1)。

Thankless Squire.rulesTextZh: 長槍、長槍、長槍、無法移動。

The Black Plague.rulesTextEng: At the end of your turn, the weakest minion occupying affected sites dies. If tied, choose one. Dispel if none die.
The Black Plague.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合結束時，位於受此效果影響地點上力量最低的隨從死亡。若有平手，由你選擇其中一個。若沒有隨從死亡，則驅散此效果。

The Faerie Queene.rulesTextEng:
Airborne, Spellcaster
Nearby allied Faeries take no damage from units with 4 or more power.
The Faerie Queene.rulesTextZh:
飛行、施法者
附近的友方妖精不會受到力量 4 或以上單位造成的傷害。

The Great Drowning of Men.rulesTextEng: At the start of your turn, destroy affected sites and flood the resulting Rubble. Submerge everything atop them and dispel The Great Drowning of Men.
The Great Drowning of Men.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合開始時，摧毀受此效果影響的地點，並使產生的瓦礫成為洪水。將其上的所有牌潛入水下，然後驅散《大洪水》。

The Great Famine.rulesTextEng: At the end of your turn, the strongest minion occupying affected sites dies. If tied, choose one. Dispel if none die.
The Great Famine.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合結束時，位於受此效果影響地點上力量最高的隨從死亡。若有平手，由你選擇其中一個。若沒有隨從死亡，則驅散此效果。

The Green Knight.rulesTextEng:
Whenever an enemy minion can attack The Green Knight, it must.
Deathrite → Strike target nearby enemy.
The Green Knight.rulesTextZh:
每當一個敵方隨從能夠攻擊綠騎士時，它必須攻擊。
死亡之際 → 對目標附近的敵方單位發動打擊。

The Lady of the Lake.rulesTextEng:
Spellcaster, Submerge
Genesis → You may summon a Mortal or artifact from your cemetery to Lady of the Lake's location. If you do, shuffle her into her owner's spellbook.
The Lady of the Lake.rulesTextZh:
施法者、潛水
降臨 → 你可以將墓地中的一張凡人或遺物牌召喚到湖中仙女所在的位置。若如此作，將她洗回其擁有者的法術書。

The Ninth Legion.rulesTextEng:
Voidwalk. Must be cast to a corner.
Deathrite → Return to hand.
The Ninth Legion.rulesTextZh:
虛空行走。必須施放到角落。
死亡之際 → 返回手牌。

The Round Table.rulesTextEng:
Must be cast to your back row.
Whenever you summon King Arthur, or a Knight, Sir, or Dame to The Round Table, draw a card.
The Round Table.rulesTextZh:
必須施放到你的後排。
每當你將亞瑟王，或一個騎士（Knight）、爵士（Sir）或女爵（Dame）召喚到圓桌時，抽一張牌。

The Wild Hunt.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
Other nearby Spirits and Faeries have Charge.
The Wild Hunt.rulesTextZh:
飛行
附近其他的靈體與妖精具有衝鋒。

Thieving Magpie.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
May pick up carried artifacts with cost (1) or less.
Thieving Magpie.rulesTextZh:
飛行
可以撿起成本為 (1) 或以下、由單位攜帶中的遺物。

Thundering Giant.rulesTextEng:
Charge
Once on your turn, Thundering Giant may teleport to another nearby location. Tap all other units there on arrival.
Thundering Giant.rulesTextZh:
衝鋒
每回合一次，在你的回合中，雷霆巨人可以傳送到另一個附近的位置。抵達時，橫置該處所有其他單位。

Tintagel.rulesTextEng: Only provides mana and threshold while in your back row.
Tintagel.rulesTextZh: 只有位於你的後排時，才會提供法力與門檻。

Tooth Faeries.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
At the start of your turn, tap target nearby enemy.
Tooth Faeries.rulesTextZh:
飛行
在你的回合開始時，橫置目標附近的敵方單位。

Tournament Grounds.rulesTextEng: Anyone may cast Knights, Sirs, or Dames to this site and may do so for no threshold.
Tournament Grounds.rulesTextZh: 任何玩家都可以將騎士（Knight）、爵士（Sir）或女爵（Dame）施放到此地點，且施放時無需門檻。

Town.rulesTextEng: Exceptional minions cost (1) less to cast to this site.
Town.rulesTextZh: 施放到此地點的卓越隨從，其施放成本減少 (1)。

Treetop Hideout.rulesTextEng: Genesis → You may give Stealth to a nearby allied minion.
Treetop Hideout.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 你可以賦予一個附近的友方隨從潛行。

Troll Bridge.rulesTextEng: The first time a lone enemy enters here each turn, strike it unless they discard a card.
Troll Bridge.rulesTextZh: 每回合第一次有一個單獨的敵方單位進入此處時，除非其操控者棄一張牌，否則對其發動打擊。

Unseelie Court.rulesTextEng: At the start of your turn, players discard a spell for each Faerie in the realm.
Unseelie Court.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合開始時，場域中的每位玩家，每有一個妖精，便棄一張法術牌。

Valley of Delight.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Choose one: (A), (E), (F), (W). This site provides that permanently.
Valley of Delight.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 選擇一項：(A)、(E)、(F) 或 (W)。此地點永久提供所選的元素。

Valor.rulesTextEng: May be cast when an ally defends a site or another unit. The ally gains +4 power this turn.
Valor.rulesTextZh: 可於一個友方單位防禦地點或另一個單位時施放。該友方單位本回合獲得 +4 力量。

Vanishment.rulesTextEng: Give all allied minions Stealth. Draw a spell.
Vanishment.rulesTextZh: 賦予所有友方隨從潛行。抽一張法術牌。

Varmint Warrens.rulesTextEng: Beasts here can't be targeted by enemies.
Varmint Warrens.rulesTextZh: 此處的野獸不能成為敵方效果或能力的目標。

Vengeful Heir.rulesTextEng: As an additional cost to cast this, you may banish a dead Knight, Sir, or Dame. If you do, Vengeful Heir is summoned as a copy of that minion.
Vengeful Heir.rulesTextZh: 作為施放此牌的額外成本，你可以放逐一個已死亡的騎士（Knight）、爵士（Sir）或女爵（Dame）。若如此作，復仇繼承人會以該隨從的複製品形式被召喚。

Vikings.rulesTextEng: Tap → Deal 2 damage to each unit at target adjacent location.
Vikings.rulesTextZh: 橫置 → 對目標相鄰位置上的每個單位造成 2 點傷害。

Vivien the Enchantress.rulesTextEng: UPDATED: Vivien has the other printed abilities of all Avatars and Spellcasters in the realm, wherever she is.
Vivien the Enchantress.rulesTextZh: 無論薇薇安位於何處，她具有場域中所有化身與施法者印刷於牌上的其他能力。

Wall of Brambles.rulesTextEng:
Conjure atop the border of an allied site.
Whenever an enemy traverses this wall
on the ground, it takes 2 damage.
Wall of Brambles.rulesTextZh:
創造於一個友方地點的邊界上。
每當一個敵方單位在地面上穿越此牆時，該單位受到 2 點傷害。

War Horse.rulesTextZh: 衝鋒，可以載運一個友方單位。

Wedding Hall.rulesTextEng: Provides no mana, but if Arthur and Guinevere start your turn here, you win.
Wedding Hall.rulesTextZh: 不提供法力，但若亞瑟王與桂妮薇兒在你的回合開始時都位於此處，你獲得勝利。

Whirlwind.rulesTextEng: Choose clockwise or counterclockwise. Each unit and artifact atop sites in a two-by-two area is pushed one step in that direction.
Whirlwind.rulesTextZh: 選擇順時針或逆時針。將一個 2×2 區域內各地點上的所有單位與遺物，皆朝該方向推動一步。

White Hart.rulesTextEng: Other minions and locations nearby can't be attacked.
White Hart.rulesTextZh: 附近其他隨從與位置不能成為攻擊目標。

White Knight.rulesTextEng: Costs (2) less to cast if you have less life than each opponent.
White Knight.rulesTextZh: 若你的生命值低於每位對手，則其施放成本減少 (2)。

Witch.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play or draw a site.
Tap → Curse target Avatar, choose one: Their spells cost (1) more to cast on their next turn, they lose 2 life, or they have -3 power until your next turn.
Witch.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 打出或抽一張地點牌。
橫置 → 詛咒目標化身，選擇一項：其下個回合施放法術的成本增加 (1)、失去 2 點生命，或直到你的下個回合前具有 -3 力量。

Wizard's Den.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Draw a spell. Discard a spell when this site is first attacked successfully.
Wizard's Den.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 抽一張法術牌。當此地點第一次被成功攻擊時，棄一張法術牌。

Wolpertinger.rulesTextEng: Has +1 power for each of your dead Beasts.
Wolpertinger.rulesTextZh: 你的每個已死亡野獸各使其獲得 +1 力量。

Wormelow Tump.rulesTextEng: (E)(E)(E) – Opponents can't affect cards in your cemetery.
Wormelow Tump.rulesTextZh: (E)(E)(E)－對手不能影響你墓地中的牌。

Year of the Blaze.rulesTextEng: At the start of your turn, destroy affected sites and everything here, including Year of the Blaze.
Year of the Blaze.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合開始時，摧毀受此效果影響的地點以及其上的所有牌，包括《烈焰之年》。

Dragonlord.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play or draw a site.
Before setup, set aside a Unique Dragon. Once on your turn, if you meet its threshold, you may pay (3) to gain its abilities this turn.
Dragonlord.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 打出或抽一張地點牌。
設置開始前，將一張獨特巨龍牌置於一旁。每回合一次，在你的回合中，若你符合其門檻，可以支付 (3)，直到回合結束前獲得其能力。

Kairos the Archivist.rulesTextEng:
Genesis → Archive the state of the realm.
Deathrite → Return all archived cards to their recorded state. Then banish Kairos.
Kairos the Archivist.rulesTextZh:
降臨 → 將場域狀態封存。
死亡之際 → 將所有已封存的牌恢復至封存時記錄的狀態，然後放逐凱洛斯。

Caelestis.rulesTextEng:
Airborne, Voidwalk
Tap → The next Dragon you cast to this location costs (0) this turn.
Caelestis.rulesTextZh:
飛行、虛空行走
橫置 → 本回合，你下一個施放到此位置的巨龍成本為 (0)。

Xeraphine Konrul.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
At the end of your turn, you may choose three of your dead minions. Banish two to return the remaining one to hand.
Xeraphine Konrul.rulesTextZh:
飛行
在你的回合結束時，你可以選擇三張已死亡的隨從牌。放逐其中兩張，將剩餘的一張返回手牌。

Draco Corvus.rulesTextEng:
Airborne, Stealth
Tap → Teleport to target tapped minion to burrow it.
Draco Corvus.rulesTextZh:
飛行、潛行
橫置 → 傳送到目標已橫置的隨從所在位置，並將其埋入地下。

Moonsong Talagelum.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
Counts as a Grey Wolves and has +1 power for each other Grey Wolves nearby.
Moonsong Talagelum.rulesTextZh:
飛行
視為一個灰狼（Grey Wolves），且附近每有一個其他灰狼，便具有 +1 力量。

Adtonitum.rulesTextEng:
Airborne, Movement +1
Whenever Adtonitum stops, she may deal 3 damage to another random unit there.
Adtonitum.rulesTextZh:
飛行、移動力 +1
每當阿德托尼圖姆停止移動時，她可以對該處另一個隨機單位造成 3 點傷害。

Talamh Dreig.rulesTextEng:
Can't be moved by force.
Has +1 power for each adjacent site.
Talamh Dreig.rulesTextZh:
不能被強制移動。
每有一個相鄰地點，便具有 +1 力量。

Ignis Rex.rulesTextEng:
Airborne, Immune to fire damage
Once on your turn, discard a fire card → Deal 3 damage to units at target adjacent location.
Ignis Rex.rulesTextZh:
飛行、免疫火焰傷害
每回合一次，在你的回合中，棄一張火焰牌 → 對目標相鄰位置上的所有單位造成 3 點傷害。

Vatn Draconis.rulesTextEng:
Submerge
At the end of your turn, you may submerge all minions and artifacts here.
Vatn Draconis.rulesTextZh:
潛水
在你的回合結束時，你可以使此處所有隨從與遺物潛入水下。

Cradle of Etherrum.rulesTextEng:
Any time during your turn, you may look at your next spell.
You may cast Dragons from the top of your spellbook here for (1) less.
Cradle of Etherrum.rulesTextZh:
在你的回合中任何時候，你可以查看你的下一張法術牌。
你可以將法術書頂端的巨龍施放到此處，其施放成本減少 (1)。

Shrine of the Dragonlord.rulesTextEng:
Genesis → Teleport all Dragons here.
This site provides an additional (1) and (E)(F)(W)(A).
Shrine of the Dragonlord.rulesTextZh:
降臨 → 將所有巨龍傳送到此處。
此地點額外提供 (1) 與 (E)(F)(W)(A)。

Dragonlord's Lair.rulesTextEng: Dragons cast to this site require no threshold and cost (1) less.
Dragonlord's Lair.rulesTextZh: 施放到此地點的巨龍無需門檻，且施放成本減少 (1)。

Bruin.rulesTextEng: While near your Avatar, Bruin takes damage for them.
Bruin.rulesTextZh: 當布魯因位於你的化身附近時，由布魯因代替其承受傷害。

Day of Judgment.rulesTextEng: Place the cross anywhere in the realm. Banish Evil and damage units occupying affected squares.
Day of Judgment.rulesTextZh: 將十字放置於場域中的任意位置。放逐邪惡（Evil），並對位於受影響格子上的單位造成傷害。

Swap.rulesTextEng: Swap the location of target minion or artifact with another target minion or artifact.
Swap.rulesTextZh: 交換目標隨從或遺物與另一個目標隨從或遺物的位置。

River of Blood.rulesTextEng: All healing is halved, rounded down.
River of Blood.rulesTextZh: 所有治療量減半，無條件捨去。

Haystack.rulesTextEng: If an opponent would search a deck, they search the top three cards instead.
Haystack.rulesTextZh: 若對手將搜尋牌庫，改為搜尋該牌庫頂端三張牌。

Fields of Phyxis.rulesTextEng: The site directly in front is silenced.

Lance.rulesTextEng: UPDATED: Bearer's next strike against units deals +1 damage and strikes first, then Lance breaks.
Lance.rulesTextZh: 持有者下一次對單位發動打擊時，額外造成 +1 點傷害且先攻，然後長槍損壞。

Aaj-kegon Ghost Crabs.rulesTextEng:
Submerge, Voidwalk
Has +1 power for each void in their row.
Aaj-kegon Ghost Crabs.rulesTextZh:
潛水、虛空行走
所在橫列每有一個虛空，便具有 +1 力量。

Abaddon Succubus.rulesTextEng: Once on your turn, may lure target adjacent enemy minion to take a step closer. When it arrives, it takes 2 damage and you heal 2.
Abaddon Succubus.rulesTextZh: 每回合一次，在你的回合中，可以引誘目標相鄰的敵方隨從向自己邁出一步。當其抵達時，該隨從受到 2 點傷害，且你回復 2 點生命。

Abyssal Assault.rulesTextEng: For each point of its power, an allied Monster may deal 1 damage to a unit in a square near it.
Abyssal Assault.rulesTextZh: 一個友方怪物可以依其力量值，每 1 點力量對附近一個格子中的一個單位造成 1 點傷害。

Accursed Desert.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 破壞附近的結界。

Accursed Tower.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 破壞附近的結界。

Accusation.rulesTextEng: Target opponent reveals their hand and banishes a card. If any of their cards or allies are Evil, you may choose which.
Accusation.rulesTextZh: 目標對手展示其手牌，並放逐其中一張牌。若其任何牌或友方單位具有邪惡（Evil），則由你選擇要放逐哪一張。

Acid Rain.rulesTextEng: Silence affected sites and artifacts there.
Acid Rain.rulesTextZh: 使受此效果影響的地點及其上的遺物沉默。

Aethermoeba.rulesTextEng:
Voidwalk
Moves by expanding from any part of itself. It occupies all locations it has ever occupied, and has +1 power for each one that is void.
Aethermoeba.rulesTextZh:
虛空行走
可從自身任意部分向外擴張移動。它會持續佔據曾經佔據過的所有位置，且其中每有一個虛空位置，便具有 +1 力量。

Aino.rulesTextEng: At the end of your turn, Aino may take a step between the top and bottom edges of the realm to gain Stealth.
Aino.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合結束時，艾諾可以在場域的上邊緣與下邊緣之間邁出一步。若如此作，獲得潛行。

Alabaster Box.rulesTextEng: Whenever a minion dies nearby, you heal 1.
Alabaster Box.rulesTextZh: 每當附近有一個隨從死亡時，你回復 1 點生命。

Algor Omphalos.rulesTextEng:
Earth and Water Spellcaster
At the end of your turn, this Omphalos draws a spell, which only it can cast. Minions it casts must be summoned here.
Algor Omphalos.rulesTextZh:
大地、水域施法者
在你的回合結束時，此臍石抽一張法術牌，且只有它可以施放該牌。由它施放的隨從必須召喚至此處。

Altar of Malachai.rulesTextEng: Once per game, if you would die, you may sacrifice a minion atop this Altar instead.
Altar of Malachai.rulesTextZh: 每場遊戲一次，若你將死亡，你可以改為犧牲此祭壇上的一個隨從。

Angel Ascendant.rulesTextEng: Has Airborne and +1 power while Warded.
Angel Ascendant.rulesTextZh: 具有飛行。受到護衛時，力量+1。

Angry Mob.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Kill target adjacent Unique or Elite minion.
Angry Mob.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 消滅目標相鄰的唯一或菁英隨從。

Animist.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play or draw a site.
You may cast magics in your hand as Spirits with power equal to their cost.
Animist.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 打出一張地點牌或抽一張地點牌。
你可以將手中的魔法牌視為靈體施放，其力量等同於其費用。

Apostles of Thamariel.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Search your top seven spells. You may summon an Angel from among them, then shuffle. The Angel is banished if the Apostles ever leave the realm.
Apostles of Thamariel.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 檢視你的法術書頂端七張牌。你可以從中召喚一個天使，然後將法術書洗牌。若使徒離開領域，該天使會被放逐。

Apply Alkahest.rulesTextEng: Destroy all minions, artifacts, and auras at target nearby site.
Apply Alkahest.rulesTextZh: 摧毀目標附近地點上的所有隨從、遺物與光環。

Arcade of Bones.rulesTextEng: While in this row, Undead move freely and can't be targeted or damaged by magic.
Arcade of Bones.rulesTextZh: 位於此橫列時，不死生物可自由移動，且不能成為魔法的目標，也不會受到魔法傷害。

Archangel Gabriel.rulesTextEng:
Airborne, Ward
Genesis -> Choose another allied minion. They draw a spell, which only they can cast.
Archangel Gabriel.rulesTextZh:
飛行，護衛
降臨 → 選擇另一個友方隨從。該隨從抽一張法術牌，且只有它可以施放該牌。

Archangel Michael.rulesTextEng:
Airborne, Ward
Genesis → Michael takes a step, then strikes all enemies at his location.
Archangel Michael.rulesTextZh:
飛行，護衛
降臨 → 米迦勒邁出一步，然後攻擊其所在位置的所有敵軍。

Archangel Raphael.rulesTextEng:
Airborne, Ward
Genesis → Strike or Ward a nearby Avatar.
Archangel Raphael.rulesTextZh:
飛行，護衛
降臨 → 攻擊或護衛一個附近的化身。

Archangel Samael.rulesTextEng:
Airborne, Ward
Genesis → Players lose 1 life for each Evil minion they control or in their cemetery.
Archangel Samael.rulesTextZh:
飛行，護衛
降臨 → 每位玩家每控制一個邪惡隨從，或其墳墓場中每有一個邪惡隨從，便失去1點生命。

Arjaro Exorcist.rulesTextEng:
Spellcaster
Genesis → Banish target adjacent Demon, Spirit, or aura.
Arjaro Exorcist.rulesTextZh:
施法者
降臨 → 放逐目標相鄰的惡魔、靈體或光環。

Army of the Dead.rulesTextEng: Whenever this Army moves or takes damage, it leaves a Skeleton token behind.
Army of the Dead.rulesTextZh: 每當此大軍移動或受到傷害時，便在原處留下一個骷髏衍生物。

Asmodeus.rulesTextEng:
Stealth
Break Stealth → Destroy everything else here, including this site.
Asmodeus.rulesTextZh:
潛行
潛行被打破 → 摧毀此處除此牌外的一切，包括此地點。

Assimilator Snail.rulesTextEng: Once on your turn, you may banish a dead minion. Assimilator Snail becomes a copy of that minion until your next turn.
Assimilator Snail.rulesTextZh: 每回合一次，你可以放逐一個已死亡的隨從。同化蝸牛成為該隨從的複製品，直到你的下一個回合開始。

Avenging Angel.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
Has Charge and Lethal if an ally died on your opponent's last turn.
Avenging Angel.rulesTextZh:
飛行
若有友軍於對手的上一個回合死亡，則具有衝鋒與致命。

Baba Yaga's Hut.rulesTextEng: Once on your turn, this may swap positions with an empty site in your back row.
Baba Yaga's Hut.rulesTextZh: 每回合一次，此牌可以與你後排的一個空地點交換位置。

Balor of the Evil Eye.rulesTextEng: Once on your turn, Balor may deal 2 damage to one unit at each other location in a cardinal direction.
Balor of the Evil Eye.rulesTextZh: 每回合一次，巴羅爾可以對一個正方向上每個其他位置的一個單位各造成2點傷害。

Bane of Aventis.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Gain control of nearby Warded minions.
Bane of Aventis.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 獲得附近所有受到護衛的隨從之控制權。

Baptize.rulesTextEng: Ward each allied minion at target water site.
Baptize.rulesTextZh: 護衛目標水域地點上的每個友方隨從。

Barrow Wight.rulesTextEng:
Burrowing
(2), Sacrifice a Skeleton token → Summon this minion from your cemetery to that site.
Barrow Wight.rulesTextZh:
潛地
(2)，犧牲一個骷髏衍生物 → 將此隨從從你的墳墓場召喚至該地點。

Begone!.rulesTextEng: Banish an Evil minion anywhere in the realm.
Begone!.rulesTextZh: 放逐領域中任意位置的一個邪惡隨從。

Betrayal.rulesTextEng: Gain control of target enemy minion this turn and untap it.
Betrayal.rulesTextZh: 獲得目標敵方隨從的控制權直到本回合結束，並將其重置。

Bind Evil.rulesTextEng: Disable target nearby Evil minion until an adjacent Spellcaster taps to release it.
Bind Evil.rulesTextZh: 使目標附近的邪惡隨從失效，直到一個相鄰的施法者橫置以解除其束縛。

Bitten.rulesTextEng:
Genesis → Strike target nearby Evil minion.
Deathrite → Summon a Skeleton token here under your opponent's control.
Bitten.rulesTextZh:
降臨 → 攻擊目標附近的邪惡隨從。
死亡之觸 → 在此處於你的對手控制下召喚一個骷髏衍生物。

Bitter Departed.rulesTextEng: Genesis → If an ally died last turn, may teleport to the killer to strike it.
Bitter Departed.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 若有友方於上一個回合死亡，你可以傳送到擊殺者所在的位置並攻擊它。

Black Cat.rulesTextEng:
Has nine lives.
Determine opponent's random outcomes.
Black Cat.rulesTextZh:
擁有九條命。
由你決定對手所有隨機效果的結果。

Black Mass.rulesTextEng: Search your top seven spells. You may reveal and draw three different Evil minions from among them. Put the rest at the bottom of your spellbook.
Black Mass.rulesTextZh: 檢視你的法術書頂端七張牌。你可以從中展示並抽取三張名稱不同的邪惡隨從牌，然後將其餘牌置於法術書底。

Bladderblimp.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
Deathrite → Players lose 1 life for each nearby site they control.
Bladderblimp.rulesTextZh:
飛行
死亡之觸 → 每位玩家每控制一個附近的地點，便失去1點生命。

Bladedancer.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play or draw a site.
After her first attack each turn, Bladedancer may take a step. When she does, she may attack a unit there.
Bladedancer.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 打出一張地點牌或抽一張地點牌。
每回合第一次攻擊後，刃舞者可以邁出一步。若如此做，她可以攻擊該位置的一個單位。

Blade of Thorns.rulesTextEng: Bearer has +3 power, but it can't drop this Weapon and its controller loses 2 life at the end of their turn.
Blade of Thorns.rulesTextZh: 佩戴者力量+3，但不能棄下此武器，且其操控者在其回合結束時失去2點生命。

Blasphemy.rulesTextEng: Each minion deals 1 damage to its site, destroys an artifact there, then taps. They don't untap the next time they would.
Blasphemy.rulesTextZh: 每個隨從對其所在地點造成1點傷害，摧毀該處的一件遺物，然後橫置。下一次本應重置時，改為不重置。

Blaze of Glory.rulesTextEng: An ally fights each enemy near it, one at a time. It doesn't die until it's done.
Blaze of Glory.rulesTextZh: 選擇一個友方單位，使其依序與附近每個敵軍戰鬥。直到完成所有戰鬥前，它不會死亡。

Bleeding Skull.rulesTextEng: Whenever a minion dies nearby, your opponent loses 1 life.
Bleeding Skull.rulesTextZh: 每當附近有一個隨從死亡時，你的對手失去1點生命。

Bless.rulesTextEng: Ward a nearby minion or site.
Bless.rulesTextZh: 護衛一個附近的隨從或地點。

Blood Mana.rulesTextEng: The next spell you cast this turn costs life instead of mana.
Blood Mana.rulesTextZh: 你本回合施放的下一張法術改為支付生命，而非法力。

Bodach Bogeyman.rulesTextEng: Can pick up adjacent weaker enemy minions. They're disables while carried.
Bodach Bogeyman.rulesTextZh: 可以拾起相鄰且力量較低的敵方隨從。被攜帶期間，它們處於失效狀態。

Bone Jumble.rulesTextEng:
Charge
(1), Sacrifice a Skeleton token → Summon Bone Jumble from your cemetery there.
Bone Jumble.rulesTextZh:
衝鋒
(1)，犧牲一個骷髏衍生物 → 將骸骨聚合體從你的墳墓場召喚至該處。

Bone Spear.rulesTextEng: Sacrifice an Undead to shoot a projectile from its location that deals 3 damage.
Bone Spear.rulesTextZh: 犧牲一個不死生物，從其所在位置發射一枚投射物，造成3點傷害。

Book Burners.rulesTextEng: Once on your turn, Book Burners may banish a Document from the realm or a magic from a cemetery.
Book Burners.rulesTextZh: 每回合一次，焚書者可以放逐領域中的一張文獻，或墳墓場中的一張魔法牌。

Book of Blessings.rulesTextEng: Whenever bearer casts magic that chooses a single allied minion, Ward that ally.
Book of Blessings.rulesTextZh: 每當佩戴者施放指定單一友方隨從的魔法時，護衛該友方隨從。

Book of the Dead.rulesTextEng: Once on your turn, Spellcaster bearer may cast a dead minion. It becomes Undead instead and is banished if it dies.
Book of the Dead.rulesTextZh: 每回合一次，具有施法者的佩戴者可以施放一個已死亡的隨從。該隨從改為成為不死生物，且若死亡則會被放逐。

Boulevard of Bones.rulesTextEng: Whenever another site is played to an adjacent square, summon a Skeleton token there.
Boulevard of Bones.rulesTextZh: 每當另一個地點牌被打出至相鄰的格子時，在該處召喚一個骷髏衍生物。

Bound Spirit.rulesTextEng: Disabled unless adjacent to an allied Spellcaster.
Bound Spirit.rulesTextZh: 除非相鄰於一個友方施法者，否則此牌處於失效狀態。

Bull Whip.rulesTextEng: Once on your turn, bearer may deal 1 damage to target adjacent minion.
Bull Whip.rulesTextZh: 每回合一次，佩戴者可以對目標相鄰隨從造成1點傷害。

Bureau of Occult Control.rulesTextEng: Players must pay (2) to access a collection or cemetery.
Bureau of Occult Control.rulesTextZh: 玩家存取收藏區或墳墓場時，必須額外支付(2)。

Buried Alive.rulesTextEng:
May be cast by any ally.
Burrow target adjacent minion.
Buried Alive.rulesTextZh:
可由任意友方單位施放。
使目標相鄰隨從潛地。

Cage of Sidrak.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Lock all minions with 2 or less power in this cage, tapped and disabled.
Cage of Sidrak.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 將所有力量2以下（含）的隨從鎖入此牢籠，使其橫置並失效。

Call of the Sea.rulesTextEng: Minions adjacent to target Water site step towards it. Then submerge all minions there.
Call of the Sea.rulesTextZh: 目標水域地點相鄰的所有隨從各向其邁出一步，然後使該處所有隨從潛入水下。

Carrion Beetles.rulesTextEng:
Burrowing
Genesis → Banish three cards from one cemetery.
Carrion Beetles.rulesTextZh:
潛地
降臨 → 從一個墳墓場放逐三張牌。

Carrionette.rulesTextEng: Summon an Undead from a cemetery to a nearby location.
Carrionette.rulesTextZh: 從一個墳墓場召喚一個不死生物至附近的一個位置。

Cemetery Rats.rulesTextEng:
Burrowing
Genesis → Discard your top two spells.
Cemetery Rats.rulesTextZh:
潛地
降臨 → 棄掉你的法術書頂端兩張牌。

Chaoswish.rulesTextEng: Cast a copy of a random spell for free, ignoring threshold, then the next player may copy Chaoswish.
Chaoswish.rulesTextZh: 免費施放一張隨機法術的複製品，無視門檻，然後下一位玩家可以複製並施放《混沌之願》。

Char Omphalos.rulesTextEng:
Air and Fire Spellcaster
At the end of your turn, this Omphalos draws a spell, which only it can cast. Minions it casts must be summoned here.
Char Omphalos.rulesTextZh:
風域、火域施法者
在你的回合結束時，此臍石抽一張法術牌，且只有它可以施放該牌。由它施放的隨從必須召喚至此處。

Cherubim.rulesTextEng:
Airborne, Ward
Tap → Shoot a projectile that deals 4 damage.
Cherubim.rulesTextZh:
飛行，護衛
橫置 → 發射一枚造成4點傷害的投射物。

Chorus of Condemnation.rulesTextEng: Each player chooses another to discard a card.
Chorus of Condemnation.rulesTextZh: 每位玩家各選擇另一位玩家棄一張牌。

City of Glass.rulesTextEng: (A) — Provides (2) instead but is destroyed when damaged.
City of Glass.rulesTextZh: (A) — 改為提供(2)，但受到傷害時便會被摧毀。

City of Plenty.rulesTextEng: (W) — Provides (2) instead but also provides (1) for your opponent.
City of Plenty.rulesTextZh: (W) — 改為提供(2)，但同時也為你的對手提供(1)。

City of Souls.rulesTextEng: (E) — Provides (2) instead but enemies can redirect damage dealt to this site to any unit.
City of Souls.rulesTextZh: (E) — 改為提供(2)，但敵方可以將對此地點造成的傷害轉移給任意單位。

City of Traitors.rulesTextEng: (F) — Provides (2) instead but your opponent can cast minions to this site Stealthed.
City of Traitors.rulesTextZh: (F) — 改為提供(2)，但你的對手可以將隨從以潛行狀態施放到此地點。

Clairvoyant.rulesTextEng:
Ward
Once on your turn, you may banish a dead minion to look at your top spell. You may put it at the bottom.
Clairvoyant.rulesTextZh:
護衛
每回合一次，你可以放逐一個已死亡的隨從，查看你的法術書頂端牌。你可以將其置於法術書底。

Clay Golem.rulesTextEng: Deathrite → Play your top site to an adjacent void or Rubble.
Clay Golem.rulesTextZh: 死亡之觸 → 將你的地點牌堆頂端牌打出至相鄰的虛空或瓦礫。

Consecrate.rulesTextEng: An ally Wards its site, then may transform it into a Consecrated Ground from your collection.
Consecrate.rulesTextZh: 選擇一個友方單位，使其所在地點獲得護衛，然後你可以將其從你的收藏區轉化為「祝聖之地」。

Consecrated Ground.rulesTextZh: 邪惡單位在此處沒有力量。

Corpse Catapult.rulesTextEng: Tap bearer and another ally here, Banish a dead minion → Deal damage equal to the banished minion's power to each unit at target location up to three steps away.
Corpse Catapult.rulesTextZh: 橫置佩戴者與此處另一個友方單位，放逐一個已死亡的隨從 → 對最遠三步距離內目標位置的每個單位造成等同於該放逐隨從力量的傷害。

Corpse Explosion.rulesTextEng: Deal a dead minion to each site in a two-by-two area. Deal damage equal to each corpse's power to units there, then banish the corpses.
Corpse Explosion.rulesTextZh: 將一個已死亡的隨從分配至一個2×2區域內的每個地點。對各地點上的單位造成等同於該屍體力量的傷害，然後放逐那些屍體。

Corruptor.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play or draw a site.
Your Beasts are Monsters, your Mortals are Undead, and your Angels are Demons.
Corruptor.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 打出一張地點牌或抽一張地點牌。
你的野獸視為怪物，你的凡人視為不死生物，而你的天使視為惡魔。

Corruptor Freak.rulesTextEng: At the end of your turn, deal 2 damage to this site.
Corruptor Freak.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合結束時，對此地點造成2點傷害。

Cranky Overseer.rulesTextEng: Once on your turn, the Overseer may deal 1 damage to target adjacent Ordinary minion to untap it.
Cranky Overseer.rulesTextZh: 每回合一次，監工可以對目標相鄰的普通隨從造成1點傷害，然後將其重置。

Crawling Congregation.rulesTextEng: Projectiles fly over this and other adjacent allies.
Crawling Congregation.rulesTextZh: 投射物會飛越此牌與其他相鄰的友方單位。

Croaking Swamp.rulesTextEng: Genesis → You may pay (1) to summon a Frog token here.
Croaking Swamp.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 你可以支付(1)，在此處召喚一個青蛙衍生物。

Crucifix.rulesTextEng:
Genesis → Return each Evil minion here to its owner’s hand.
Evil minions can't enter this location.
Crucifix.rulesTextZh:
降臨 → 將此處所有邪惡隨從返回其擁有者手中。
邪惡隨從不能進入此位置。

Cursed Iron.rulesTextEng: Artifacts here can't be dropped and each deals 1 damage to its bearer at the end of each turn.
Cursed Iron.rulesTextZh: 此處的遺物不能被棄下，且每件遺物都會在每個回合結束時對其佩戴者造成1點傷害。

Dank Omphalos.rulesTextEng:
Air and Water Spellcaster
At the end of your turn, this Omphalos draws a spell, which only it can cast. Minions it casts must be summoned here.
Dank Omphalos.rulesTextZh:
風域、水域施法者
在你的回合結束時，此臍石抽一張法術牌，且只有它可以施放該牌。由它施放的隨從必須召喚至此處。

Dark Alley.rulesTextEng: The first minion that enters here gains Stealth.
Dark Alley.rulesTextZh: 第一個進入此處的隨從獲得潛行。

Darkest Dungeon.rulesTextEng: Genesis → The next time an ally strikes an Avatar this turn, drag both here if able.
Darkest Dungeon.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 本回合下一次當友方單位攻擊化身時，若可以，將雙方都拖曳至此處。

Death Knight.rulesTextEng: Other nearby Undead allies have +1 power.
Death Knight.rulesTextZh: 其他附近的友方不死生物力量+1。

Deathwish.rulesTextZh: 每個化身的生命值上限減半。

Defiler Spire.rulesTextEng: Sites occupied by Evil have "At the end of your turn, you lose 1 life."
Defiler Spire.rulesTextZh: 被邪惡單位佔據的地點具有「在你的回合結束時，你失去1點生命。」

Deliverance.rulesTextZh: 放逐附近所有邪惡單位。

Demon Hunter.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 消滅目標相鄰的惡魔。

Demonic Contract.rulesTextEng:
Search your spellbook for any card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle afterward.
You may only search for a spell that has rarity lower or equal to a Demon minion that you control. As an additional cost to cast Demonic Contract you must pay 4 life, or reach another accord with said demon by sacrificing a coin, egg, frog, gem, goat, rune, treasure, or Mortal soul.
Demonic Contract.rulesTextZh:
在你的法術書中搜尋任意一張牌，展示之，加入你的手牌，然後將法術書洗牌。
你只能搜尋稀有度低於或等於你所控制的一個惡魔隨從的法術牌。作為施放《惡魔契約》的額外代價，你必須支付4點生命，或與該惡魔達成另一項協議：犧牲一枚硬幣、蛋、青蛙、寶石、山羊、符文、寶藏，或一個凡人的靈魂。

Den of Evil.rulesTextEng: Genesis → This turn, the next Evil cast to this site costs (1) less, ignoring threshold.
Den of Evil.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 本回合下一個施放至此地點的邪惡單位費用減少(1)，且無視門檻。

Desecrate.rulesTextEng: An Evil ally strikes its site, then may transform it into a Desecrated Ground from your collection.
Desecrate.rulesTextZh: 選擇一個邪惡友方單位，使其攻擊其所在地點，然後你可以將該地點從你的收藏區轉化為「褻瀆之地」。

Desecrator Kite.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
At the end of your turn, deal 1 damage to this site.
Desecrator Kite.rulesTextZh:
飛行
在你的回合結束時，對此地點造成1點傷害。

Detonate.rulesTextEng: Destroy a minion or artifact you own or control. It explodes, dealing 3 damage to each unit at its location.
Detonate.rulesTextZh: 摧毀一個由你擁有或控制的隨從或遺物。它會爆炸，對其所在位置的每個單位造成3點傷害。

De Vermis Mysteriis.rulesTextEng: Spellcaster bearer may cast minion spells for (5), ignoring threshold.
De Vermis Mysteriis.rulesTextZh: 具有施法者的佩戴者可以支付(5)施放隨從牌，且無視門檻。

Dhol Chants.rulesTextEng: Tap any number of nearby allies. Reveal that many spells from the top of your spellbook and cast one for free. Put the rest at the bottom of your spellbook.
Dhol Chants.rulesTextZh: 橫置任意數量的附近友方單位。展示你的法術書頂端等量的牌，免費施放其中一張，然後將其餘牌置於法術書底。

Displace.rulesTextEng: Teleport target minion, artifact, or aura one diagonal step.
Displace.rulesTextZh: 將目標隨從、遺物或光環傳送一個對角方向的步距。

Divine Intervention.rulesTextEng: Return from Death's Door to 1 life.
Divine Intervention.rulesTextZh: 使你的化身脫離瀕死狀態，生命值恢復至1點。

Divine Lance.rulesTextEng: Deal 1 damage to each minion at target site. You may break any number of allied Wards to increase the damage by 1 for each.
Divine Lance.rulesTextZh: 對目標地點上的每個隨從造成1點傷害。你可以打破任意數量的友方護衛，每打破一個護衛，此傷害便增加1點。

Doctor Demetrius.rulesTextEng: Once on your turn, Demetrius may Ward another adjacent minion.
Doctor Demetrius.rulesTextZh: 每回合一次，德米特里斯可以護衛另一個相鄰隨從。

Doomsday Cult.rulesTextEng:
Players play with the top card of their spellbook revealed.
Players may cast Evil from the top of their spellbook here.
Doomsday Cult.rulesTextZh:
玩家的法術書頂端牌保持展示。
玩家可以從法術書頂端將邪惡單位施放至此處。

Dormant Monstrosity.rulesTextEng:
Voidwalk
Must be cast to a corner void, costing (2) less for each unit in an adjacent square.
Dormant Monstrosity.rulesTextZh:
虛空行走
必須施放至角落的虛空。每有一個位於相鄰格子的單位，其費用便減少(2)。

Draconian Bonekite.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
Tap → Deal 3 damage to each other unit at target nearby location. Summon a Skeleton token there for each unit that died.
Draconian Bonekite.rulesTextZh:
飛行
橫置 → 對目標附近位置的每個其他單位造成3點傷害。每有一個單位因此死亡，便在該處召喚一個骷髏衍生物。

Dread Thicket.rulesTextEng: The first attack out of this site each turn can't be defended.
Dread Thicket.rulesTextZh: 每回合從此地點發動的第一次攻擊不能被防禦。

Dreadwing.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
Genesis → Strikes your Avatar unless you discard a card.
Dreadwing.rulesTextZh:
飛行
降臨 → 除非你棄一張牌，否則攻擊你的化身。

Dredge.rulesTextEng: Surface everything at target water site and summon two Skeleton tokens there.
Dredge.rulesTextZh: 使目標水域地點的所有單位浮出水面，然後在該處召喚兩個骷髏衍生物。

Driftwood Marrows.rulesTextZh: 附近的友方單位不能被潛入水下。

Drowned.rulesTextZh:
潛水
必須以潛水狀態施放。

Duplicator.rulesTextEng:
Your spellbook and atlas can only contain matching pairs of Uniques and you start with only two spells and two sites in hand.
Tap → Play or draw a site.
Duplicator.rulesTextZh:
你的法術書與地圖集只能包含成對且相同的唯一牌，且你起始手牌只有兩張法術牌與兩張地點牌。
橫置 → 打出一張地點牌或抽一張地點牌。

Earl of the Ivory Towers.rulesTextEng:
Non-Ordinary Spellcaster
Can't be targeted or damaged by the Ordinary.
Earl of the Ivory Towers.rulesTextZh:
非普通施法者
不能成為普通單位的目標，也不會受到普通單位造成的傷害。

Eclipse.rulesTextEng:
You may cast Evil minions to affected sites.
Evil allies occupying affected sites have +1 power.
Eclipse.rulesTextZh:
你可以將邪惡隨從施放至受影響的地點。
佔據受影響地點的邪惡友方單位力量+1。

Eerie Coral.rulesTextEng: Bearer has +1 power and is a Water Spellcaster.
Eerie Coral.rulesTextZh: 佩戴者力量+1，且視為水域施法者。

Elder Ruins.rulesTextEng: Sacrifice a minion here → Cast a Shoggoth submerged here from your collection.
Elder Ruins.rulesTextZh: 犧牲此處的一個隨從 → 從你的收藏區以潛水狀態施放一個修格斯至此處。

Endless Fence.rulesTextEng: Minions can't enter this span of land from the void.
Endless Fence.rulesTextZh: 隨從不能從虛空進入這片連續的陸地。

Enduring Faith.rulesTextEng: Ward an allied minion. Until your next turn, it takes damage for its nearby allies instead.
Enduring Faith.rulesTextZh: 護衛一個友方隨從。直到你的下一個回合開始前，它改為代替附近的友方單位承受傷害。

Enraged Familiar.rulesTextEng: Has +2 power if you've lost life this turn.
Enraged Familiar.rulesTextZh: 若你本回合失去過生命，則力量+2。

Entombed.rulesTextZh:
潛地
必須以潛地狀態施放。

Ersatz Platz.rulesTextEng: You can play an Exceptional site from your collection here, banishing this site.
Ersatz Platz.rulesTextZh: 你可以從收藏區將一張卓越地點牌打出至此處，並放逐此地點。

Estranged Loner.rulesTextEng: Deathrite → You may summon a Horrible Hybrids from your collection to this location.
Estranged Loner.rulesTextZh: 死亡之觸 → 你可以從收藏區將一個「駭人混種」召喚至此位置。

Evil Twin.rulesTextEng: Enters the realm as an Evil copy of an enemy minion, and strikes first if they fight.
Evil Twin.rulesTextZh: 以一個敵方隨從的邪惡複製品進入領域。若兩者發生戰鬥，邪惡雙生子會先攻擊。

Exhume.rulesTextEng: Unburrow everything at target land site and summon two Skeleton tokens there.
Exhume.rulesTextZh: 使目標陸地地點的所有單位解除潛地，然後在該處召喚兩個骷髏衍生物。

Failed Mutation.rulesTextEng: Can't be targeted or damaged by magic.
Failed Mutation.rulesTextZh: 不能成為魔法的目標，也不會受到魔法傷害。

Faith Incarnate.rulesTextEng: Has +2 power for each Ward in the realm.
Faith Incarnate.rulesTextZh: 領域中每有一個護衛，其力量便+2。

Fallen Angel.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
Nearby allied Demons have +1 power.
Fallen Angel.rulesTextZh:
飛行
附近的友方惡魔力量+1。

Falling Star.rulesTextEng: Lasts 3 of your turns. When the star falls, you may summon a minion from your hand atop an affected site. It strikes each other unit where it lands.
Falling Star.rulesTextZh: 持續3個你的回合。當流星墜落時，你可以從手牌將一個隨從召喚到受影響地點的地表。它落地時會攻擊該處的每個其他單位。

False Idol.rulesTextEng: Whenever a nearby minion taps, its opponent draws a spell.
False Idol.rulesTextZh: 每當附近有一個隨從橫置時，該隨從的對手抽一張法術牌。

Feign Death.rulesTextEng: Trigger an allied minion's Deathrite. It gains Stealth. Draw a spell.
Feign Death.rulesTextZh: 觸發一個友方隨從的死亡之觸。該隨從獲得潛行。抽一張法術牌。

Ferryman's Coin.rulesTextEng: Banish this coin → Gain (1), or banish up to three cards from any cemetery.
Ferryman's Coin.rulesTextZh: 放逐此硬幣 → 獲得(1)，或從任意墳墓場放逐最多三張牌。

Flagellant.rulesTextEng: Whenever Flagellant takes damage, you heal 1.
Flagellant.rulesTextZh: 每當苦修者受到傷害時，你恢復1點生命。

Flame of the First Ones.rulesTextEng: Whenever the flame stops at a new site, you heal 1 and your opponent loses 1 life.
Flame of the First Ones.rulesTextZh: 每當此火焰停留於一個新的地點時，你恢復1點生命，且你的對手失去1點生命。

Flame Strike.rulesTextEng: Choose a cardinal direction from the caster. Deal damage to each unit at affected locations:
Flame Strike.rulesTextZh: 選擇施法者的一個正方向。對受影響位置上的每個單位造成傷害：

Flayer.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Deal 1 damage to each other nearby unit.
Flayer.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 對附近每個其他單位造成1點傷害。

Forgotten Tomb.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Search your top five spells for a minion to discard. Bottom the rest.
Forgotten Tomb.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 檢視你的法術書頂端五張牌，選擇其中一張隨從牌棄掉，將其餘牌置於法術書底。

Forlorn Keep.rulesTextEng: (E)(E) — Genesis → You may cast a Penitent Knight from your collection to this site.
Forlorn Keep.rulesTextZh: (E)(E) — 降臨 → 你可以從收藏區將一個「懺悔騎士」施放至此地點。

Forsaken.rulesTextEng:
Voidwalk
Must be cast to an outer column.
Forsaken.rulesTextZh:
虛空行走
必須施放至最外側的一列。

Forsaken Crypt.rulesTextEng: (A)(A) — Genesis → You may cast a Ghoul from your collection to this site.
Forsaken Crypt.rulesTextZh: (A)(A) — 降臨 → 你可以從收藏區將一個「食屍鬼」施放至此地點。

Four Fat Frogs.rulesTextEng: Summon four Frog tokens to an allied site.
Four Fat Frogs.rulesTextZh: 在一個友方地點召喚四個青蛙衍生物。

Fowl Bones.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
(1), Sacrifice a Skeleton token → Summon Fowl Bones from your cemetery there.
Fowl Bones.rulesTextZh:
飛行
(1)，犧牲一個骷髏衍生物 → 將骸骨飛禽從你的墳墓場召喚至該處。

Freeze.rulesTextEng: Disable target nearby minion until your next turn.
Freeze.rulesTextZh: 使目標附近的隨從失效，直到你的下一個回合開始。

Frozen Horror.rulesTextEng:
Stealth
Break Stealth → Disable other nearby minions until your next turn.
Frozen Horror.rulesTextZh:
潛行
潛行被打破 → 使附近每個其他隨從失效，直到你的下一個回合開始。

Garden of Eden.rulesTextEng: Players can't draw more than one spell each turn.
Garden of Eden.rulesTextZh: 每位玩家每回合不能抽超過一張法術牌。

Gargantula.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Gargantula may drag an adjacent minion here, disabling it in a cocoon until a unit at its location taps to free it.
Gargantula.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 巨蛛可以將一個相鄰隨從拖曳至此處，並將其困在繭中使其失效，直到其所在位置的一個單位橫置將其解救。

Ghostfire.rulesTextEng:
Shoot a 1-damage projectile.
You may cast this spell from your cemetery, banishing it afterward.
Ghostfire.rulesTextZh:
發射一枚造成1點傷害的投射物。
你可以從你的墳墓場施放此法術，然後將其放逐。

Gift of the Frog.rulesTextEng: Summon a Frog token to an allied minion. Draw a spell.
Gift of the Frog.rulesTextZh: 在一個友方隨從身上召喚一個青蛙衍生物。抽一張法術牌。

Gift of the Raven.rulesTextEng: Choose an allied minion. The next time they strike a unit this turn, the damage heals you. Draw a spell.
Gift of the Raven.rulesTextZh: 選擇一個友方隨從。本回合下一次該隨從攻擊單位時，造成的傷害會改為使你恢復等量生命。抽一張法術牌。

Gift of the Serpent.rulesTextEng: Give an allied minion Lethal this turn. Draw a spell.
Gift of the Serpent.rulesTextZh: 本回合使一個友方隨從獲得致命。抽一張法術牌。

Gift of the Wolf.rulesTextEng: Give an allied minion +2 power this turn. Draw a spell.
Gift of the Wolf.rulesTextZh: 本回合使一個友方隨從力量+2。抽一張法術牌。

Gilman House.rulesTextEng: (W)(W)(W)(W) → Transform a minion here into a Horrible Hybrids from your collection.
Gilman House.rulesTextZh: (W)(W)(W)(W) → 將此處的一個隨從轉化為你收藏區中的一個「駭人混種」。

Gloam Toads.rulesTextEng:
Immobile
Tap → Drags in target adjacent unit and may strike it when it arrives.
Gloam Toads.rulesTextZh:
無法移動
橫置 → 將目標相鄰單位拖曳至此處，並可以在其抵達時攻擊它。

Gnarled Wendigo.rulesTextEng: This costs (2) less to cast for each minion you sacrifice at its summoning location.
Gnarled Wendigo.rulesTextZh: 在其召喚位置每犧牲一個隨從，施放此牌的費用便減少(2)。

Goat for Azazel.rulesTextZh: 代替其他友方單位承受傷害。

Golden Dawn.rulesTextEng: Deal out your top spells, one to each site in your back row. Summon any that are minions and put the rest at the bottom of your spellbook. If you're on Death's Door, they gain Charge.
Golden Dawn.rulesTextZh: 將你法術書頂端的牌依序分配至你後排的每個地點，每個地點一張。將其中的隨從召喚到各自的地點，其餘牌置於法術書底。若你的化身處於瀕死狀態，這些隨從獲得衝鋒。

Golgor.rulesTextEng: Once on your turn, you may banish minions with 2 or less power at target adjacent location.
Golgor.rulesTextZh: 每回合一次，你可以放逐目標相鄰位置所有力量2以下（含）的隨從。

Gossamer Ghost.rulesTextEng:
Stealth
Can't be immobilized or disabled.
Gossamer Ghost.rulesTextZh:
潛行
不能被定身或失效。

Grasping Ground.rulesTextEng: Each burrowed ally may drag down a target minion or artifact above them.
Grasping Ground.rulesTextZh: 每個處於潛地狀態的友方單位都可以將其正上方的一個目標隨從或遺物拖入地下。

Gravedigger.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 使目標相鄰的不死生物潛地。

Greater Blood Demon.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 你失去4點生命。

Grief Larvae.rulesTextEng:
Burrowing
At the end of your turn, deal 1 damage to this site.
Grief Larvae.rulesTextZh:
潛地
在你的回合結束時，對此地點造成1點傷害。

Grigori Rasputin.rulesTextEng:
Spellcaster
Banish an Evil ally → Cast Rasputin from your cemetery to there. He adds their power and abilities to his own until he dies again.
Grigori Rasputin.rulesTextZh:
施法者
放逐一個邪惡友方單位 → 將拉斯普丁從你的墳墓場施放至該處。在他再次死亡前，他獲得該單位的力量與所有能力。

Guardian Angel.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
Genesis → Fly to a weaker allied minion to Ward it.
Guardian Angel.rulesTextZh:
飛行
降臨 → 飛至一個力量較低的友方隨從，並護衛它。

Hand of Glory.rulesTextEng: Bearer has +1 power and is a Fire Spellcaster.
Hand of Glory.rulesTextZh: 佩戴者力量+1，且視為火域施法者。

Harbinger.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play or draw a site.
On setup, determine three random squares. Once on your turn, you can cast a minion to one of them and for (1) less.
Harbinger.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 打出一張地點牌或抽一張地點牌。
設置時，隨機決定三個格子。每回合一次，你可以將一個隨從施放至其中一個格子，且費用減少(1)。

Harpyon Urge.rulesTextEng: An ally flies to target weaker minion and strikes it upon arrival.
Harpyon Urge.rulesTextZh: 選擇一個友方單位，使其飛向目標力量較低的隨從，並在抵達時攻擊它。

Harvest Festival.rulesTextEng: Summon Eltham and Serava Townsfolk from your collection to an allied site.
Harvest Festival.rulesTextZh: 從你的收藏區將艾爾瑟姆鎮民與塞拉瓦鎮民召喚至一個友方地點。

Hauntless Head.rulesTextEng:
Spellcaster, Voidwalk
At the start of your turn, Hauntless Head teleports to the top of a random site or void.
Hauntless Head.rulesTextZh:
施法者，虛空行走
在你的回合開始時，無畏之首傳送至一個隨機地點或虛空的上方。

Hearkening Kraken.rulesTextEng:
Submerge
Must be cast submerged, and costs (1) less for each enemy in its body of water.
Hearkening Kraken.rulesTextZh:
潛水
必須以潛水狀態施放，且其所在水域每有一個敵方單位，費用便減少(1)。

Heirloom Lost.rulesTextEng: You may play this to replace any player's Elite or Unique site, under their control.
Heirloom Lost.rulesTextZh: 你可以打出此牌，取代任一位玩家所控制的一個菁英或唯一地點，並仍由該玩家控制。

Hellfire.rulesTextEng: Destroy everything below sites, then deal 2 damage to each minion above.
Hellfire.rulesTextZh: 摧毀所有位於地點下方的物件，然後對所有位於地點上方的隨從造成2點傷害。

Hellmouth.rulesTextEng: Evil minions nearby or being summoned nearby have Burrowing.
Hellmouth.rulesTextZh: 附近的邪惡隨從，以及召喚至附近的邪惡隨從，都具有潛地。

Hellstar.rulesTextEng: Airborne, can't attack or defend. At the start of your turn, each other unit at affected locations takes damage:
Hellstar.rulesTextZh: 飛行，不能攻擊或防禦。在你的回合開始時，受影響位置上的每個其他單位受到傷害：

Hemogoblet.rulesTextEng: Once on your turn, you may fill the goblet by sacrificing a minion here, or empty it if it's full. When you empty the goblet, you gain mana or heal life equal to that minion's power.
Hemogoblet.rulesTextZh: 每回合一次，你可以犧牲此處的一個隨從來裝滿聖杯；若聖杯已滿，則可以將其倒空。當你倒空聖杯時，你獲得等同於該隨從力量的法力，或恢復等量生命。

Hemogoblin.rulesTextEng: Genesis & Deathrite → Set players' maximum life to their current life.
Hemogoblin.rulesTextZh: 降臨與死亡之觸 → 將所有玩家的生命值上限設為其目前生命值。

Hemogolem.rulesTextEng: Damage dealt to units by Hemogolem's strikes heals you, but damage it takes is dealt to you as well.
Hemogolem.rulesTextZh: 血魔像以攻擊對單位造成的傷害會使你恢復等量生命，但它所受到的傷害也會由你承受。

Heretics of Seth.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 奪取一個附近的護衛。

Hillside Chapel.rulesTextEng: Genesis → You may pay (1) to tap and Ward a nearby allied minion.
Hillside Chapel.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 你可以支付(1)，橫置並護衛一個附近的友方隨從。

Hollow One.rulesTextEng: Disabled until a Mortal or Beast dies nearby.
Hollow One.rulesTextZh: 處於失效狀態，直到附近有一個凡人或野獸死亡。

Holy Nova.rulesTextEng: Deal damage to each enemy at affected locations. You may break an allied Ward to center this spell on that location instead of the caster's.
Holy Nova.rulesTextZh: 對受影響地點上的每個敵方造成傷害。你可以破壞一個友方護衛（Ward），改為以該護衛所在位置作為此法術的中心，而非施法者所在位置。

Holy Water.rulesTextEng: Bearer has "Tap, Sacrifice this Holy Water → Throw a projectile. If it hits a minion, banish it if Evil, Ward it if not."
Holy Water.rulesTextZh: 持有者獲得「橫置，犧牲此聖水 → 投擲一個投射物。若擊中一個隨從，若其為邪惡（Evil）則放逐它；否則賦予它護衛（Ward）。」

Homecoming.rulesTextZh: 此地點的隨從具有「橫置 → 獲得①。」

Horns of Behemoth.rulesTextEng: (F)(F)(F)(F)(F)(F) — May transform into a Demon. Place Rubble underneath.
Horns of Behemoth.rulesTextZh: （F）（F）（F）（F）（F）（F）— 可以變形為一個惡魔（Demon）。在其下方放置一個瓦礫（Rubble）。

Hotwheel.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Rolls forward two steps, striking another unit at each location it enters.
Hotwheel.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 向前滾動兩步，並在每個經過的位置對另一個單位進行一次打擊。

Howl from Beyond.rulesTextEng: Deal out your top spells, one to each void in the outer columns. Draw any minions with Voidwalk or Monsters from among them and banish the rest.
Howl from Beyond.rulesTextZh: 將你牌庫頂的法術依序發放到外側兩列的每個虛空（void）中，每個虛空放置一張。將其中具有虛空行走（Voidwalk）的隨從或怪物（Monster）加入手牌，其餘全部放逐。

Hyperparasite.rulesTextEng: Can pick up a single minion, disabling them, but can't move while carrying them.
Hyperparasite.rulesTextZh: 可以抓起一個隨從，使其失效（disable），但攜帶期間自己不能移動。

I Am Colossus!.rulesTextEng: You may banish minions under your control, or from your hand or cemetery, to help cast the Colossus. It costs (1) less to cast for each.
I Am Colossus!.rulesTextZh: 你可以放逐由你操控、手牌中或墓地中的隨從，以協助施放巨像（Colossus）。每放逐一個，此法術的施放成本便減少①。

Ice Shards.rulesTextEng: Shoot three projectiles, one at a time. Each deals 1 damage but melts before the third step.
Ice Shards.rulesTextZh: 依序發射三枚投射物。每枚造成1點傷害，但會在飛行至第三步之前融化。

Ignited.rulesTextEng:
Charge
Dies at the end of your turn.
Ignited.rulesTextZh:
衝鋒（Charge）
在你的回合結束時死亡。

Imposter.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play or draw a site.
(3) → Banish an Avatar from your collection to mask yourself. Gain their abilities until damaged or until you put on a new mask.
Imposter.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 打出或抽一張地點。
③ → 從你的收藏（Collection）中放逐一位化身（Avatar）來偽裝成它。獲得該化身的能力，直到你受到傷害或戴上新的面具為止。

Infusion Factory.rulesTextEng: Adjacent artifacts are Automatons with 2 power and their own bearer abilities.
Infusion Factory.rulesTextZh: 相鄰的遺物成為具有2力量的自動機（Automaton），並保有各自的持有者能力。

Innsmouth Dock.rulesTextEng: Once on your turn, you may lure an adjacent minion to step here.
Innsmouth Dock.rulesTextZh: 每回合一次，你可以引誘一個相鄰的隨從向此處邁出一步。

Instigator Imp.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Make two enemy minions at target nearby location fight each other.
Instigator Imp.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 令目標附近地點上的兩個敵方隨從互相戰鬥。

Interrogator.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play or draw a site.
Whenever an ally strikes an enemy Avatar, draw a spell unless they pay 3 life.
Interrogator.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 打出或抽一張地點。
每當一個友方對敵方化身造成一次打擊時，抽一張法術牌，除非該玩家支付3點生命。

Into the Abyss.rulesTextEng: Submerge target minion, or pull it into a void it's adjacent to.
Into the Abyss.rulesTextZh: 令目標隨從潛入水下，或將其拉入與其相鄰的一個虛空（Void）中。

Invigorate.rulesTextEng: An ally gains +3 power this turn and you heal 3.
Invigorate.rulesTextZh: 一個友方本回合獲得+3力量，你恢復3點生命。

Ironclad.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play or draw a site.
Takes 2 less damage.
Ironclad.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 打出或抽一張地點。
受到的傷害減少2點。

Iron Maiden.rulesTextEng: Whenever a nearby Avatar draws a card, they lose life equal to the number of cards they've drawn this turn.
Iron Maiden.rulesTextZh: 每當附近的一位化身（Avatar）抽一張牌時，該化身失去等同於其本回合已抽牌數量的生命。

Jack the Ripper.rulesTextEng:
Stealth
May be cast to any Mortal, silencing then killing them, without breaking Stealth.
Jack the Ripper.rulesTextZh:
潛行（Stealth）
可施放到任意凡人（Mortal）身上，使其沉默（Silence）後再將其殺死，且不會失去潛行。

Key to the City.rulesTextZh:
提供①。
持有者無視地點能力。

Khamaseen Mummy.rulesTextEng:
Burrowing
Whenever this unburrows, you may trigger the Genesis of a nearby Desert.
Khamaseen Mummy.rulesTextZh:
潛地（Burrowing）
每當此單位鑽出地面（Unburrow）時，你可以觸發附近一個沙漠（Desert）的降臨（Genesis）效果。

Kissers of Wounds.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Ward a wounded minion nearby, or you heal 2.
Kissers of Wounds.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 賦予附近一個受傷的隨從護衛（Ward），或你恢復2點生命。

Kiss of Death.rulesTextEng:
May be cast by Spirits and Undead.
Kill target minion here.
Kiss of Death.rulesTextZh:
可由靈體（Spirit）與不死族（Undead）施放。
殺死此處的目標隨從。

Kiss of Judas.rulesTextEng: This turn, attacks against target Avatar can't be defended and you draw a card whenever they are attacked.
Kiss of Judas.rulesTextZh: 本回合，對目標化身（Avatar）的攻擊不能被防禦，且每當該化身受到攻擊時，你抽一張牌。

Kor Crematory.rulesTextEng: (F)(F)(F)(F) — If a card would be placed in a cemetery, banish it instead.
Kor Crematory.rulesTextZh: （F）（F）（F）（F）— 若一張牌將會進入墓地，改為放逐它。

Koschei's Egg.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Avatar bearer hides its soul in Koschei's Egg, becoming immune to death blows. After three of your turns, or if the Egg leaves the realm, you lose.
Koschei's Egg.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 持有此牌的化身（Avatar）將自己的靈魂藏入科謝伊之卵，因此免疫致命一擊（Death Blow）。在你的三個回合後，或若此蛋離開界域（Realm），你便輸掉遊戲。

Lacuna Entity.rulesTextEng:
Submerge, Voidwalk
Genesis → Drag target weaker minion from an adjacent site to here, ignoring regions.
Lacuna Entity.rulesTextZh:
潛水（Submerge）、虛空行走（Voidwalk）
降臨 → 將一個位於相鄰地點、力量低於此單位的目標隨從拖曳到此處，無視區域（Regions）。

Landmass.rulesTextEng: Draw a site. You may play a land site.
Landmass.rulesTextZh: 抽一張地點牌。你可以打出一張陸地地點。

Lash.rulesTextEng: Deal 1 damage to target nearby minion and untap it.
Lash.rulesTextZh: 對附近的目標隨從造成1點傷害，然後將其重置（Untap）。

Leadworks.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Until your next turn, sites are silenced while nearby.
Leadworks.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 直到你的下個回合開始前，附近的地點均被沉默（Silence）。

Legion of Gall.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
Genesis → Look at a collection and banish three cards from it.
Legion of Gall.rulesTextZh:
飛行（Airborne）
降臨 → 查看一位玩家的收藏（Collection），並從中放逐三張牌。

Lifewish.rulesTextZh: 將每位化身（Avatar）的生命完全恢復。

Lilith.rulesTextEng: At the end of your turn, reveal opponent’s top spell. If it’s a minion, summon it here. Otherwise, put it at the bottom of the deck.
Lilith.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合結束時，展示對手牌庫頂的一張法術牌。若其為隨從，則將它召喚到此處；否則將其置於牌庫底。

Locusts of Illyria.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
At the end of your turn, if no new Locusts have been summoned this turn, summon a tapped copy of this nearby.
Locusts of Illyria.rulesTextZh:
飛行（Airborne）
在你的回合結束時，若本回合沒有新的伊利里亞蝗群被召喚，則在附近召喚一個橫置的此牌複製品。

Lord of Destruction.rulesTextEng: Destroys sites it strikes and other minions there.
Lord of Destruction.rulesTextZh: 摧毀它所打擊的地點，以及該地點上的其他隨從。

Lord of Fear.rulesTextZh: 敵方不能單獨進行防禦。

Lord of Greed.rulesTextEng:
Can't drop artifacts.
At the end of your turn, Lord of Greed snatches an artifact from elsewhere into his hands.
Lord of Greed.rulesTextZh:
不能放下遺物。
在你的回合結束時，貪婪之主會從其他地方奪取一件遺物到自己手中。

Lord of Lies.rulesTextEng: Once on your turn, you may have two target units at a nearby location fight.
Lord of Lies.rulesTextZh: 每回合一次，你可以令附近一個地點上的兩個目標單位互相戰鬥。

Lucid Dreamers.rulesTextEng:
Voidwalk
You may cast minions to this void, granting them Voidwalk until they're no longer in the void.
Lucid Dreamers.rulesTextZh:
虛空行走（Voidwalk）
你可以將隨從施放到此虛空（Void），並賦予它們虛空行走（Voidwalk），直到它們離開該虛空。

Lure.rulesTextEng: An ally tempts an enemy minion at a nearby site into taking a step closer.
Lure.rulesTextZh: 令一個友方引誘附近地點上的一個敵方隨從，使其向自己邁出一步。

Magician.rulesTextEng:
You have no atlas, but your spellbook may contain sites, and you start with seven cards.
Tap → Play a site.
Magician.rulesTextZh:
你沒有地圖冊（Atlas），但你的法術書（Spellbook）可以包含地點牌，且你以七張手牌開始遊戲。
橫置 → 打出一張地點。

Maiden, Mother, Crone.rulesTextEng:
Genesis → Heal 3.
(3) → Draw a spell.
Deathrite → Opponent loses 3 life.
Maiden, Mother, Crone.rulesTextZh:
降臨 → 恢復3點生命。
③ → 抽一張法術牌。
死亡之力 → 對手失去3點生命。

Makeshift Barricade.rulesTextEng: If one or more allies here would take damage, prevent it. If the damage was 3 or more, the barricade breaks.
Makeshift Barricade.rulesTextZh: 若此處一個或多個友方將受到傷害，改為防止該傷害。若此次傷害為3點或以上，則此路障被摧毀。

Malakhim.rulesTextEng:
Airborne, Ward
At the end of your turn, untap Malakhim.
Malakhim.rulesTextZh:
飛行（Airborne）、護衛（Ward）
在你的回合結束時，重置瑪拉金。

Mandrake Jars.rulesTextEng: Bearer has +1 power and is an Earth Spellcaster.
Mandrake Jars.rulesTextZh: 持有者獲得+1力量，且視為一名土系施法者（Earth Spellcaster）。

Martyrs of Tomorrow.rulesTextZh: 死亡之力 → 賦予一個友方隨從護衛（Ward）。

Master Necromancer.rulesTextEng:
Spellcaster
Genesis → Summon a Skeleton token to each other adjacent site.
Master Necromancer.rulesTextZh:
施法者（Spellcaster）
降臨 → 在每個其他相鄰地點召喚一個骷髏衍生物（Skeleton token）。

Mayor of Milborne.rulesTextZh: 其他附近的凡人（Mortals）獲得+1力量。

Màzuj Ifrit.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
At the start of your turn, you lose 2 life.
Màzuj Ifrit.rulesTextZh:
飛行（Airborne）
在你的回合開始時，你失去2點生命。

Meat Hook.rulesTextEng: Bearer has "Tap → Shoot a projectile. If a unit is hit, drag it here, and bearer may fight it when it arrives."
Meat Hook.rulesTextZh: 持有者具有「橫置 → 發射一枚投射物。若擊中一個單位，將其拖曳至此處，且持有者可以在其抵達時與其戰鬥。」

Megalurker.rulesTextEng:
Burrowing
Genesis → If an ally died last turn, Megalurker may drag the killer from an adjacent site to here.
Megalurker.rulesTextZh:
潛地（Burrowing）
降臨 → 若上一回合有友方死亡，巨型潛伏者可以將殺死它的單位從一個相鄰地點拖曳到此處。

Mephistopheles.rulesTextEng:
Must be cast to your Avatar's location, taking their life and replacing them as your Avatar.
Once on your turn, you may summon an Evil minion from your hand to an adjacent site.
Mephistopheles.rulesTextZh:
必須施放到你的化身（Avatar）所在位置，奪取其生命，並取代它成為你的化身。
每回合一次，你可以從手牌將一個邪惡（Evil）隨從召喚到一個相鄰地點。

Mesmer Demon.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Tap target adjacent enemy minion and make it step closer.
Mesmer Demon.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 橫置一個相鄰的目標敵方隨從，並令其向此處邁出一步。

Mimic.rulesTextEng: As you summon this Mimic, you may transform a carriable artifact into it, under your control.
Mimic.rulesTextZh: 當你召喚此擬態怪時，你可以將一件可攜帶的遺物變形為此擬態怪，並由你操控。

Mismanaged Mortuary.rulesTextEng: Flooded. Treat your opponent's cemetery as yours, and vice versa.
Mismanaged Mortuary.rulesTextZh: 淹沒（Flooded）。將對手的墓地視為你的墓地，而你的墓地則視為對手的墓地。

Molten Maar.rulesTextEng: (F)(F) — Genesis → You may cast a Hellhounds from your collection to this site.
Molten Maar.rulesTextZh: （F）（F）— 降臨 → 你可以從你的收藏（Collection）中將一張地獄獵犬（Hellhounds）施放到此地點。

Monks of Kobalsa.rulesTextEng: Can't be modified, except by Wards.
Monks of Kobalsa.rulesTextZh: 不能被任何效果修改，護衛（Ward）除外。

Monstermorphosis.rulesTextEng: Disable target nearby minion until your next turn. At the start of that turn, you may transform it into a Monster from your hand or a Horrible Hybrids from your collection.
Monstermorphosis.rulesTextZh: 使附近的目標隨從失效（Disable）直到你的下個回合開始。在該回合開始時，你可以將它變形為手牌中的一個怪物（Monster），或收藏（Collection）中的一張可怖混種（Horrible Hybrids）。

Mortal Soil.rulesTextEng: Whenever an affected site takes damage, banish a minion from your cemetery to prevent it. If you can't, dispel this.
Mortal Soil.rulesTextZh: 每當一個受影響的地點將受到傷害時，你可以放逐墓地中的一個隨從來防止該傷害。若你無法如此做，則驅散此法術。

Moss Troll.rulesTextEng:
Stealth
Loses Stealth if it moves.
Moss Troll.rulesTextZh:
潛行（Stealth）
若其移動，便失去潛行。

Mount Ussar Sanctuary.rulesTextEng: (E)(E)(E)(E) — When your Avatar arrives at Death's Door, they flee here and gain Ward.
Mount Ussar Sanctuary.rulesTextZh: （E）（E）（E）（E）— 當你的化身（Avatar）來到瀕死之門（Death's Door）時，改為逃離至此處，並獲得護衛（Ward）。

Mover of Mountains.rulesTextEng:
Spellcaster
Once on your turn, you may swap two nearby empty sites.
Mover of Mountains.rulesTextZh:
施法者（Spellcaster）
每回合一次，你可以交換兩個附近且沒有單位的地點。

Muddy Pigs.rulesTextZh: 死亡之力 → 你恢復3點生命。

Mudslide.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Slide all units at land sites in this column one step left or right.
Mudslide.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 將此列所有陸地地點上的單位向左或向右滑動一步。

Murder of Crows.rulesTextEng: Deal 1 damage to all enemy minions on the surface. You may cast this spell from your cemetery, banishing it afterward.
Murder of Crows.rulesTextZh: 對地表上的所有敵方隨從造成1點傷害。你可以從墓地施放此法術，施放後將其放逐。

Myrrh's Trophy Room.rulesTextEng: Provides an additional (1) for each Unique minion in an opponent's cemetery.
Myrrh's Trophy Room.rulesTextZh: 對手墓地中每有一個獨特（Unique）隨從，此牌便額外提供①。

Nadir Seed.rulesTextEng: At the end of their turn, this site's controller loses life equal to their unspent mana.
Nadir Seed.rulesTextZh: 在每個回合結束時，此地點的操控者失去等同於其未使用魔力數量的生命。

Necromancer.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play or draw a site.
Once on your turn, you may pay (1) to summon a Skeleton token here.
Necromancer.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 打出或抽一張地點。
每回合一次，你可以支付①，在此處召喚一個骷髏衍生物（Skeleton token）。

Necronomiconcert.rulesTextEng: Each differently named Undead and Instrument nearby joins the band to play. Draw a card for each.
Necronomiconcert.rulesTextZh: 每個附近名稱不同的不死族（Undead）與樂器（Instrument）都加入樂團演奏。每有一個如此加入的單位或樂器，便抽一張牌。

Necropotence.rulesTextEng: Give a nearby allied Undead +3 power this turn.
Necropotence.rulesTextZh: 令附近一個友方不死族（Undead）本回合獲得+3力量。

Nightwatchmen.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 賦予此地點護衛（Ward）。

Noisome Twosome.rulesTextEng: Deathrite → Summon a Skeleton token here.
Noisome Twosome.rulesTextZh: 死亡之力 → 在此處召喚一個骷髏衍生物（Skeleton token）。

No Man's Land.rulesTextEng: Players can't summon minions to this site or to the one directly in front of it.
No Man's Land.rulesTextZh: 玩家不能將隨從召喚到此地點，或其正前方的地點。

Nosferatu.rulesTextEng:
Airborne, Burrowing
Deathrite → Resummon Nosferatu beneath your starting square. If he dies again this turn, banish him instead.
Nosferatu.rulesTextZh:
飛行（Airborne）、潛地（Burrowing）
死亡之力 → 將諾斯費拉圖重新召喚到你的起始格下方。若他於本回合再次死亡，則改為將他放逐。

Novice Necromancer.rulesTextEng:
Spellcaster
Genesis → Summon a Skeleton token here.
Novice Necromancer.rulesTextZh:
施法者（Spellcaster）
降臨 → 在此處召喚一個骷髏衍生物（Skeleton token）。

Old Mortimer's Den.rulesTextEng: When a minion enters here, kill it, then return this site to hand, leaving Rubble behind.
Old Mortimer's Den.rulesTextZh: 當一個隨從進入此處時，將其殺死，然後將此地點收回手牌，並留下瓦礫（Rubble）。

One-shot Wizard.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Shoot a projectile that deals 1 damage, or gain Spellcaster this turn.
One-shot Wizard.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 發射一枚造成1點傷害的投射物，或本回合獲得施法者（Spellcaster）。

Onslaught.rulesTextEng: This turn, allies gain +1 power, Charge, and can't be immobilized, silenced, or disabled.
Onslaught.rulesTextZh: 本回合，友方獲得+1力量、衝鋒（Charge），且不能被定身（Immobilize）、沉默（Silence）或失效（Disable）。

Open Grave.rulesTextEng: Genesis → You may pay (1) to summon a Skeleton token here.
Open Grave.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 你可以支付①，在此處召喚一個骷髏衍生物（Skeleton token）。

Open Mausoleum.rulesTextEng: Genesis → You may pay (1) to summon a Skeleton token here.
Open Mausoleum.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 你可以支付①，在此處召喚一個骷髏衍生物（Skeleton token）。

Ophanim.rulesTextZh: 飛行（Airborne）、移動+1、虛空行走（Voidwalk）、護衛（Ward）

Order of the Pale Worm.rulesTextEng: Nearby sites and units lose Ward
Order of the Pale Worm.rulesTextZh: 附近的地點與單位失去護衛（Ward）。

Order of the Sacred Oak.rulesTextEng:
Ward
Your opponent can't destroy nearby sites.
Order of the Sacred Oak.rulesTextZh:
護衛（Ward）
你的對手不能摧毀附近的地點。

Order of the White Wing.rulesTextEng:
Ward
If a minion would be summoned nearby and it wasn't cast from hand, banish it.
Order of the White Wing.rulesTextZh:
護衛
若附近將有一個隨從被召喚，且它不是從手牌施放，則放逐它。

Orm Infestor.rulesTextEng:
Burrowing, Submerge
At the end of your turn, deal 1 damage to this site and you heal 1.
Orm Infestor.rulesTextZh:
潛地，潛水
在你的回合結束時，對此地點造成1點傷害，並恢復你1點生命。

Orpheus' Crossing.rulesTextEng: Genesis → You're on Death's Door until your next turn. Summon a dead minion here.
Orpheus' Crossing.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 直到你的下個回合開始前，你處於瀕死狀態。將一個死亡的隨從召喚至此。

Overflow.rulesTextEng: Draw a site. You may play a water site.
Overflow.rulesTextZh: 抽一張地點牌。你可以額外放置一張水域地點。

Panpipes of Pnom.rulesTextEng: Damage caused by nearby units is increased to 2.
Panpipes of Pnom.rulesTextZh: 附近單位造成的傷害改為2點。

Peacemaker Arbalest.rulesTextEng: Bearer has Ranged and its strikes deal 1 more damage to units for each of the following they are: Evil, artifact bearers, spellcasters, voidwalkers, submergers, burrowers, and Frogs.
Peacemaker Arbalest.rulesTextZh: 持有者具有遠程。持有者對單位進行打擊時，若該單位具有以下任一特性，每符合一項便額外造成1點傷害：邪惡、攜帶遺物、施法者、虛空行走、潛水、潛地，以及青蛙。

Peace Offering.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
Whenever this enters another player's site, you may give them the Peace Offering. If you do, their units can't attack you on their next turn.
Peace Offering.rulesTextZh:
飛行
每當此牌進入其他玩家的地點時，你可以將和平獻禮交給該玩家。若如此作，該玩家的單位在其下一個回合不能攻擊你。

Peculiar Port.rulesTextEng: (W)(W) — Genesis → You may cast a Horrible Hybrids from your collection to this site.
Peculiar Port.rulesTextZh: （水）（水）— 降臨 → 你可以從你的收藏中施放一張 Horrible Hybrids 到此地點。

Persecutor.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play or draw a site.
Once on your turn, Persecutor may step toward the closest Evil, or brand an enemy so your cards treat them as Evil this turn.
Persecutor.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 放置一張地點牌或抽一張地點牌。
每回合一次，迫害者可以朝最近的邪惡單位邁出一步，或標記一個敵軍，使你的卡牌於本回合將其視為邪惡。

Pied Piper of Hameln.rulesTextEng: You control all minions with 1 or less power.
Pied Piper of Hameln.rulesTextZh: 你操控所有力量值為1或以下的隨從。

Pile of Skulls.rulesTextEng: Once on your turn, you may banish a card from a cemetery to summon a Skeleton token here.
Pile of Skulls.rulesTextZh: 每回合一次，你可以放逐墳墓場中的一張牌，在此召喚一個骷髏衍生物。

Pilgrim's Shrine.rulesTextEng: Ward. When a minion leaves here, transfer this site's Ward to it.
Pilgrim's Shrine.rulesTextZh:
護衛。
當一個隨從離開此處時，將此地點的護衛轉移給它。

Pith Imp.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
Genesis → Steals a random spell from your opponent's hand until it leaves the realm.
Pith Imp.rulesTextZh:
飛行
降臨 → 隨機偷取對手手牌中的一張法術牌，直到它離開界域。

Plague Pits.rulesTextEng: Genesis → If there are three or more dead minions, banish all cemeteries.
Plague Pits.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 若有三個或更多死亡的隨從，放逐所有墳墓場。

Plate of the Whale.rulesTextEng: Bearer is immobile if it has less than 3 power. If it has more than 3 power, prevent the first instance of damage it would take each turn.
Plate of the Whale.rulesTextZh: 若持有者的力量小於3，則其無法移動。若持有者的力量大於3，則每回合首次將受到的傷害改為預防。

Powerwish.rulesTextEng: Each Avatar sacrifices all of their minions, permanently gaining +1 power for each.
Powerwish.rulesTextZh: 每位化身犧牲其所有隨從，並每犧牲一個，永久獲得+1力量。

Profane Revenant.rulesTextEng: Has 0 power unless adjacent to an Evil ally.
Profane Revenant.rulesTextZh: 除非鄰近一個邪惡友軍，否則其力量為0。

Purgatory.rulesTextEng: Whenever an Evil minion dies nearby, its controller loses 1 life.
Purgatory.rulesTextZh: 每當附近有一個邪惡隨從死亡時，其操控者失去1點生命。

Putrid Presence.rulesTextEng:
Submerge, Burrowing
The subsurface of nearby sites can be attacked.
Putrid Presence.rulesTextZh:
潛水，潛地
附近地點的地下與水下區域可以成為攻擊目標。

Raise Militia.rulesTextEng: Summon a Skeleton token to each allied site that borders an enemy site.
Raise Militia.rulesTextZh: 在每個與敵方地點相鄰的友方地點召喚一個骷髏衍生物。

Rat King.rulesTextEng: Genesis & Deathrite → Search your top six spells. You may summon an Ordinary rat from among them to each other adjacent site. Put the rest at the bottom of your spellbook.
Rat King.rulesTextZh: 降臨與死亡儀式 → 檢視你的法術書頂六張法術牌。你可以從中將一個普通稀有度的老鼠召喚到每個其他相鄰地點。將其餘牌以任意順序置於你的法術書底。

Raze.rulesTextEng: An ally destroys its site and all artifacts there.
Raze.rulesTextZh: 選擇一個友方單位，其摧毀所在的地點及該處所有遺物。

Realm-Eater.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play, draw, or digest a site.
Destroys sites it successfully attacks, then becomes immobile until it digests.
Realm-Eater.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 放置、抽取或消化一張地點牌。
當它成功攻擊一個地點時，摧毀該地點，然後直到完成消化前無法移動。

Redmane Hyena.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Banish up to three cards from cemeteries. If any are Demons, this becomes one and gains +2 power permanently.
Redmane Hyena.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 放逐墳墓場中至多三張牌。若其中有任何一張是惡魔，則此牌成為惡魔，並永久獲得+2力量。

Red Rock of Ravannis.rulesTextEng:
Artifacts can't be carried here.
At the end of each turn, pull each artifact one step towards this site, along with its bearer.
Red Rock of Ravannis.rulesTextZh:
遺物在此處無法被攜帶。
每回合結束時，將每件遺物朝此地點拉近一步，其持有者也一同移動。

Regurgitator.rulesTextEng: At the end of your turn, Regurgitator must either fill its empty belly by banishing a dead minion, or empty its full belly by shooting a projectile that deals damage equal to the eaten minion's power.
Regurgitator.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合結束時，反芻獸必須擇一：若腹中為空，則放逐一個死亡的隨從將其吞下；若腹中已有獵物，則將其吐出，發射一枚投射物，造成等同於被吞食隨從力量的傷害。

Release the Hounds.rulesTextEng: Summon two Hellhounds from your collection to your Avatar's location. They gain Charge this turn.
Release the Hounds.rulesTextZh: 從你的收藏中召喚兩隻地獄獵犬到你的化身所在地。它們本回合獲得衝鋒。

Renatus Trueblood.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
Renatus Trueblood's strike damage against units heals you.
Renatus Trueblood.rulesTextZh:
飛行
雷納圖斯・真血對單位造成的打擊傷害會為你恢復等量生命。

Returned King.rulesTextEng:
Other Undead have +1 power.
You control all Undead.
Returned King.rulesTextZh:
其他不死生物具有+1力量。
你操控所有不死生物。

Return to Nature.rulesTextEng: Return up to three cards from a cemetery to the bottom of their decks. Draw a spell.
Return to Nature.rulesTextZh: 將一個墳墓場中至多三張牌放回其牌庫底，然後抽一張法術牌。

Revered Revenant.rulesTextEng: Has 0 power unless adjacent to an allied Ward.
Revered Revenant.rulesTextZh: 除非鄰近一個具有護衛的友方單位或地點，否則其力量為0。

River Rapids.rulesTextEng: Once on your turn, you may push a minion on connected Rivers one step.
River Rapids.rulesTextZh: 每回合一次，你可以將位於相連河流上的一個隨從推動一步。

Road to Perdition.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Target nearby Evil gains or loses 1 power this turn.
Road to Perdition.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 選擇附近一個邪惡單位，其本回合力量增加或減少1。

Rowdy Boys.rulesTextZh: 對不死生物進行打擊後，重置。

Sacred Stag.rulesTextEng:
Ward
Deathrite → You may Ward this site.
Sacred Stag.rulesTextZh:
護衛
死亡儀式 → 你可以賦予此地點護衛。

Saint of Redemption.rulesTextEng:
Ward
No minion is Evil, but all enter the realm tapped.
Saint of Redemption.rulesTextZh:
護衛
沒有任何隨從視為邪惡，但所有隨從進入界域時皆為橫置。

Saintweald.rulesTextEng: Deathrite abilities here are also Genesis abilities.
Saintweald.rulesTextZh: 此處的死亡儀式異能同時視為降臨異能。

Salt the Earth.rulesTextEng:
Conjure Salt the Earth to a single site, destroying it.
Sites can't be played here.
Salt the Earth.rulesTextZh:
將「鹽封大地」具現到一個地點，並摧毀該地點。
此處不能放置地點牌。

Satanic Panic.rulesTextEng: Kill all Demons, and one other target minion.
Satanic Panic.rulesTextZh: 消滅所有惡魔，以及另一個目標隨從。

Savior.rulesTextEng:
Tap → Play or draw a site.
(1) → Ward a minion that was summoned this turn.
Savior.rulesTextZh:
橫置 → 放置一張地點牌或抽一張地點牌。
① → 賦予本回合被召喚的隨從護衛。

Sawbones.rulesTextEng: If a nearby allied minion survives damage, fully heal it.
Sawbones.rulesTextZh: 若附近的一個友方隨從承受傷害後存活，則將其完全治癒。

Scatter.rulesTextEng: Push everything at target location one step, one at a time.
Scatter.rulesTextZh: 將目標位置上的所有物件逐一推動一步。

Screamer.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Tap target adjacent enemy minion and make it take a step away.
Screamer.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 橫置目標相鄰敵方隨從，並使其朝遠離此牌的方向移動一步。

Sea of Ash.rulesTextZh: 附近地點地下的隨從死亡。

Search Party.rulesTextEng: Has +1 power for each Search Party in your cemetery.
Search Party.rulesTextZh: 你的墳墓場中每有一張「搜尋隊」，此牌便具有+1力量。

Searing Truth.rulesTextEng: Target player draws and reveals two spells, then takes damage equal to the higher mana cost.
Searing Truth.rulesTextZh: 目標玩家抽兩張法術牌並展示之，然後受到等同於其中較高魔力成本的傷害。

Second Wind.rulesTextEng:
An allied minion takes a step.
You may cast this spell from your cemetery, banishing it afterward.
Second Wind.rulesTextZh:
一個友方隨從移動一步。
你可以從你的墳墓場施放此法術，施放後將其放逐。

Sensu of the Fang.rulesTextEng: Bearer has +1 power and is an Air Spellcaster.
Sensu of the Fang.rulesTextZh: 持有者具有+1力量，且成為風系施法者。

Sentinel Trap.rulesTextEng: At the end of each turn, Sentinel Trap deals 4 damage to each unit at the adjacent location it's facing, then rotates 90 degrees clockwise.
Sentinel Trap.rulesTextZh: 每回合結束時，哨兵陷阱對其面向的相鄰位置上每個單位造成4點傷害，然後順時針旋轉90度。

Seraphim.rulesTextEng:
Airborne, Ward
At the end of your turn, you may transfer a nearby Ward onto a nearby minion or site.
Seraphim.rulesTextZh:
飛行，護衛
在你的回合結束時，你可以將附近的一個護衛轉移到附近的一個隨從或地點。

Sewer Rats.rulesTextEng:
May be cast under any site.
Burrowing, Submerge
Sewer Rats.rulesTextZh:
可以施放至任何地點的地下或水下區域。
潛地，潛水

Shackled Demon.rulesTextEng: Disabled until an adjacent Spellcaster taps to release him.
Shackled Demon.rulesTextZh: 此牌處於失能狀態，直到一個相鄰的施法者橫置以釋放它。

Shallow Grave.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Discard your top two spells.
Shallow Grave.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 棄掉你的法術書頂兩張法術牌。

Shrike Orchard.rulesTextEng: Whenever you summon a minion here, kill target nearby enemy Beast with 2 or less power.
Shrike Orchard.rulesTextZh: 每當你在此召喚一個隨從時，消滅附近一個力量2或以下的目標敵方野獸。

Silent Hills.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Until your next turn, minions are silenced while atop nearby sites.
Silent Hills.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 直到你的下個回合開始前，位於附近地點地表的隨從皆被沉默。

Silver Bullet.rulesTextEng: Bearer has "Tap, Sacrifice Silver Bullet -> This unit may cast an Exceptional spell from your collection."
Silver Bullet.rulesTextZh: 持有者具有「橫置，犧牲銀彈 → 此單位可以從你的收藏中施放一張卓越稀有度法術。」

Sinister Pond.rulesTextEng: Mortals here may transform into Evil from hand by paying the difference in cost.
Sinister Pond.rulesTextZh: 此處的人類可以支付成本差額，從手牌變身為邪惡單位。

Sinterfee.rulesTextEng: Genesis -> Target adjacent site is silenced and provides no threshold while Sinterfee is in the realm.
Sinterfee.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 當辛特菲位於界域中時，目標相鄰地點被沉默，且不提供任何元素門檻。

Sister Stefánia.rulesTextEng:
Ward
Other nearby minions are silenced.
Sister Stefánia.rulesTextZh:
護衛
其他附近的隨從皆被沉默。

Sjaelström.rulesTextEng: Banish all nearby Spirits and auras. Draw a spell for each.
Sjaelström.rulesTextZh: 放逐附近所有靈體與靈氣。每放逐一張，便抽一張法術牌。

Skeleton Mage.rulesTextEng:
Spellcaster
Genesis → May cast an Ordinary magic from a cemetery, banishing it afterward.
Skeleton Mage.rulesTextZh:
施法者
降臨 → 你可以從一個墳墓場施放一張普通稀有度魔法，施放後將其放逐。

Slimy Mutants.rulesTextEng:
Submerge
(3) → Transform an ally with Submerge into Slimy Mutants from your hand.
Slimy Mutants.rulesTextZh:
潛水
③ → 將一個具有潛水的友方單位，從你的手牌變身為「黏液突變體」。

Slobbermaw.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Sacrifice a minion or Slobbermaw deals 4 damage to you.
Slobbermaw.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 犧牲一個隨從，否則垂涎巨口對你造成4點傷害。

Smite.rulesTextEng:
May be cast by any ally.
Strike target adjacent enemy. If it's Evil, banish it instead.
Smite.rulesTextZh:
可由任何友方單位施放。
打擊目標相鄰敵軍。若其為邪惡單位，改為放逐它。

Sold-out Cemetery.rulesTextEng: Whenever Undead enter this site, push another Undead here away one step.
Sold-out Cemetery.rulesTextZh: 每當有不死生物進入此地點時，將此處另一個不死生物朝遠離此地點的方向推動一步。

Sow the Earth.rulesTextEng:
Conjure Sow the Earth to a single void square, playing your top site there.
This site provides double mana and threshold.
Sow the Earth.rulesTextZh:
將「播種大地」具現到一個虛空格，並將你的牌庫頂地點放置於該處。
此地點提供雙倍法力與元素門檻。

Sphere of Animosity.rulesTextEng: Avatars here can't leave, heal, or be defended.
Sphere of Animosity.rulesTextZh: 此處的化身不能離開、恢復生命，也不能被防禦。

Sphinx Sarcophagus.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Banish two identical spells from cemeteries to draw a spell.
Sphinx Sarcophagus.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 從墳墓場放逐兩張同名法術牌，然後抽一張法術牌。

Spore Spouts.rulesTextEng: Genesis → You can cast minions with 2 or less power to any site this turn.
Spore Spouts.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 本回合，你可以將力量2或以下的隨從施放到任何地點。

Stagecoach.rulesTextEng:
Charge
May carry any number of minions.
Stagecoach.rulesTextZh:
衝鋒
可以搭載任意數量的隨從。

Stargazer.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Draw a spell for each minion in the void.
Stargazer.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 虛空中的每個隨從各讓你抽一張法術牌。

Static Servant.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Each other unit here takes 1 damage.
Static Servant.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 此處其他每個單位受到1點傷害。

Stinging Kelp.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Deal 1 damage to each minion at target site in this body of water.
Stinging Kelp.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 對此水域中目標地點上的每個隨從造成1點傷害。

Stitched Abomination.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Banish up to three minions from one cemetery to stitch together. This Abomination has their combined power, but each part may be damaged and destroyed separately.
Stitched Abomination.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 從一個墳墓場放逐至多三個隨從並將其縫合。此憎惡的力量等於它們力量的總和，但每個縫合部位都能分別受到傷害並被摧毀。

Sturmgeist.rulesTextEng:
Airborne
Whenever an enemy casts magic, Sturmgeist steps closer then strikes it if adjacent.
Sturmgeist.rulesTextZh:
飛行
每當敵方施放魔法時，風暴幽靈朝其移動一步，若因此相鄰，則立即對其進行打擊。

Stygian Archers.rulesTextEng:
Ranged
Whenever Stygian Archers kill an enemy, summon a Skeleton token where it died.
Stygian Archers.rulesTextZh:
遠程
每當冥河弓箭手消滅一個敵軍時，在該單位死亡的位置召喚一個骷髏衍生物。

Survivors of Serava.rulesTextEng: At the end of your turn, if no enemies are nearby, this gains Stealth.
Survivors of Serava.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合結束時，若附近沒有敵軍，此牌獲得潛行。

Symmetric Suffering.rulesTextEng: Sacrifice up to one minion, artifact, and aura. Your opponent must sacrifice the same.
Symmetric Suffering.rulesTextZh: 你可以各犧牲至多一個隨從、一件遺物與一個靈氣。你的對手必須犧牲相同數量與類型的永久物。

Tabula Rasa.rulesTextEng:
May be cast to any minion.
Bearer is silenced, can't be modified otherwise, and can't drop Tabula Rasa.
Tabula Rasa.rulesTextZh:
可施放於任何隨從。
持有者被沉默、不能以其他方式被修改，且不能卸下「白板」。

Temple of Moloch.rulesTextEng: Once on each player's turn, they may sacrifice a minion here to gain (2).
Temple of Moloch.rulesTextZh: 每位玩家每回合一次，可以犧牲此處的一個隨從以獲得②。

The Apex of Babel.rulesTextEng: When the Tower of Babel is built, draw a spell, then you may cast a spell for free.
The Apex of Babel.rulesTextZh: 當巴別塔建成時，抽一張法術牌，然後你可以免費施放一張法術。

The Base of Babel.rulesTextEng: You may build The Tower of Babel by playing The Apex of Babel atop this.
The Base of Babel.rulesTextZh: 你可以將「巴別塔之巔」放置於此牌上方，以建造巴別塔。

The Doom of Dilmun.rulesTextEng:
Burrowing, Submerge, Voidwalk
Can't be banished, destroyed, or modified.
The Doom of Dilmun.rulesTextZh:
潛地，潛水，虛空行走
不能被放逐、摧毀或修改。

The Empyrean.rulesTextEng: Provides (A)(E)(F)(W) if you control a nearby Angel or Ward.
The Empyrean.rulesTextZh: 若你操控附近的一個天使，或附近具有護衛的單位或地點，則提供（A）（E）（F）（W）。

The Flood.rulesTextEng: Permanently flood the entire realm, including voids. Submerge everything except one minion of each type.
The Flood.rulesTextZh: 永久淹沒整個界域，包括所有虛空格。將所有單位潛入水下，但每種類型各保留一個隨從不受影響。

The Hexham Haunts.rulesTextEng:
Airborne, Burrowing
Must be cast burrowed, but may be cast from the cemetery.
The Hexham Haunts.rulesTextZh:
飛行，潛地
必須以潛地狀態施放，但可以從墳墓場施放。

The Inquisition.rulesTextEng:
When an opponent can see this card in your hand or spellbook, you may summon it.
Genesis → Target opponent reveals their hand. You may banish a card from it.
The Inquisition.rulesTextZh:
當對手能看見此牌位於你的手牌或法術書時，你可以召喚它。
降臨 → 目標對手展示其手牌。你可以放逐其中一張牌。

The Malleus Maleficarum.rulesTextEng: Once on your turn, bearer may cast a magic from your collection that targets an enemy Spellcaster, or their location or site.
The Malleus Maleficarum.rulesTextZh: 每回合一次，持有者可以從你的收藏中施放一張以敵方施法者、其所在位置或其所在地點為目標的魔法。

The Manor at Daperyll Hill.rulesTextEng: (A)(A)(A)(A) — Once on your turn, this may deal 3 damage to target enemy here to heal you 3.
The Manor at Daperyll Hill.rulesTextZh: （A）（A）（A）（A）— 每回合一次，此牌可以對此處一個目標敵軍造成3點傷害，並使你恢復3點生命。

The Pallid Bust.rulesTextEng:
Genesis → Banish a dead minion.
Minion bearer has the banished minion's printed types and abilities.
The Pallid Bust.rulesTextZh:
降臨 → 放逐一個死亡的隨從。
隨從持有者獲得該被放逐隨從牌面印刷的類型與異能。

The Rack.rulesTextEng: Whenever the bearer strikes an Avatar, stretch them so that they also occupy another adjacent location. Then they lose 1 life for each location they occupy.
The Rack.rulesTextZh: 每當持有者打擊一個化身時，將該化身延展，使其額外占據一個相鄰位置。然後，該化身每占據一個位置便失去1點生命。

Thing in the Ice.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Disabled for three of your turns. Can't be targeted or damaged by magic until the ice melts.
Thing in the Ice.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 在你的三個回合內處於失能狀態。在冰層融化前，不能成為魔法的目標，也不會受到魔法造成的傷害。

Thin Ice.rulesTextEng: At the end of your turn, if minions atop this site total 5 or more power, submerge them.
Thin Ice.rulesTextZh: 在你的回合結束時，若位於此地點地表的隨從力量總和為5或以上，則將它們潛入水下。

Those Who Linger.rulesTextEng: Deathrite → Summon a Ghoul from your collection to this site. It has "Deathrite → Summon a Skeleton token to this site."
Those Who Linger.rulesTextZh: 死亡儀式 → 從你的收藏中召喚一個食屍鬼到此地點。它具有「死亡儀式 → 在此地點召喚一個骷髏衍生物。」

Thumb Screws.rulesTextEng: Whenever a nearby Avatar casts a spell, they lose life equal to the number of spells they've cast this turn.
Thumb Screws.rulesTextZh: 每當附近的一個化身施放法術時，其失去等同於該玩家本回合已施放法術數量的生命。

Tombstone Wardens.rulesTextEng: During your opponent's turn, this is a 5 power Angel Automaton with Airborne.
Tombstone Wardens.rulesTextZh: 在對手的回合中，此牌視為一個力量5、具有飛行的天使構裝體。

Toolbox.rulesTextEng: Sacrifice → Bearer may cast an Ordinary spell from your collection.
Toolbox.rulesTextZh: 犧牲 → 持有者可以從你的收藏中施放一張普通稀有度法術。

Torch and Pitchfork.rulesTextEng: Ordinary bearer has "Nearby Ordinary allies have +1 power."
Torch and Pitchfork.rulesTextZh: 普通稀有度的持有者具有「附近其他普通稀有度友軍具有+1力量。」

Torrid Omphalos.rulesTextEng:
Earth and Fire Spellcaster
At the end of your turn, this Omphalos draws a spell, which only it can cast. Minions it casts must be summoned here.
Torrid Omphalos.rulesTextZh:
土系與火系施法者
在你的回合結束時，此歐姆法洛斯抽一張法術牌，且只有它可以施放該牌。由它施放的隨從必須召喚至此。

Town Priest.rulesTextEng: Genesis → Return target adjacent Evil minion to its owner's hand.
Town Priest.rulesTextZh: 降臨 → 將目標相鄰邪惡隨從返回其擁有者手牌。

Trade Encampment.rulesTextEng: Genesis → You may trade an artifact in your hand with one of equal rarity from your collection
